title: 3D Packaging Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a 3D Packaging Engineer, you will collaborate closely with our engineering team to physically realize our VIO products. You will operate, adapt, and fine-tune high-precision assembly equipment to meet the precise tolerances required for optimal device performance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Tooling Adaptation: Assist in modifying and calibrating high-precision assembly equipment (e.g., flip-chip bonders, die attach machines) to meet unique quantum 3D integration specifications.

  • Process Optimization: Help develop and refine placement and bonding processes (thermo-compression bonding, laser-assisted bonding, coldwelding) for non-standard substrates. Test adhesives, glues, and solders to determine which materials survive extreme thermal cycling and cryogenic vacuum conditions.

  • 3D Assembly Execution: Execute complex integration strategies, including multi-die stacking, interposer-based 3D architectures, and orthogonal (vertical) chip placement.

Your Profile

  • Education: BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field.

  • Tooling Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience operating and adjusting high-accuracy semiconductor assembly platforms.

  • Precision Assembly: Demonstrated experience achieving tight placement tolerances (around 1µm) in an R&D or pilot production environment.

  • 3D Integration Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of 3D integration (TSVs, micro-bumps, interposers) and how structural materials behave under thermal stress, high vacuum, or cryogenic conditions.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: [2027 Bachelor's graduates] Analyst (European Competition practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world.  CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.

We have played a key role in many cases that have shaped European competition policy in recent years: from aerospace to software, and manufacturing to transportation. More recently, we have been at the forefront of economic thinking in antitrust investigations and regulation in the tech sector.

We seek candidates for our London, UK location.

Position Overview

The Analyst position is the entry-level position for applicants with an undergraduate qualification in economics. Analysts work closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practice input to projects. A typical Analyst would:

  • Identify potential issues and conduct analyses that can be used to illustrate economic arguments;
  • Assemble compelling evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations;
  • Program, build models, and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;
  • Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using financial, market, industry or client-proprietary data;
  • Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; and
  • Participate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).

Desired Qualifications 

  • An undergraduate qualification (BSc/BA) in economics from well-regarded institutions, graduating between December 2026 and August 2027. The position is ideally suited to candidates considering post-graduate study who would appreciate 1-2 year's employment experience and an insight into the world of economic consulting before returning to university for a postgraduate qualification;
  • Strong foundation in microeconomics, with a specialism in industrial economics preferred;
  • High degree of numeracy and comfort with data manipulation are essential, familiarity with econometric techniques desirable;
  • Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;
  • Effective oral and written communication skills;
  • Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;
  • Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;
  • Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills; and
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.

As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit the following:

  • CV/Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in the European Competition practice and how this role matches your goals.
  • Academic Results - please provide all university transcript(s) available to date, including any current or incomplete results.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • Charles River Associate’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering 100 hours of training annually through formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

Charles River Associates creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 days a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another Charles River Associates office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team. At certain times of the year (e.g. holiday periods), additional remote work options are offered to those whose work commitments permit it, although our offices remain open for those who choose or need to be there.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an Equality Act 2010 employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

title: [31687] - Senior HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an HR professional who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and enjoys operating at both a strategic and operational level. You’ll play a key role in translating business priorities into people strategies that enable growth, strengthen organisational culture and deliver measurable business outcomes.

With teams across the UK, Portugal and Brazil, you’ll bring a strong understanding of working across different cultures and markets, while helping the organisation navigate transformation and change.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence leadership decisions, shape organisational design, develop talent and succession pipelines, strengthen performance management, and lead initiatives that enhance the overall employee experience.

What You’ll Do

Partner with Senior Leadership

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior leaders across EMEA, providing insight and challenge on people, organisational structure, performance and workforce matters.

  • Translate business strategy and evolving priorities into practical People & Culture solutions.

  • Support leaders in making informed, people-focused decisions in a fast-moving environment.

Drive People Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and deliver People & Culture initiatives that directly support business objectives and deliver measurable impact.

  • Lead and contribute to organisational transformation and change initiatives across the region.

  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, policies and ways of working, ensuring they remain agile and fit for purpose.

Lead Core HR Processes

  • Own and support end-to-end workforce planning and headcount management.

  • Drive succession planning and talent development pipelines.

  • Lead performance management cycles, including calibration and development planning.

  • Support employee engagement, culture and organisational effectiveness initiatives.

Use Data to Drive Decisions

  • Leverage people analytics and HR metrics to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

  • Turn data and insights into clear recommendations for leaders.

  • Use evidence-based approaches to continuously improve people processes and employee experience across diverse teams.

Coach & Develop Leaders

  • Provide hands-on coaching to leaders on effective people management, feedback, performance, conflict resolution and leadership development.

Collaborate Across People & Culture

What We’re Looking For

You’ll bring:

  • Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, People Partner or strategic HR role, ideally within an organisation experiencing significant growth, transformation or change.

  • A strong track record of partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  • A hands-on approach, with the ability to move confidently between strategic thinking and operational delivery.

  • Strong experience across performance management, talent development, succession planning and organisational culture.

  • Excellent commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people solutions.

  • Experience working across different countries, cultures and organisational contexts within EMEA.

  • A strong analytical mindset, with experience using people data, HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions and improve processes.

  • Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to build trusted relationships at all levels and confidently challenge and coach senior leaders.

  • A proven ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, change and evolving organisational priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within a technology, startup or high-growth environment.

  • Experience leading organisational transformation or change management initiatives across multiple regions.

  • Knowledge of Portuguese would be an advantage.

Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard. We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the French market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in France: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in France. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the French market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in France, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the French market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent French are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the French market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

AI in Our Recruitment Process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. The Account Specialist will also drive strategy by analyzing campaign performance, identifying success areas and/or challenge areas, and proactively implementing strategic measures to continuously optimize programs towards goals and objectives.

You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth.

Diligently vets opportunities to ensure brand alignment, authenticity and relevancy prior to presenting to client for approval. Conducts outreach to approved partners and skillfully garners their engagement and participation in the campaign, negotiating when necessary. Supports influencers through campaign onboarding by developing and providing resources to streamline processes.

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.

title: Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Megaport We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun. Our Team Culture We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

Reporting to the Regional Manager of Customer Success, the Customer Success Manager (CSM) will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of high-value, strategic customers. This is a Sales role with a quota to achieve each quarter, focused on high-touch post-sales engagement, with particular emphasis on driving customer success, enabling upsell and cross-sell opportunities, managing renewals, supporting service performance, and enhancing the overall customer experience.

The CSM will be responsible for maintaining and expanding revenue by developing strong customer relationships, understanding strategic priorities, introducing new product developments and commercial initiatives, and showcasing the full value of the Megaport proposition. This is a quota-carrying role, with defined revenue targets and performance measured against attainment. Success will be evaluated based on your ability to grow and retain revenue within your customer base, contributing to both individual and team objectives.

This position is part of the wider Integrated Accounts Team, working closely with a Direct Sales Executive and Solutions Architect. The CSM will take a leading role in commercial engagement for existing strategic customers within the France portfolio, focused on growth, retention, adoption, and long-term customer satisfaction.

You will champion Megaport’s value proposition and help drive adoption across our ever-evolving portfolio of services, strengthening Megaport’s position as a trusted infrastructure partner.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with Direct Sales Executives and Solution Architects to manage, grow, and retain revenue across a defined portfolio of strategic customers.

  • Build strong relationships across multiple levels of the customer organisation, including senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain account plans that capture customer objectives, priorities, risks, stakeholders, and growth opportunities.

  • Lead regular strategic customer engagements, including business reviews and success planning sessions.

  • Drive adoption and awareness of Megaport’s products, services, and broader partner ecosystem through proactive, tailored engagement.

  • Proactively manage the renewal process, identifying risk early and working to maximise retention and customer lifetime value.

  • Act as a trusted advisor from onboarding through to renewal and expansion, ensuring customers realise ongoing value from Megaport.

  • Identify upsell, cross-sell, and whitespace opportunities based on customer priorities, use cases, and future plans.

  • Represent the customer internally, coordinating commercial resolution of issues and identifying where Megaport can deliver greater value.

  • Track customer sentiment, account health, risks, and pipeline activity in Salesforce (SFDC) to support planning and forecasting.

  • Maintain strong product knowledge across Megaport’s solutions, confidently positioning their value within the customer’s broader technology environment.

  • Support revenue growth campaigns by partnering with Sales and Marketing on focused strategies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Finance and Operations, to help resolve service-impacting challenges.

  • Continuously seek ways to improve customer experience and internal processes through customer feedback and commercial insight.


    • What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Account Management, or equivalent roles within the enterprise software, internet, cloud, or telecommunications sectors.

  • Experience managing high-value or strategically important customers in a high-touch environment.

  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to influence revenue outcomes through a consultative, value-driven sales approach.

  • Proven experience driving retention, adoption, upsell, and cross-sell within existing customer accounts.

  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated strength in identifying customer pain points and proposing relevant solutions that drive tangible value.

  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, technical environments with shifting priorities.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and customers.

  • Confident using CRM platforms such as Salesforce (SFDC) to maintain account records, opportunity pipelines, forecasting, and reporting.

  • Understanding of cloud, networking, and virtualised compute environments in the enterprise space is highly desirable.

  • Must be fluent in French and English, comfortable presenting to customers and internal company stakeholders in both languages.


    • What We Offer

  • Flexible working environments

  • Birthday Leave

  • Generous study and training allowance + 5 days paid study leave

  • Creative, fun, and contemporary workspaces

  • Motivated team of industry experts and new talent

  • Celebrated success with ‘Legend’ and ‘Kudos’ Awards

title: Account Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Account Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus Digital Media bei Carwow in München.

Du verkaufst unsere digitalen Mediaprodukte YouTube, Meta und Data an Automobilhersteller, Partner und Mediaagenturen und begleitest die Kampagnen von der Buchung bis zur Aussteuerung.

Du bist dir nicht ganz sicher, ob die Position zu dir passt? Bewirb dich und lass es uns gemeinsam herausfinden.



Unsere Mission

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel. Wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt.

Unsere Reichweite geht weit über die eigene Plattform hinaus: 10 Mio. YouTube Abonnenten und mehr als 350 Mio. Online Leser pro Jahr in der Gruppe. Genau diese Reichweite und unsere Daten machen wir jetzt für Werbekunden auch außerhalb von Carwow nutzbar.

Dein Impact @ Carwow

Du baust die Säule Digital Media, Audiences und Data im deutschen OEM & Media Team aus. Unsere Brand Partnerships Manager:innen verkaufen Retail Media auf der Plattform. Du sorgst dafür, dass Carwow auch in den Mediaplänen der Agenturen fest gesetzt ist.

Dafür hast du drei Produkte im Gepäck. Du schnürst daraus Pakete, die zu den Zielen der Partner passen und verbindest sie mit unserem Retail Media Angebot zu einer durchgängigen Media Story bis zum Kauf. So wächst ein noch junger Umsatzstrom zu einem festen Standbein, und du prägst ihn von Anfang an mit.

YouTube: Bewegtbildkampagnen im Carwow Umfeld und mit Carwow Zielgruppen, von Awareness bis Klick

Meta: Kampagnen auf Facebook und Instagram, ausgesteuert auf Menschen, die gerade nachweislich ein Auto suchen

Data: Datenberatung auf Basis der Carwow Daten, verbunden mit unserem Verständnis des deutschen Automarkts

Und neue Produkte: Weitere Formate und Ideen, die wir gerade entwickeln. Du bringst ein, was Kunden und Agenturen brauchen, und führst neue Produkte in den Markt ein


Deine Aufgaben als Account Manager mit Fokus Digital Media

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz mit YouTube, Meta und Data im deutschen Markt und baust ihn gezielt aus (genau hier brauchst du eine "Hunter Mentalität" im Vertrieb)

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für die Mediaagenturen der Automobilhersteller, von den großen Networks bis zu den spezialisierten Häusern, und kennst dort Planung, Einkauf und Strategie

  • Du gewinnst gemeinsam mit unseren Brand Partnerships Manager:innen die Marketing und Mediaverantwortlichen der OEMs für unsere Digitalprodukte

  • Du beantwortest Briefings mit Mediaplänen und Angebote, die sich an den KPIs der Kunden messen lassen, und überzeugst mit starken Pitches

  • Du bringst gewonnene Kampagnen sauber in die Buchung: Angebot, Auftrag, Übergabe an Media Operations und Abstimmung von Assets, Laufzeiten und Tracking

  • Du steuerst laufende Kampagnen gemeinsam mit Media Operations aus, optimierst auf die vereinbarten KPIs, ordnest Reportings für Kunden ein und machst aus guten Ergebnissen Folgebuchungen und Jahresvereinbarungen

  • Du entwickelst mit Produkt, Analytics und Media Operations unsere Angebote weiter und bringst zurück, was Agenturen wirklich brauchen

    ... und du pflegst deine Pipeline und deinen Forecast so, dass wir uns darauf gemeinsam verlassen können

Dein Profil


Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifiziert und Lust auf richtig guten Mediavertrieb hast, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Denn wir wollen gemeinsam mit dir wachsen.

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Mediavertrieb mit, zum Beispiel bei einem Vermarkter, Publisher, einer Plattform oder auf Agenturseite

  • Du kennst die deutsche Agenturlandschaft und hast idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk in den Agenturen

  • Du hast digitale Kampagnen selbst aufgesetzt und ausgesteuert, idealerweise in DV360 (YouTube) und im Meta Ads Manager, und sprichst über CPM, Reichweite und Conversion so sicher wie über Markenziele

  • Du arbeitest gern mit Daten und kannst aus Zahlen eine Geschichte machen, die ein Kunde versteht und kauft

  • Du präsentierst komplexe Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht und überzeugend, vor der Planer:in genauso wie vor der Marketingleitung

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, auch wenn mehrere Angebote und Buchungen gleichzeitig laufen

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch

    Benzin im Blut ist kein Muss, Neugier auf die Automobilbranche schon.



Unser Interview Prozess

  • Talent Screen (telefonisch) mit unserem Recruiting Team - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Video Interview (online) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Case Study (vor Ort) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 60 Minuten

  • Final Values & Team Fit (vor Ort oder online) nach Möglichkeit im Anschluss an deine Case Study - ca. 30 Minuten


Und was springt für dich dabei raus?

Bei uns findest du ein innovatives, vielfältiges und lockeres Arbeitsumfeld im Herzen Münchens. Dazu kommen:

  • Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket mit variablem Anteil

  • 28 Urlaubstage, die mit der Betriebszugehörigkeit auf bis zu 35 Tage steigen, plus Sonderurlaub für Umzüge, Hochzeiten und mehr

  • Hybrides Arbeiten (3 Tage Office, 2 Tage Home Office, für dessen Ausstattung du ein Budget von 500 Euro on top bekommst)

  • Eine Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

  • Eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club

  • ... sowie eine ehrliche Work Life Balance

Vielfalt und Inklusion sind fest in unserer Unternehmenskultur verankert. Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und treffen unsere Entscheidungen fair, transparent und ausschließlich auf Basis von Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und Potenzial.

title: Account Manager — New Business & Closing (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager — New Business & Closing (m/f/d) based in Switzerland.

As an Account Manager specializing in new business and closing, you will turn qualified sales opportunities into signed partnerships, helping businesses unlock the commercial potential of loyalty programmes. You will manage the full sales cycle, from discovery and solution development to presentations, negotiations, and contract closure. Working with small and medium-sized businesses, you will identify customer acquisition and retention challenges and demonstrate how loyalty solutions can drive repeat purchases and sustainable growth. You will collaborate closely with Sales Development Representatives and Customer Success to ensure a seamless customer journey, from the first qualified conversation through successful onboarding. By combining consultative selling, disciplined pipeline management, and AI-powered sales tools, you will help accelerate revenue growth in an expanding B2B loyalty market. This is an opportunity to join an international, remote-first team where commercial ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement are central to success.


Accountabilities:
  • Own the full sales cycle: Manage qualified opportunities from initial discovery through solution development, proposal preparation, commercial negotiations, and signed agreements, taking personal responsibility for converting prospects into customers.
  • Conduct consultative discovery: Understand each prospect's business model, target audience, commercial priorities, customer acquisition challenges, and buying process to identify meaningful opportunities for loyalty partnerships.
  • Develop tailored loyalty propositions: Demonstrate how loyalty currencies, including airline miles and reward points, can help businesses attract new customers, increase spending, strengthen retention, and encourage repeat purchases.
  • Lead presentations and negotiations: Deliver compelling sales presentations, prepare customized proposals, address objections, negotiate commercial terms, and guide decision-makers toward confident purchasing decisions.
  • Maintain deal momentum: Establish clear next steps, engage relevant stakeholders, follow up consistently, and proactively address obstacles throughout the sales process to improve conversion rates and shorten sales cycles.
  • Manage pipeline and forecasting: Maintain accurate records in HubSpot, qualify opportunities objectively, track deal progression, and produce realistic forecasts based on customer engagement and demonstrated buying intent.
  • Leverage AI and sales technology: Use AI-powered tools to improve prospect research, meeting preparation, follow-up communications, and pipeline analysis while applying sound judgment to customer interactions and sales decisions.
  • Coordinate with internal teams: Work closely with Sales Development Representatives on qualified leads and provide Customer Success with structured handovers covering customer objectives, agreed deliverables, commercial commitments, and implementation expectations.
  • Contribute to sales strategy: Share insights on successful deals, common objections, customer needs, and conversion challenges to help refine sales messaging, improve the proposition, and strengthen the overall sales process.
  • Collaborate with sales leadership: Work directly with the Head of Partnerships on live opportunities, commercial strategies, performance improvement, and initiatives that support the growth of the sales team.

    • Requirements:

  • B2B sales experience: At least three years of relevant B2B sales experience, with a demonstrated track record of acquiring new customers and successfully closing commercial agreements.
  • Relevant industry background: Experience selling on the provider side of the loyalty, CRM, or marketing industry, such as within a loyalty technology company, software platform, agency, or specialist services provider.
  • Full-cycle sales ownership: Proven ability to manage opportunities independently from discovery and qualification through presentations, proposals, negotiations, and contract signature.
  • SME sales expertise: Experience selling to small and medium-sized businesses, managing multiple opportunities simultaneously, and adapting sales approaches to different customer needs and buying processes.
  • Commercial understanding of loyalty: Ability to explain loyalty programmes in straightforward business terms and connect proposed solutions to customer acquisition, retention, spending, and overall business economics.
  • Strong communication skills: Excellent presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities, with the confidence to engage business stakeholders and communicate complex propositions clearly.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both German and English, with the ability to conduct sales conversations, deliver presentations, and negotiate effectively in both languages.
  • CRM and pipeline discipline: Practical experience using CRM platforms, ideally HubSpot, with strong habits around opportunity qualification, record keeping, follow-up, and forecasting.
  • AI tool proficiency: Confidence using AI tools in daily sales activities, including research, preparation, communication, and pipeline analysis, while maintaining accuracy and a personal approach.
  • Ownership and resilience: A proactive, persistent, and commercially motivated mindset, with the ability to maintain deal momentum, navigate objections, and take responsibility for results.
  • Learning and collaboration: Openness to coaching, a willingness to share knowledge, and a team-oriented approach to improving sales performance and contributing to shared goals.
  • Remote working readiness: Ability to work independently in an international remote environment and maintain reliable availability during shared Central European Time (CET) business hours.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: A monthly compensation range of €5,000–€10,000, with a base salary and performance-based variable compensation.
  • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, subject to the role's working-hour requirements and applicable employment arrangements.
  • Work-life balance: A standard 40-hour working week and 24 days of annual leave.
  • Direct leadership access: Collaborate closely with sales leadership on active opportunities, commercial strategy, and professional development.
  • Clear role ownership: Benefit from qualified leads generated by Sales Development Representatives, with dedicated responsibility for closing deals and a structured handover to Customer Success.
  • Professional growth: Help shape sales processes, test new approaches, and contribute ideas as the partnership business expands.
  • International team environment: Work with a collaborative, ambitious team that values initiative, knowledge sharing, mutual support, and celebrating commercial wins.
  • AI-enabled sales environment: Use modern tools to streamline workflows, improve productivity, and strengthen sales execution.
  • Meaningful commercial impact: Help businesses unlock new customer acquisition and retention opportunities through innovative loyalty partnerships.

title: Account Payment Manager
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Payment Manager based in Switzerland.

Join a growing international technology environment focused on innovative B2B solutions and payment services for global clients. In this role, you will support the onboarding of payment service providers, electronic money institutions, and banking partners, helping ensure smooth and reliable payment operations. You will coordinate documentation, manage partner communications, and track onboarding processes from initial application through account activation. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help resolve operational issues and maintain accurate, well-organized records. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys structured processes, takes ownership of responsibilities, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. You will also benefit from opportunities to develop your expertise, contribute to operational improvements, and grow within an ambitious international organization.


Accountabilities

  • Payment Partner Onboarding: Coordinate the onboarding of payment service providers (PSPs), electronic money institutions (EMIs), and banking partners, ensuring that all required steps are completed efficiently.

  • Documentation and Compliance Support: Prepare, collect, review, and submit applications, questionnaires, and Know Your Business (KYB) documentation in line with partner requirements.

  • Partner Communication: Maintain regular communication with external partners, follow up on outstanding requests, clarify requirements, and ensure timely progress throughout the onboarding process.

  • Process Tracking: Monitor onboarding statuses, maintain visibility over deadlines and outstanding actions, and proactively address potential delays or bottlenecks.

  • Documentation Management: Maintain accurate, structured, and up-to-date records of onboarding activities, partner information, applications, and supporting documents.

  • Daily Payment Operations: Support routine payment operations and help ensure that payment accounts and related services function smoothly.

  • Operational Issue Resolution: Identify, investigate, and coordinate the resolution of operational issues, escalating complex matters when necessary.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to coordinate requirements, resolve dependencies, and facilitate the successful activation of payment accounts and services.

  • Process Improvement: Contribute to more efficient workflows by maintaining consistent procedures, improving task organization, and identifying opportunities to reduce unnecessary manual work.

    • Requirements

    • At least one year of experience in a similar role or a related operational position.

    • Intermediate English proficiency, with the ability to communicate effectively with international partners and handle professional documentation.

    • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or financial operations is an advantage but not essential.

    • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow several processes simultaneously.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a structured, process-oriented approach to documentation and administrative work.

    • A high level of responsibility, reliability, and consistency when handling important operational tasks.

    • The ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and follow through on assignments without constant supervision.

title: Activation Specialist (London)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the Team

The Customer Experience team helps customers adopt LangSmith and turn early momentum into lasting product usage. The team partners closely with GTM, Product, Engineering, and LangChain specialists to guide customers through onboarding, production readiness, and the practices required to build reliable AI applications.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Activation Specialist to join the Customer Experience team. In this role, you’ll work with new customers during their first weeks on LangSmith, helping them move from signed contract to a working platform that is ready for agents in production. You’ll focus on activation milestones such as admin setup, user onboarding, traces flowing, evaluations in place, and customer teams feeling confident enough to keep building independently.

What You’ll Do

  • Own customer onboarding from kickoff through early activation milestones, including admin setup, SDK integration, first traced run, first evaluation, and LangGraph deployment.

  • Guide customers through core LangSmith setup and production readiness topics, including security, org design, workload isolation, and integration questions.

  • Partner with GTM teams, Product, Engineering, and LangChain specialists to unblock customers and coordinate support when deeper expertise is needed.

  • Help customers build their first evaluation workflows, define what “good” looks like, and confirm they can debug a production trace independently.

  • Route customers to the right resources and turn recurring onboarding questions into runbooks, documentation, and repeatable processes.

  • Surface customer friction to Product and Engineering early and track activation metrics such as time to first trace, first evaluation, and production run.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in a customer-facing role such as support, customer success, account management, onboarding, or a similar function.

  • A strong desire to work directly with customers and build productive, trusted relationships.

  • Excellent organization and follow-through, with a track record of keeping customers and internal partners aligned.

  • A proactive, industrious approach to learning new tools, solving problems, and rolling up your sleeves.

  • Clear, friendly written and verbal communication skills.

  • Curiosity about technology and AI, plus a willingness to get hands-on and learn technical concepts on the job.

Nice to Have’s

  • Customer onboarding experience at a SaaS company.

  • Familiarity with enterprise readiness concepts such as SSO, SCIM, ABAC, and workload isolation.

  • Exposure to developer tools, observability, evaluations, or AI/LLM workflows.

  • Familiarity with analytics, BI tools or SQL.

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents for healthcare providers: they answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, and handle confirmations and reminders, so medical teams can focus on care. Following our $25M Series A, we are a team of 50+ across Paris and New York, working with around 240 healthcare organizations (imaging, ophthalmology, dental and more) across 700+ sites.

Today, Vocca signs faster than it deploys: more than 200 deals signed since June, and 41 days on average between signature and go-live on a standalone account. Our goal is to cut that in half and bring 11 to 12 new accounts live every week. The Deployment team owns this: kick-off, configuration, telephony, training, go-live, then handover to Account Management at day 30.

You join the Deployment team, within Operations, as AI Deployment Strategist Intern. Our interns own real accounts within weeks: this internship is close to the full-time role, with the same bar.

Your mission

Bring your clients live, fast and right the first time. You run deployments on your own accounts from kick-off to go-live, with the team's targets: kick-off to go-live in 7 days or less, and no rework after go-live. Then you help us deploy faster: every friction you meet becomes a better process, guide or tool.

Expected outcomes

After 1 month:

  • You master the product, its configuration options and our tools (Attio, our configuration server, telephony, Doctolib)

  • You have shadowed deployments on our main client types and co-run your first kick-offs

  • You run a guided deployment end to end on your own, from kick-off to go-live

After 3 months:

  • You own your portfolio of accounts, from kick-off to day-30 handover

  • 5 to 15 onboardings run, with configurations right the first time

  • A first process or support documented and adopted by the team (e.g. a telephony guide, a piece of the client kit)

  • Client feedback turned into concrete proposals for Product and Tech

At the end of your internship (6 months):

  • You are the trusted go-to person for your accounts, for clients and internal teams

  • You deploy at the team's pace on your segment

  • A visible contribution to the product: some of your proposals shipped with Tech

What you'll own

Deploy your accounts end to end

  • Prepare each kick-off: pre-configuration of agendas, appointment types and knowledge base, internal tests

  • Run the one-hour kick-off with the client: frame the project, validate the configuration, agree on the go-live date

  • Coordinate telephony with the client and their provider, train the front desk, run the go-live

  • Follow up at day 7 and day 30, then hand the account over to Account Management

Manage client projects

  • Scope, plan and follow up each project, with dated next steps

  • Solve client-specific challenges with creativity: multi-site centers, complex telephony, specific workflows

  • Support a Deployment Strategist on larger accounts: groups, networks of centers, pilots then roll-outs

Make deployment faster

  • Spot friction in our workflows and simplify them

  • Build the supports that let clients move on their own: guides, telephony documents, videos

  • Keep Attio up to date so the team steers on facts

Close the product loop

  • Structure client feedback and bring it to Product and Tech

  • Work across Sales, Product, Tech and Account Management

This role is for you if

Must have:

  • You are looking for a 6-month end-of-study internship, under an internship agreement (convention de stage)

  • Perfect French: you will work every day with French medical teams

  • A first client-facing or project experience (internship, consulting, association, student job) where you delivered something end to end

  • You are at ease with tools and configuration: you test, debug and learn a new tool fast. No technical degree required.

What we'll assess:

  • Deployment method: you structure a project, from pilot to roll-out, and anticipate what can block it

  • Client presence: you lead a meeting with a center director as easily as you talk to an engineer

  • Rigor and ownership: you prioritize by impact, close your loops, and nothing stays stuck

  • Simplifying: you fix the process, not only the case in front of you

Nice to have:

title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
descriptionHtml:
The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us.

Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten.

HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak.


We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them.

We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems.

The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact.

What you will actually do:

You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before.

The kind of work you could be on in your first months:

  • Agentic Commerce: making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat.

  • AI Design Studio: letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence.

  • AI-first customer service: replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end.

  • Internal agent swarms: automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours.

  • Whatever you spot next: if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it.

We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week.


Who you are:

  • You are a builder before anything else. You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age.

  • You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better.

  • You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out.

  • You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks.

You will probably recognise yourself in most of this:

  • You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest.

  • You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it.

  • You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees.

  • You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly.

  • You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud.


What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that.

What you get:

The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else, because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change.


A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship.

  • Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you.

  • Ownership from day one: your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs.

  • The best tools, no budget debates: the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using.

  • A growth path that follows your output, not your age: if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you.

  • A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar.

  • Flexible set-up: full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver.

Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent.

How to apply:

Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built.

Send us three things:

  1. Your best project: a link to something you built: a live product, a repo, a demo video. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you would do differently now.

  2. Something you think is broken: one thing about HelloPrint (our website, our ordering flow, anything) that you would rebuild with AI, and how you would do it.

  3. A short intro: who you are and what you are obsessed with right now. Five sentences is plenty.

What happens next:

  1. We read every application ourselves and reply within 5 days if you’re up to the next round

  2. A 15-minute call with one of our builders or founders about your projects.

  3. A Builders Day in our office: Together with other builders, you meet the team and if we have a click, you work on an assignment

  4. A conversation with the founders, and a decision the same day.

We would rather hear from you too early than too late. If you are not sure you are ready, apply anyway; your work will answer that question for us. At HelloPrint, we believe diversity makes us better. We're building a workplace where everyone can be themselves, grow, and do their best work regardless of background, identity, or perspective. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Switzerland.

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations.


Accountabilities

You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools.

  • Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning.

  • Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls.

  • Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data.

  • Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV.

  • Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams.

  • Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis.

  • Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories.

  • Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries.

  • Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails.

  • Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping.

  • Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces.

  • Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hands-on AI engineer with experience taking complex systems from initial development to production, particularly in environments involving physical-world data and industrial operations.

    • At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred.

    • Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight.

    • Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one.

    • Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems.

    • Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems.

    • Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data.

    • Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments.

    • Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes.

    • Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems.

    • Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript.

    • Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV.

    • A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction.

    • Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment.

    • Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to help build a category-defining industrial operating system with the potential to shape manufacturing plants and industrial facilities over the next 10–20 years.

      • Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one.

      • Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team with backgrounds in enterprise technology, industrial robotics, autonomous driving, and academic research.

      • Exposure to complex, real-world industrial challenges and large volumes of underutilized sensor data.

      • Direct impact on operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, industrial reliability, and decision-making across major industries.

      • Opportunity to contribute to a zero-to-one product in an ambitious, innovation-driven environment.
