descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

  • Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

  • Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

  • Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.


  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

  • Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

  • A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

  • Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

  • Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

  • Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

  • Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
descriptionHtml:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques.

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...

  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos du poste

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Les missions :

  • Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

  • Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS).

  • Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.

  • Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.

  • Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.

  • Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.

  • Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).

  • S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.

  • Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
  • Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
  • Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
  • Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
  • Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
  • Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
  • Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA

Un plus

  • Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)
  • Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD
  • Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini),
  • Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions
  • Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent
  • Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks

▪️ L'ancrage Toulousain

L'agence SFEIR Toulouse regroupe une équipe à taille humaine de plus de 10 expert·e·s de haut niveau. Tu y bénéficies de la proximité et de l'agilité d'une structure locale, tout en adossant tes projets à la solidité financière et technique d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à la vie de la scène tech locale (DevFest Toulouse, SFEIR Talks, afterworks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D et l'intégration des LLMs au niveau régional.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Toulouse.
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

SFEIR collecte vos données à caractère personnel afin de traiter votre candidature. Pour en savoir plus sur la gestion de vos données personnelles et pour exercer vos droits, nous vous invitons à consulter notre Politique de confidentialité.

title: AI Solutions Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case. Increasingly, that first-draft build work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI agents can generate workflow configurations, draft integration mappings, and produce the initial pass on a customer's setup.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every workflow yourself, you specify exactly what needs to exist, direct AI to build it, and apply the judgment AI can't: is this the right configuration for this customer's approval policy, will Legal and Finance actually sign off on it, does it hold up once real spend starts flowing through it. In practice, that might mean catching that the approval chain AI just drafted works perfectly for HQ, but misses a regional delegation-of-authority rule that would fail an audit in the customer's APAC entity.

As Omnea's AI Solutions Lead, you own deployment of the Omnea platform end to end - typically running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently - for some of Europe's most recognisable companies. You advise customers on the best-fit configuration, direct AI-assisted build work to get there fast, and validate every output against what the customer actually needs. You'll also deal with the politics that come with every enterprise rollout: the Legal team wanting one more sign-off, the Finance stakeholder who doesn't trust the new approval flow, the exec sponsor who's gone quiet. You become the internal voice of the customer, and you're judged on outcomes you can point to: time to launch, post-go-live CSAT, and whether that customer becomes a case study or reference.

This is an early hire on Omnea's customer team, working directly with our sales, customer, product, and engineering leadership. The future shape of the role is yours to define!

What You'll Do

Discover and design

  • Run discovery with customer stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT, and translate their process into an Omnea configuration

  • Design the target workflow: approval chains, routing logic, integrations, and the edge cases that make procurement hard

  • On a deployment with a dozen-plus integrations, you own the sequencing - what has to land first, what blocks what - and the harder calls underneath it: which system is the source of truth for a given entity, and how records reconcile when two systems key that entity differently

  • Define success criteria and a realistic path to go-live with the customer's project sponsor

Build with AI, not instead of it

  • You're not just directing AI to draft your own deliverables faster - you're configuring the specialized agents Omnea's customers rely on every day: an intake agent that knows how to ask a procurement analyst the right follow-up question, a risk agent that flags what actually matters to this customer's Legal team

  • The real leverage comes from chaining agents together - an intake agent that hands clean, structured requests to a risk agent, which in turn routes into approvals with the right context already attached. You design how those agents work as a system, not just individually

  • Writing a spec for one agent is a skill. Writing one that holds up across a chain of agents - where one agent's output becomes another's input - is the actual bar here

  • Validate every AI-generated output against the customer's actual process, policy, and edge cases before anything ships

  • Handle what AI can't: judgment calls on ambiguous requirements, custom logic, and anything that needs a human read on internal politics

Deploy and prove value

  • Present configured workflows to stakeholders, from procurement analysts to CFOs, working through the pushback and internal politics that come with any enterprise rollout, and win their buy-in

  • Run multi-day onsite workshops with customers, coordinating dozens of stakeholders across multiple workstreams at once - a different muscle than a single stakeholder meeting

  • Project-manage the deployment: timelines, blockers, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to launch, acting as an extension of the customer's team

  • Track adoption after go-live and keep the configuration working as the customer's process evolves

  • Work with Product and Engineering during the design phase, not just after something breaks in the field - you're often the earliest signal on whether a new module will hold up for an enterprise customer, and that shapes what gets built next

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time specifying and validating than building from scratch. AI produces the first draft; you make sure it's right for this customer

  • Writing instructions AI can act on precisely is a skill you'll build fast here. Vague requests produce vague configurations

  • Judgment matters more, not less. AI speeds up the build, but you decide whether the output is right for this contract, this Board, this customer

  • You'll keep experimenting as our AI tooling evolves, and share what works with the rest of the team

About You

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're ambitious and hard-working, as comfortable directing an AI agent through a tricky configuration as you are presenting a project plan to an exec. You make up for any gap in experience with hunger and a genuine growth mindset. You derive energy from building relationships, shipping projects, and making customers succeed.

  • 4-8 years in a fast-paced, high-bar environment: a startup, scale-up, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

    • Less experience? Check out our Solutions Associate role

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft work, and confident enough in your own judgment to catch what's wrong. Prior use of tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor is a strong plus. What matters most is your ability to write clear, specific instructions and evaluate what comes back

  • Client-facing experience, or the natural gravitas to be excellent at it. You can point to a time you went well beyond what a client expected

  • A track record of doing something exceptionally well, whether that's work, academia, sport, or anything else you've put your mind to

  • Comfortable reasoning about system architecture - how data models, primary keys, and integration sequencing interact across a dozen enterprise systems. You don't need to write the integration code, but you need to know why it breaks and be able to reason with the people who do, and you'll need to become an Omnea product expert

  • You build real relationships with people at any level, from a junior procurement analyst to a CFO, and know how to handle pushback and stakeholder politics, not just build rapport

  • Comfortable running rooms of stakeholders across a genuinely cross-functional tool - on a single project you'll interface with the CPO, Legal, Finance, AP, InfoSec, and Compliance, plus each of their technical resources, often all with competing priorities on the same decision

  • Comfortable moving between the detail and the big picture: configuring a workflow in the morning, presenting a project plan to an exec in the afternoon

  • Entrepreneurial, have high ownership, and want to be part of building something. We've signed up to the Future Founder Promise

  • An excellent communicator: clear and concise, verbal and written, even when the subject is complicated

  • Highly organised: comfortable running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently, each at a different stage, without dropping any of them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: AI Tutor/Lehrkraft (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
AI Tutor/Lehrkraft (all genders)

Du brennst für GenAI und Large Language Models und möchtest Dein Wissen nicht nur anwenden, sondern auch weitergeben? Als KI Tutor/Lehrkraft begleitest Du unsere Teilnehmenden fachlich und didaktisch auf ihrem Weg zu praxisnahen KI-Kompetenzen: Du beantwortest ihre Fragen rund um GenAI, LLMs und verantwortungsvollen KI-Einsatz, unterstützt sie in Übungen und Projekten und sorgst dafür, dass sie KI-Tools am Ende nicht nur verstehen, sondern sicher und reflektiert in ihrem Arbeitsalltag einsetzen können.

Du bewertest Lernfortschritte, führst Abschlussprüfungen durch und gibst strukturiertes, konstruktives Feedback. Durch den engen Kontakt zu den Lernenden trägst Du außerdem aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Trainingsprogramme bei – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Coaching Team Lead, dem Learning Team und weiteren Schnittstellen.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Fachliche Beantwortung von Fragen der Lernenden (schriftlich und mündlich)

  • Vermittlung und Vertiefung von Trainingsinhalten in Live-Sessions, Webinaren, Classrooms und individueller Lernbegleitung

  • Begleitung bei Unsicherheiten im Lernprozess sowie in Übungen und Projekten

  • Durchführung und Bewertung von Abschlussprüfungen sowie Entscheidung über den Trainingserfolg

  • Erstellung, Aufbereitung und Weiterentwicklung von Lernmaterialien rund um praktische GenAI/LLM-Fähigkeiten, grundlegende KI/ML-Kompetenz und verantwortungsvollen, ethischen KI-Einsatz

  • Qualitätssicherung bestehender Trainings inkl. Feedback ans Learning-Team

  • Durchführung individueller Coaching-Sessions und Unterstützung neuer Teammitglieder

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem quantitativen, analytischen oder technischen Fachbereich

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner KI-Konzepte – insbesondere GenAI mit Fokus auf LLMs, inkl. Grundverständnis von Trainingsdaten, Modellen, Evaluierung und typischen KI-Limitierungen (Machine Learning und Deep Learning sind ein Plus)

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung von LLMs (z. B. Prompt-Engineering, Workflow-Integration, Agenten) sowie mit No-/Low-Code-KI-Tools

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit (einfachen) API-Clients (z. B. Postman, curl); gute Python-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit SQL, Power BI oder Excel sind von Vorteil

  • Bewusstsein für ethische, rechtliche und organisatorische Aspekte von KI-Anwendungen sowie Interesse an aktuellen Entwicklungen im KI-Sektor

  • Didaktische Erfahrung in der Vermittlung technischer oder fachlicher Inhalte an nicht-technische Zielgruppen sowie Verständnis für Konzepte der Erwachsenenbildung und Online-Weiterbildung

  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung, Empathie, klare Kommunikation und konstruktive Feedbackkultur

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Teamgeist, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.


Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: Alternant(e) en Cybersécurité H/F
descriptionHtml:
Lieu : Fontenay-sous-Bois (94)
Type de contrat : Contrat d’apprentissage – 24 mois
Temps de travail : 35 h/semaine
Rémunération : selon l’âge et l’année de contrat (grille légale de l’apprentissage)
Début : dès que possible

Protégez un système d’information réel et préparez un titre Bac+5 en cybersécurité reconnu par l’État, gratuitement et en étant payé(e).

Qui sommes-nous ?
KAISCHOOL est une école supérieure spécialisée en Intelligence Artificielle, Data, Cybersécurité et Commerce IT. Elle forme du Bac+3 au Bac+5 en alternance, en mode hybride. Pour renforcer la sécurité de son système d’information, KAISCHOOL recrute un(e) alternant(e) Analyste Cybersécurité. Vous protégerez nos données, nos utilisateurs et nos outils numériques tout en préparant votre diplôme dans notre école.

Votre formation : Mastère Cyber – Expert en renseignement et investigation sur les cybermenaces
Il s’agit d’un titre Bac+5 de niveau 7 enregistré au RNCP. La formation part de la menace réelle : vous apprenez les méthodes des attaquants pour construire des défenses efficaces. Elle couvre toute la chaîne de la cybersécurité, de l’analyse des risques jusqu’au renseignement sur les menaces et à l’investigation numérique avancée.

Blocs de compétences :

  1. Analyser les menaces et les vulnérabilités des systèmes d’information.

  2. Détecter les incidents de sécurité et mener l’investigation numérique.

  3. Piloter la sécurité et la conformité réglementaire de l’organisation (RGPD, NIS2).

  4. Conduire des opérations de renseignement sur les cybermenaces (CTI).

Vous apprendrez à :

  • repérer les vulnérabilités et modéliser les menaces pour savoir quoi sécuriser en priorité ;

  • superviser les flux de sécurité et coordonner la réponse aux incidents et aux crises ;

  • analyser des postes et des logiciels malveillants (forensic, malware) pour comprendre une attaque ;

  • collecter et exploiter du renseignement sur les menaces (OSINT, MISP) ;

  • appliquer les exigences réglementaires et les normes au sein d’une organisation.

Outils et référentiels : MITRE ATT&CK, EBIOS RM, Splunk, Wireshark, OpenCTI, MISP.

Les + de KAISCHOOL :

  • formation 100 % gratuite pour vous, financée par l’OPCO, et salaire versé pendant toute l’alternance ;

  • pédagogie hybride : cours sur place à Fontenay-sous-Bois et plateforme en ligne avec replays 24h/24 ;

  • 15 projets concrets par étudiant, sur de vrais outils cyber ;

  • école certifiée Qualiopi ;

  • 95 % d’insertion à 6 mois (promotion 2024, donnée déclarative de l’école).

Vos missions :

  • surveiller les événements de sécurité du système d’information ;

  • repérer et analyser les vulnérabilités et les risques ;

  • participer au traitement et au suivi des incidents de sécurité ;

  • contrôler la sécurité des postes, des applications et des outils (Microsoft 365, plateforme e-learning, CRM…) ;

  • participer à la gestion des accès et des habilitations des utilisateurs ;

  • contribuer à la mise en conformité RGPD et à la protection des données des étudiants et des partenaires ;

  • rédiger des procédures, des comptes rendus et des rapports de sécurité ;

  • sensibiliser les équipes aux bonnes pratiques (phishing, mots de passe, MFA) ;

  • suivre l’actualité des menaces et des vulnérabilités.

Profil recherché :

  • vous avez un Bac+3 (titre de niveau 6) en informatique, systèmes et réseaux, cybersécurité, mathématiques appliquées, MIAGE ou ingénierie logicielle ;

  • vous pouvez aussi postuler sans Bac+3 si vous avez 2 ans d’expérience en informatique, ou 1 an si vous êtes spécialisé(e) en systèmes et réseaux ;

  • vous connaissez les bases des réseaux (TCP/IP), des systèmes (Windows, Linux) et de la sécurité informatique ;

title: Analyste en investigation numérique judiciaire H/F
descriptionHtml:

Vous aimez enquêter, comprendre, relier des faits et révéler la vérité à partir de données numériques ?

Nous recrutons un·e analyste en investigation numérique pour renforcer notre équipe et intervenir sur des dossiers sensibles confiés par les autorités judiciaires.

Qui sommes-nous ?

LE LERTI est un laboratoire privé spécialisé dans l’analyse de données numériques dans un cadre judiciaire, et reconnu au niveau national.

Nous intervenons en qualité d’experts judiciaires, principalement sur des affaires pénales complexes, pour le compte de juges d’instruction et de forces de l’ordre.

Notre mission : extraire, analyser, comprendre et contextualiser des éléments numériques susceptibles de constituer des preuves dans le cadre d’enquêtes et de procédures pénales.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire (analystes, informaticiens, juristes…), vous analysez des données issues de supports numériques (smartphones, ordinateurs, supports de stockage, etc.) afin d’en extraire des informations pertinentes pour une instruction ou un procès pénal.

Vos responsabilités principales :

Analyse et investigation

  • Comprendre les enjeux judiciaires d’un dossier et identifier les axes d’investigation
  • Analyser, croiser et interpréter des données numériques parfois volumineuses et complexes

Rédaction et communication

Interaction avec les parties prenantes

Veille, amélioration et transmission

  • Participer à l’évolution des outils, méthodes et processus internes

Vos compétences

Compétences clés

  • Maîtrise des environnements Windows et des outils bureautiques

Profil recherché

  • Formation supérieure en sciences humaines, sociales, ou expérience significative en environnement judiciaire (police, gendarmerie, justice…)
  • Esprit d’analyse, rigueur, méthode et autonomie

title: Analytics Manager
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

835 - Manager, Client Analytics - DTA

About WPP Media 

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. 

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com 

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: 

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 

About Choreograph: A Leading WPP Media Brand 

Choreograph is WPP’s global data products and technology company. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation. 

We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising. 

We’re endlessly curious. Our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world. 

Role Summary and Impact   

The Manager, Client Analytics reports to the Director of Analytics, working to design, customize and maintain platforms for business analytics and measurement. You would have excellent oral and written communication skills, be client obsessed, self-motivated and able to operate both as a team and independently with limited guidance and direction

The Manager, Client Analytics is following the direction of Director of Analytics and is responsible for data manipulation and visualization, performing quantitative data analysis, problem solving, statistical modeling, and developing/analysing business cases.

WHAT YOU WILL DO   

  • Apply deep knowledge of basic statistics (significance testing, correlation analysis, confidence intervals, descriptive statistics) to support analytical solutions.
  • Use statistical modeling techniques (regression, classification) to extract business value from campaign data.
  • Utilize programming languages (Python, R, SQL), statistical packages (SciPy), and Google tools (BigQuery, Tensorflow, Datalab) to prototype and deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Recommend and develop technical solutions with guidance from senior leadership.
  • Define project scope, setup, and effort estimation in collaboration with the account Analytics lead.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Analytics leads and gain a deep understanding of client challenges.
  • Work closely with key stakeholders to assess project needs and ensure delivery of best-in-class analytics work.
  • Collaborate with regional leadership on process development, improvement, and compliance.
  • Support campaign measurement, determine incremental lift from marketing activities, and manage reporting and data needs (ingestion, cleaning, delivery).
  • Code in SQL and Python to create reports and build dashboards; automate recurring workloads to improve efficiency.
  • Generate meaningful insights using advanced analytics/statistical techniques; create dashboards and presentations for wider teams.
  • Ensure continuous collaboration and progression across bands, disciplines, and offices.

Skills and Experience  

  • Relevant industry experience in analytics-focused roles.
  • Degree in an applied quantitative field (data science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, economics, business management, computer science, or related).
  • Understanding of marketing campaigns, objectives, and measurement techniques; prior experience in digital agency or consulting preferred.
  • Proficient coding skills in statistical software (R, Python, SciPy), programming languages (SQL, Python), and MS Office tools (especially advanced Excel/Google Sheets).
  • Experience in owning and delivering analytics projects, including correlation, regression, significance testing, A/B tests, and supervised machine learning.
  • Practical understanding of data science techniques, statistical analysis, and modeling.
  • Passion for data analysis, troubleshooting data anomalies, integrating data from multiple sources to create repositories for data science models.
  • Ability to transform raw data into actionable business insights for decision-making and strategic planning.
  • Strong logical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Adherence to quality standards and ability to plan and prioritize work.
  • Experience using or building reports with business intelligence tools is a plus.
  • Experience in applying big data, statistics, and analytical techniques to solve client problems is preferred.
  • Business acumen to provide actionable strategic recommendations is preferred

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.   

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 
 
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Android-Entwickler als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Entwickle Android-Software, die Menschen in Bewegung bringt

Du möchtest Android-Apps entwickeln und sehen, wie dein Code in einem echten Produkt zum Einsatz kommt? Bei AUGLETICS entwickelst du Software für smarte Rudergeräte und unsere App. Du kannst neue Funktionen direkt ausprobieren und gemeinsam mit dem Team verbessern – vom ersten Prototyp bis zur zuverlässigen Anwendung.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Unser Unternehmen hat rund 25 Mitarbeitende; im Softwareteam arbeitest du mit vier bis fünf Personen und direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Wir haben viele Ideen und suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, gerne programmiert und Wert auf gute Ergebnisse legt.

Das entwickelst du bei uns

  • Android-Funktionen für Gerät und App: Du entwickelst neue Features, verbesserst bestehende Abläufe und arbeitest an einer verständlichen, zuverlässigen Bedienung.

  • Das Zusammenspiel im Blick: Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zwischen App, Gerätesoftware und Backend und hilfst, Datenflüsse und Fehlerfälle sauber zu lösen.

  • Ideen praktisch erproben: Du setzt Prototypen um, probierst sie am Rudergerät aus und entwickelst gute Ansätze mit dem Team weiter.

  • Qualität von Anfang an: Du schreibst nachvollziehbaren Code, beteiligst dich an Reviews und Tests und behebst Fehler nachhaltig.

  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge für Ideen, Code, Tests und Fehleranalyse. Du verstehst und prüfst die Ergebnisse, bevor sie ins Produkt gelangen.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Programmiergrundlagen und Lust auf native Android-Entwicklung mit Kotlin oder Java. Praktische Android-Erfahrung ist willkommen; wenn du dich neu in Android einarbeitest, interessieren uns dein bisheriger Lernweg und deine Motivation.

  • Du kannst erklären, wie du technische Aufgaben angehst. Eigene Apps, Lernprojekte, Hochschulprojekte, Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen genauso wie berufliche Erfahrung.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis von Programmiergrundlagen und Interesse daran, verständliche, wartbare und getestete Software zu entwickeln.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte App-Entwicklung. Wenn du solche Werkzeuge bereits ausprobiert hast, interessiert uns, was gut funktioniert hat und wie du die Ergebnisse geprüft hast.

  • Eigeninitiative, Freude an Zusammenarbeit und Lust, dich in ein bestehendes Produkt einzuarbeiten und schrittweise Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist für den technischen Austausch im Team erforderlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig in Königs Wusterhausen vor Ort zu arbeiten, um Funktionen am Gerät zu entwickeln und mit dem Team abzustimmen.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps, zum Beispiel bei Benutzeranmeldung, Datenspeicherung oder serverseitiger Logik.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Kenntnisse in Git, automatisierten Tests, CI/CD oder der Anbindung von APIs und Geräten.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du direkt ausprobieren kannst, und sichtbaren Einfluss auf das Training unserer Kunden.

  • Ein kleines Softwareteam, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde und kurze Wege zwischen Idee, Entwicklung und Test.

  • Raum für eigene Ideen und fachliche Entwicklung – mit Aufgaben, die zu deinem Erfahrungsstand passen und mit dir wachsen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein GitHub-Link oder eine App ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. You will develop Android software for our connected rowing machines and app, working closely with our CTO and a small team. Early-career developers with practical projects are welcome. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward engineers to be part of our early team at Resonance. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll build the production AI systems behind Resonance’s client engagements, driving a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier alongside Senior AI Engineers, owning features, integrations and evals end to end. You’ll build and ship agentic systems, from agents and MCP servers into client systems to retrieval and the product around them, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll build evals and observability from day one, take features from first prototype to production, and deploy and extend what we build inside client environments, shipping at pace with the latest AI coding tools. You’ll grow with the firm by contributing to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning what you learn on each build into reusable components, and taking on more ownership as you grow.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have up to four years building software at a startup, a scale-up, a fast-moving product team or your own company. You write production Python or TypeScript, have shipped software with an LLM at its core, at work or on your own projects, and have iterated on prompts, agent loops and evals. You’re at home with messy real-world data, APIs and SQL, you ship fast without cutting corners, and you enjoy solving problems with technical and non-technical people. You have consistently been among the top performers in high-performing environments, at university or at work. Forward deployed experience, AI side projects or a company you founded are a plus.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Most engineers get one shot at a startup. Here you build many products, not one: our own AI products and platform, and several production AI systems a year across industries. You’ll learn fast alongside people who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, with scope that grows as fast as your impact. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm. As one of our early joiners, you’ll shape how we build, operate and grow.

Logistics: London, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in the UK and Europe. English is our working language. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV, your GitHub profile and a short note on the AI system you're proudest of shipping and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Applied Science - Time Series
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job

Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on time series. You will design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art time-series foundation models, and apply them to the most demanding forecasting problems in industry, from power grids and plants to trading desks.

Timestral, our family of time-series foundation models, ranked first on amongst all benchmarks at release (tech report). The role has two sides: building the next generations of Timestral with our Science team, and taking them into production with our industrial and financial clients, adapted to their data. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry.

What you will do

  • Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art time-series foundation models on clusters with thousands of GPUs.

  • Generate and curate large-scale time-series datasets, real and synthetic, and build evaluators and benchmarks for forecasting and other time-series tasks.

  • Push the frontier of Timestral: architectures, training recipes, scaling, and new capabilities such as anomaly detection, classification and embeddings.

  • Fine-tune and adapt Timestral on client data, in the cloud or on-premise, and benchmark it against the client's existing models.

  • Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases, including agents that combine Timestral with Mistral LLMs.

  • Manage research projects and communications with client research teams.

About you

  • Fluent in English with excellent communication skills, at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Expert with PyTorch or JAX.

  • Solid knowledge of modern deep learning and large language models: architectures, pre-training, post-training and evaluation.

  • Experience pre-training or fine-tuning time-series foundation models or large transformer models at scale.

  • Strong background in time-series modelling: probabilistic forecasting, multivariate series and covariates, and classical baselines (statistical models, gradient boosting).

  • Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance.

  • Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code.

  • Doesn't need roadmaps: moves independently and is comfortable with uncertainty.

  • Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn.

  • Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia.

Nice to have

  • Ex-founder or builder

  • PhD / Master in a relevant field (Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics). Exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome.

  • Research on time-series foundation models: pre-training, scaling, synthetic data or evaluation.

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning LLMs, building agents and tool use, or models that combine text and time series.

  • Industry experience in energy, industrial operations, telecom or finance, or experience deploying models for industrial clients.

  • Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale.

  • Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase.

  • Publications in top academic journals or conferences.

  • Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.

title: Automation & Industrialization Director
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Harmattan AI is moving from rapid product development and early serial production into high-volume industrial scale-up. Products, production volumes and manufacturing sites are evolving simultaneously.

The next phase requires a Senior Automation & Industrialisation Director who can translate engineering designs and volume requirements into robust, scalable and where justified increasingly automated production systems, while providing strong technical leadership to a diversely skilled team.

The objective is to strengthen both Harmattan AI's industrialisation capability and the technical maturity of the team, enabling the organisation to scale from today's manual and semi-automated processes toward significantly higher volumes and international manufacturing.

 

Responsibilities

The role will own the Automation & Industrialisation roadmap, including:

  • Industrialisation of new products from prototype through stable serial production.

  • DFM/DFA and Design for Automation with Engineering.

  • Production process and line architecture.

  • Workstations, tooling, fixtures, test equipment and semi-automated production systems.

  • Automation concepts, specifications, supplier selection, commissioning and ramp-up.

  • PFMEA, process validation and production-readiness activities.

  • Cycle-time, capacity, line balancing, yield and labour-content optimisation.

  • Identification of the correct automation level based on volume, maturity, quality, flexibility and ROI.

  • Standardisation and replication of production systems across Harmattan AI manufacturing sites.

  • Development of the manufacturing technology roadmap toward significantly higher production volumes.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • 15-20+ years of relevant industrial experience (ideally in aerospace, defence, advanced electronics, or mechatronics) and has personally taken complex electromechanical products from prototype into high-volume or rapidly scaling serial production

  • Ideally, combined experience from a highly developed industrial organisation with experience in a startup/scale-up, defence-tech, UAV, robotics or similarly fast-moving hardware environment.

  • Hands-on experience with semi-automated and automated assembly systems, PLC-controlled equipment (Siemens preferred), and industrial tooling.

  • Solid understanding of DFM/DFA, PFMEA, and lean manufacturing principles.

  • Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; embraces a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality. Willingness to travel and work flexible schedules (evenings/weekends as needed).

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals – from junior members to senior executives.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

  • Projekte ganzheitlich steuern: Sie übernehmen die Organisation und Abwicklung Ihrer Bauvorhaben – von der ersten Planung bis zur fertigen Übergabe.

  • Qualität und Termine sicherstellen: Sie überwachen den Projektfortschritt, lösen auftretende Herausforderungen und sorgen für reibungslose Abläufe.
  • Projekte erfolgreich abschließen: Sie begleiten Abnahmen und stellen eine strukturierte Übergabe sicher.

Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung als Bauleiter, Projektleiter oder in einer vergleichbaren verantwortlichen Funktion im Tiefbau

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems.

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting.

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market.

  • Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

title: Business Development Manager (New Business)
descriptionHtml:
About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

Our Rest of World New Business team launched in September and has been so successful that we are growing it. We are now looking for a Business Development Manager who loves winning new business and wants to build a pipeline across APAC, EMEA and the UK.

The role

You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through to negotiation and contract signature, selling subscription products on the Legal 500 platform to law firms of every size. Many of your leads will be warm, because firms already engage with our research process, but this is a hunter role: you will be on the phone, booking meetings, pitching and closing. You will speak with partners, senior lawyers, CMOs and marketing directors at some of the world's leading law firms, adapting your style to each market and audience.

The territory rotates through the year, giving you exposure to APAC, EMEA and the UK.

What you will do

  • Identify and target prospective law firm clients across the UK, APAC and EMEA.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline through calls, email, LinkedIn and face-to-face meetings.

  • Run compelling presentations and product demonstrations to senior decision makers.

  • Understand each firm's goals and align our subscription solutions to them.

  • Negotiate commercial terms and close deals to meet and exceed revenue targets.

  • Keep accurate CRM records and forecast your pipeline.

  • Share market intelligence with marketing, product and leadership, and work closely with customer success on handover.

What you will bring

  • At least 3 years of business development or new business sales experience, owning the full cycle from prospecting to close.

  • A track record of achieving or exceeding revenue targets.

  • Experience selling subscription, information, media, research or membership products, or other B2B sales to professional services firms.

  • Confidence engaging senior decision makers, including partners and C-suite.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Resilience, drive and a proactive approach to picking up the phone.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling into law firms or other professional services.

  • A second language at business level.

  • Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot or Dynamics.

Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente.

Pour signer un contrat avec une copropriété, il faut obtenir la majorité des votes des copropriétaires lors de l'Assemblée Générale annuelle (cycle de vente est long et complexe - 3 mois en moyenne).

Les missions au quotidien :

  • Gérer la relation avec les prospects :

  • Réaliser les démos avec les leads qualifiés par les SDR, et fixer clairement les prochaines étapes du cycle de vente,

  • Établir une relation de confiance avec les copropriétaires, les présidents et les membres du conseil syndical,

  • Convaincre de façon directe et indirecte la majorité de la copropriété,

  • Pitcher la solution lors des Assemblées Générales pour obtenir la signature du contrat et faire la passation avec le département Care

  • Analyser des leviers pour améliorer la conversion,

  • Faire remonter les retours des prospects / clients pour participer à l’amélioration du produit,

  • Nous aider dans l'organisation d’événements clients,

  • Participer à l'amélioration continue du discours et des process en interne.

Onboarding et montée en compétences :

  • Sur les 6 premiers mois : tu vas monter en compétences sur la qualification des leads, le pitch aux prospects inbound et outbound, les produits de Matera, l’accompagnement dans le changement de syndic pour tes clients, les techniques de vente et tu vas te familiariser avec le monde de la copropriété (droit et compta notamment).

title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.
