title: Kfz-Prüfingenieur mit Betrauung (m/w/d) – mit Perspektive zum Abteilungsleiter
descriptionHtml:
Beschreibung

Sie sind betrauter Kfz-Prüfingenieur und möchten nicht nur prüfen, sondern mittelfristig Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bieten wir Ihnen einen Weg, auf dem Sie in Ruhe in eine Führungsrolle hineinwachsen.

Wir sind die von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH. Wir betreiben eigene GTÜ-Prüfstellen in Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg und führen als Partner der GTÜ Gesellschaft für Technische Überwachung mbH amtliche Fahrzeuguntersuchungen durch.

Gut zu wissen: Wir arbeiten eng mit dem von Hebel Ingenieurbüro zusammen – einem etablierten Kfz-Sachverständigenbüro, das professionelle Unfall- und Haftpflichtgutachten für Privat- und Geschäftskunden erstellt. Für Sie bedeutet das: ein breites fachliches Umfeld über die Prüftätigkeit hinaus.

Warum wir jetzt suchen: Wir planen langfristig. Die Leitung unserer Prüfstellen und des ca. zehnköpfigen Teams soll in einigen Jahren in neue Hände übergehen – und wir möchten die Person dafür frühzeitig an Bord holen. Sie steigen zunächst als Prüfingenieur ein, lernen unser Team, unsere Standorte und Abläufe kennen und übernehmen dann Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Für die Einarbeitung nehmen wir uns bewusst Zeit.

Ihr Einsatzgebiet: Unsere Standorte Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg.

Ihr Weg in die Führungsposition

Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser, sondern ein geplanter Übergang in Ihrem Tempo:

  • Ankommen: Prüftätigkeit an unseren Standorten, Kennenlernen von Team, Kunden, Abläufen und der Zusammenarbeit mit der GTÜ
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: erste Aufgaben der fachlichen und organisatorischen Leitung, z. B. Qualitätssicherung, Einarbeitung neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen, fachliche Ansprechperson im Team
  • Übergabe: Stellvertretung der jetzigen Führungskraft und anschließend vollständige Übernahme der Position

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Von Beginn an:

  • Durchführung von Untersuchungen der periodischen Fahrzeugüberwachung (HU/SP)
  • Abgasuntersuchungen (AU)
  • Änderungsabnahmen nach §19(3) StVZO
  • Wenn bereits Qualifizierung vorliegt: Begutachtungen im Rahmen des Technischen Dienstes, z. B. für Sondereintragungen, Umbauten und Importfahrzeuge
  • Tätigkeit im Außen- und Innendienst

Schrittweise hinzukommen:

  • fachliche Qualitätssicherung und Einhaltung der amtlichen Vorgaben an allen Standorten
  • fachliche Anleitung, Einarbeitung und Schulung des Teams
  • Ansprechperson für die GTÜ, z. B. bei Audits und fachlichen Rückfragen
  • Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden: Großkunden, Fuhrparks, Werkstätten, Autohäuser oder Einzelkunden
  • Mitwirkung an Dienstplanung, Prüfausstattung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

  • Betrauung zum Kfz-Prüfingenieur – gern auch von einer anderen Überwachungsorganisation, den Wechsel zur GTÜ begleiten wir
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung
  • Interesse daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und ein Team fachlich zu führen
  • Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch
  • Freude am Umgang mit Kunden und Kollegen
  • Bereitschaft zum Einsatz an unseren Standorten

Was noch fehlt, bauen wir gemeinsam auf

Sie haben noch keine Führungserfahrung oder sehen bei sich selbst noch Entwicklungsbedarf? Kein Problem – genau dafür planen wir die lange Einarbeitung ein. Wir schauen gemeinsam, where Sie stehen, und entwickeln Sie gezielt weiter:

  • individueller Plan mit regelmäßigen Entwicklungsgesprächen
  • Weiterbildungen zu Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Konfliktmanagement
  • fachliche Weiterbildungen, z. B. zum Unterschriftsberechtigten des Technischen Dienstes oder zum Kfz-Sachverständigen (inkl. IfS-Zertifizierung)
  • In-House-Schulungen – keine Anreise nötig, flexible Terminplanung
  • Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen, die ihr Wissen gerne weitergeben

Leistungen der Anstellung

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung bei der von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH
  • Grundgehalt ab 4.000 €/Monat (Vollzeit) – je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation mehr; mit wachsender Verantwortung entwickelt sich selbstverständlich auch Ihr Gehalt weiter
  • Eine langfristige Perspektive mit klarer Entwicklung zur Führungsposition
  • Arbeit an modernem Prüf-Equipment
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und planbare Einsatzorte per Dienstplan
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Ein Team mit sympathischen Kollegen und familiärer Arbeitsweise
  • Mitarbeiter Boni über Probonio
  • Gemeinsame Events wie Weihnachtsfeiern u. v. m.

  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

 This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You’ll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über unseren Kunden

Wahrscheinlich hast du heute schon ein Produkt unseres Kunden benutzt, ohne es zu merken. Das Unternehmen ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Zugangslösungen: Tor- und Türautomation, die Gebäude, Grundstücke und Garagen sicher und smart macht. Mehrere tausend Mitarbeitende arbeiten weltweit für den Konzern, hinter dem ein renommierter internationaler Investor steht. Zum Portfolio gehören starke Marken für den professionellen B2B-Markt und den DIY-Bereich sowie ein App-basiertes Smart-Access-Ökosystem, das Zugangsprodukte vernetzt.

Das Europa-Geschäft mit Zentrale in Deutschland wächst und verändert sich gerade. Ziel ist es, Marktanteile zu gewinnen und den Vertrieb noch professioneller aufzustellen. Dafür sucht das Unternehmen eine Person, die nicht nur selbst Neukunden gewinnt, sondern das BDM-Team mitzieht.

Deine Mission

In den nächsten 12 bis 24 Monaten gewinnst du messbar mehr Neukunden, vor allem große OEMs. In deinem Kerngebiet Nordeuropa (Skandinavien und Benelux) baust du eine starke Pipeline auf. In Deutschland (DACH) holst du wichtige Zielkunden an Bord. Gleichzeitig setzt du für das BDM-Team den Standard im Neugeschäft.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Neukunden gewinnen: Du verantwortest dein eigenes Kerngebiet Nordeuropa (Skandinavien und Benelux) und konzentrierst dich auf große OEMs. Außerdem bist du dafür verantwortlich, wichtige Zielkunden in Deutschland (DACH) zu gewinnen. Dabei hilft dir idealerweise dein eigenes Netzwerk.

  • Abschlüsse in ganz Europa unterstützen: Mit den BDMs in Benelux und Nordeuropa besuchst du Kunden gemeinsam und hilfst, neue Accounts zu gewinnen.

  • Vorbild und Coach sein: Du prägst mit, wie das Team (ca. 5 BDMs) Neukunden anspricht, Kundentermine gestaltet, das CRM nutzt und die Pipeline steuert. Wenn du schon erste Führungserfahrung hast, ist das ein Plus.

  • Vertrieb steuern und Forecasts verantworten: Du berichtest KPIs in HubSpot, verantwortest deine Forecast-Zahlen und legst Maßnahmen fest, wenn erwartete Aufträge ausbleiben.

  • Den Markt entwickeln: Du beobachtest Markt und Wettbewerb und bringst Ideen ein, wie das Unternehmen Kunden vom Wettbewerb gewinnt.

Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung Europa.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im operativen B2B-Vertrieb oder Business Development und kannst nachweisen, dass du Neukunden gewinnst.

  • Du hast große Accounts, idealerweise OEMs, in mehreren europäischen Märkten gewonnen und weiterentwickelt.

  • Du arbeitest diszipliniert: Ein CRM (z. B. HubSpot), sauberes Pipeline-Tracking, KPI-Reporting und verlässliche Forecasts gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Du lieferst Ergebnisse, statt nur darüber zu reden. Du gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, setzt dich durch, denkst in Zahlen und hältst ein, was du zusagst.

  • Du betreust gern eigene Kunden und unterstützt dabei deine Kolleg:innen. Profitabilität behältst du im Blick, neue Ideen bringst du aktiv ein.

  • Du wohnst in Deutschland und bist bereit, etwa 60-70 % zu reisen (v. a. Skandinavien, Benelux, DACH und weitere Länder in Europa)

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Ein Plus ist, wenn du:

  • Erfahrung mit Tür-, Tor-, Zutritts- oder Sicherheitslösungen mitbringst oder aus einer verwandten Branche kommst, etwa Bau, Gebäudetechnik oder Elektro. Das ist keine Pflicht, solange du dich schnell ins Geschäft einarbeitest.

  • schon Vertriebskolleg:innen gecoacht oder ein Vertriebsteam fachlich geführt hast

  • ein Netzwerk zu OEMs und Großkunden in Nordeuropa, Benelux und DACH hast.

  • weitere Sprachen sprichst, vor allem Französisch, Niederländisch oder eine skandinavische Sprache.

Deine Benefits

  • Home-based arbeiten: Du musst nicht regelmäßig in der Europazentrale sein

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit bei einem globalen Marktführer

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Das Europa-Geschäft wächst, und du hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie der Vertrieb sich entwickelt

  • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen in ganz Europa

  • Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung Europa und schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket + Car Allowance

title: Lead Commercial Sales
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We want you as a talented Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional to help us in our mission by driving commercial B2B success across our key technologies, Nyx, and future programmes, while supporting our Chief Commercial Officer in expanding our government business outside Europe.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include B2B sales responsibilities:

  • Owning the sales pipeline for key technologies e.g. Additive Manufacturing, Thermal Protection, and Propulsion technologies offered through the "Space Store" as well as supporting the commercialization and expansion plan for European Astrotech (EAL) propulsion services.

  • Identifying, qualifying, and developing customers across satellite operators, launch providers, defense and prime contractors

  • Building technical and commercial proposals with our engineering teams and negotiating contract terms

  • Defining the Space Store go-to-market approach, including positioning, pricing, and sales enablement

  • Leading commercial sales for Nyx cargo and crew services, including commercial station (CLD) and payload opportunities.

  • Developing commercial strategies for future programs, including lunar and launcher offerings

  • Developing a qualified pipeline of future clients for future programs to support bid and fundraising efforts.

  • Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and bid preparation to contract signature and handover to programme teams

  • Supporting the Chief Commercial Officer in developing and executing the sales strategy for government customers outside Europe.

  • Supporting the European and USA Government teams where needed.

  • Preparing responses, capability presentations, and pitch materials

  • Representing the company at trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Lead Commercial Sales & Business Development professional, ideally, you will have the following:

  • 8+ years of B2B sales or business development experience, ideally in aerospace, space, defence, or other high-technology industries

  • A proven track record of closing complex, high-value commercial B2B deals and technical sales, such as hardware, engineering services, or systems

  • Experience selling to government agencies or prime contractors, including international government markets

  • An understanding of technical products such as additive manufacturing, thermal protection, propulsion, or spacecraft systems, and the ability to translate them into customer value

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and proposal-writing skills

  • Fluency in English; additional fluency in German, French, or Italian is a strong advantage, depending on your location

  • Experience in a fast-growing startup or scale-up environment (preferred

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

Tu accompagneras les équipes Recouvrement et Finance dans leurs prises de décisions et d’amélioration des processus de recouvrement d’Octopus Energy France. descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.   • Tu veux être accompagné pour exploiter à fond ton potentiel et réaliser ton ambition

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan.

The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base.

As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers.

To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance, Legal and Ops leaders.

We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team.

From the day you join until we are fully licensed, you will structure and execute the legal path to authorization: interpret requirements, translate them into an internal plan, and ensure deliverables are complete, consistent, and aligned across teams. You will help define the target operating model (intra-group and outsourced) and ensure it is legally defensible and well documented for the application.

After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk).

This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, and the opportunity to shape the legal culture of a fast-growing fintech while managing and mentoring an experienced Legal Counsel, with the ambition to scale the team further as the business grows.

Organisation & Reporting

You will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel.

You will manage a seasoned Legal Counsel and will be responsible for planning the future growth of the Financial Services Legal team. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team.

Mission & Objectives

Team Leadership & Structuring

  • You manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture.

  • You structure the team’s workload and roadmap, delegating effectively while remaining deeply hands-on.

  • You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team.

Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized.

Products, contracts and customer legal architecture

  • You own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable).

  • You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications).

Outsourcing / BaaS transition & vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny.

Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).

Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers.

Regulatory engagement support & internal enablement

  • Until we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&A packs, position papers, meeting preparation).

  • Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc.

  • You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services.

Culture, Training & Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes.

About you

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS.

  • You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment.

  • You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes.

  • Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar).

  • Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc).

Skills & mindset

Technical strengths You can credibly lead on :

  • ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing;

  • Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments;

  • Governance and regulated-entity corporate law basics.

Soft skills

  • Player-coach mentality: capable of executing complex individual contributions while guiding and empowering your team.

  • You can work fast without losing rigour.

  • Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex regulatory legal topics to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms.

  • Pragmatic, impact-driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation.

  • Very strong written and oral communication skills in both French and English.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Stanislas (1h), Head of Legal, Risk & Compliance

3. Case Study with Stanislas & Maxime (1h)

4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet.   • Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet

    • Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)

    • Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
    • Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)

  • Être le partenaire technique du client
    • Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client

  • Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe

    • Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving

  • Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe
    • Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)
    • Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)

Les problématiques sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d’évolution :

2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

title: Learning Designer
descriptionHtml:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy helps our customers, partners and colleagues become self-sufficient with the Quantexa Platform. We do that through online learning, instructor-led sessions and bespoke digital resources that let every user harness the power of our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Learning Designer to join our Design & Publish Team within Education Services. You'll turn complex technical topics – data, analytics, software and FinTech – into clear, engaging and accessible learning experiences, taking projects from first conversation with a subject matter expert through to a polished, published solution.

This is a role for an independent problem solver. You'll own your design projects end to end, decide how best to approach each one, and organize your own time across several priorities at once, spotting risks early and keeping stakeholders informed without needing to be chased. You'll work alongside Product, R&D and Delivery experts, and have the room to bring your own ideas on tools, approaches and how we use AI to design better learning.

If you love making hard things easy to learn, and do your best work with autonomy and trust, we'd like to hear from you.

This is a hybrid role, with the expectation of attending the company office in central London twice a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and update learning solutions for customers, partners and employees – eLearning, media assets, articles, documentation and presentations – using a range of authoring and design tools.

  • Apply best practice in visual design, accessibility and user experience so every learner has a great experience.

  • Build learning journeys in our Learning Management System and use learner feedback and data to shape your design decisions.

  • Use AI-assisted tools to speed up research, authoring and quality checks, with human review to keep content accurate and aligned to learning objectives.

  • Work with subject matter experts, and with Product, Delivery and R&D teams, to understand the Platform and turn that knowledge into effective training.

  • Take ownership of your programs, keeping them current and aligned as the Platform evolves.

  • Research technical documentation, demos, recordings and learner feedback to make sure our content is accurate and high quality.

  • Plan and track your own design projects, flagging risks and blockers early and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Use tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint and Asana to manage tasks, document your work and collaborate across teams.

  • Identify, propose and lead the introduction of new tools, processes or AI approaches that improve our learning design and the learner experience.

  • Support teammates through feedback and knowledge sharing, and take the lead on projects where it's useful.

What you'll bring.

Essential

  • Hands-on experience designing learning content with authoring and design tools (we use Articulate Rise).

  • Solid knowledge of design fundamentals such as graphic design, UX, accessibility and media design.

  • A good understanding of learning theories and instructional design principles.

  • Experience designing technical or complex training content – for example in FinTech, analytics, data science, data engineering or software development.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and concisely.

  • Confident use of Microsoft Office 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint)

  • Experience, or real curiosity, in using GenAI for content creation, automation and productivity.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing needs.

  • A collaborative, proactive and solution-focused approach, and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Experience with an LMS and using learner data or feedback to improve content.

  • Experience coordinating projects that involve several stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or sharing knowledge with colleagues, or an interest in doing so.

  • Familiarity with Confluence, Jira or Asana.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Lending Completions Officer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

This is a key role in delivering a fast, accurate and well-controlled lending journey. You will manage a portfolio of cases from offer and post-sanction administration through to drawdown and completion, making sure every case is progressed efficiently and every condition is properly satisfied.

Commercial mortgages will be a core part of the role, alongside other commercial lending products such as GGS loans, overdrafts, business loans, asset finance, non-property-backed lending and unsecured lending. You will work closely with Relationship Managers, Underwriting, legal and valuation partners and other teams across the bank.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Manage a pipeline of lending cases from offer to completion, meeting service levels, quality standards and expected completion timelines.

  • Deliver post-sanction administration, including releasing communications, instructing legal and valuation partners and coordinating payments.

  • Review and satisfy Conditions Precedent and other completion requirements, escalating risks, gaps and delays early.

  • Coordinate drawdown and completion activity accurately, ensuring the right approvals, documentation and controls are in place.

  • Build effective working relationships with Relationship Managers, Underwriting, solicitors, valuers and other internal and external stakeholders.

  • Maintain clear, accurate and audit-ready case records, including sanction audit trails, customer records and updates to the core banking system.

  • Communicate relevant information clearly so that colleagues and decision-makers understand the position, risks and actions required.

  • Work in line with bank policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, Conduct and Treating Customers Fairly expectations.

  • Support wider lending and Operations activity, including cross-skilling, issue resolution, quality improvements and change initiatives.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Experience in lending, credit operations, mortgage completions, loan administration or a similar financial services environment.

  • A practical understanding of the commercial lending journey and pipeline management, ideally including commercial mortgages.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to analyse information, identify issues and make sound, timely decisions.

  • A customer-focused approach and a track record of delivering a high standard of service in a fast-paced environment.

  • Good financial and commercial awareness, with an understanding of the importance of risk, controls and accurate record keeping.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to build relationships and have constructive conversations.

  • Strong organisation and IT skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain momentum across a live pipeline.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: M&A – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Die Steuerberatung erlebt eine Konsolidierungswelle: Tausende Häuser suchen in den nächsten Jahren eine Nachfolge, und nur wenige Käufer prüfen sie mit derselben Sorgfalt wie ein professionelles Transaktionsteam. Hier lernst du M&A auf der Käuferseite, an echten Transaktionen und von der ersten Ansprache bis nach dem Abschluss.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen und erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen, um sie weiterzuentwickeln. Wir prüfen laufend neue Ziele, bewerten, verhandeln und schließen ab. Anders als bei einem Finanzinvestor endet unsere Arbeit nicht beim Abschluss, sie fängt dort an.

Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master und willst den Transaktionsprozess vollständig kennenlernen, nicht nur einen Ausschnitt davon. Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du arbeitest im Finance-Team und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung an laufenden Transaktionen.

Deine Verantwortung

Zielsuche und Marktanalyse

  • Du baust Longlists und Shortlists möglicher Ziele, recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Nachfolgesituationen und bereitest Erstansprachen vor.

  • Du wertest Teaser und erste Unterlagen aus und hältst in einer kurzen Einschätzung fest, ob sich eine vertiefte Prüfung lohnt.

Bewertung und Due Diligence

  • Du erstellst Bewertungen nach Multiplikatoren, Transaktionsvergleichen und Ertragswert, normalisierst Jahresabschlüsse und rechnest Kaufpreis-Mechanik und Sensitivitäten durch.

  • Du strukturierst Datenräume, koordinierst Fragenlisten mit dem Verkäufer und unseren Beratern und benennst Auffälligkeiten für die Verhandlung.

  • Du rechnest die Finanzierungsseite mit: Kapitaldienst, Rückbeteiligung, Zahlungsstruktur über die Zeit.

Verhandlung und Abschluss

  • Du bereitest Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung vor: eine Empfehlung mit Begründung, keine Sammlung von Kennzahlen.

  • Du arbeitest an Absichtserklärungen, Term Sheets und Verhandlungsunterlagen mit und begleitest Gespräche mit Inhabern.

  • Nach dem Abschluss hilfst du, das übernommene Haus in unser Berichtswesen zu überführen, und machst sichtbar, ob die Annahmen der Bewertung eintreten.

Deine Perspektiven

Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du hast an mindestens einer Transaktion durchgehend mitgearbeitet, von der Analyse bis zur Verhandlung.

  • Ein Bewertungsmodell von dir ist in eine Entscheidungsvorlage eingegangen, und ein Dritter kann es weiterrechnen.

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du trägst die Erstprüfung eines Ziels eigenständig, vom Teaser bis zur Empfehlung.

  • Du kennst den Prozess so gut, dass du die nächste Prüfung strukturieren könntest.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Wer im Praktikum überzeugt, hat die Tür für den Einstieg in Finance & M&A offen. Fachliche Expertenlaufbahn und Führungslaufbahn stehen danach beide offen, entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Fach mit Vertiefung in Finance, Corporate Finance oder Rechnungswesen.

  • Erste Praxis in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Private Equity oder einer Unternehmensberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

  • Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Steuerfachangestellte mit laufendem Studium, die Jahresabschlüsse von innen kennen, Mathematik- oder Physikstudierende mit Interesse an Bewertung, Gründer eines eigenen kleinen Unternehmens. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du bist sicher in Excel und PowerPoint und baust Modelle, die ein Dritter verstehen und weiterrechnen kann.

  • Du liest einen Jahresabschluss so, dass du erkennst, was erklärungsbedürftig ist, statt Kennzahlen abzuschreiben.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Recherche, Aufbereitung von Datenräumen und Drafting.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf einem Niveau, das für Verhandlungsunterlagen trägt.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du behandelst Vertrauliches selbstverständlich vertraulich und interessierst dich für das Unternehmen hinter den Zahlen.

  • Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen, nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Keine zweite Reihe. Deine Arbeit geht in eine Verhandlung, die diesen Monat stattfindet.

  • Keine Deal-Romantik. Wir kaufen, um zu behalten. Wer nach dem Abschluss das Interesse verliert, verpasst den besten Teil.

  • Keine Übungsfälle. Du arbeitest an echten Zielen mit echten Inhabern.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

Compensation: €4K per month

title: Manufacturing Test Engineer

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Job Overview:
We are seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to join Anduril, working in a cutting-edge start-up environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in subsea robotics. The Manufacturing Test Engineer will be charged with developing and implementing high-fidelity, automated test processes on both the component and system level. Working closely with engineering staff and a team of skilled electro-mechanical technicians, this role is key to advancing our testing capabilities to ensure the highest levels quality are achieved as we continue drive scalability into our production operations.

About the Team
Anduril’s Manufacturing team is producing the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles globally at rate. The Manufacturing Engineering team owns production readiness and process engineering across the Undersea Dominance product range — from core vehicle platform to specialised mission payloads, spanning mechanical and electrical hardware build through to full system integration & test.

About the Job
You will own the test software, automation and tooling that proves every Dive-XL vehicle works before it leaves the building — the Python frameworks that drive instruments and vehicle hardware, the operator-facing GUIs that make complex test sequences safe and repeatable under production pressure, and the interlocks that protect people and product when the system is commanding real high-voltage DC. You will also own the infrastructure underneath: NixOS-based station builds, test result flow into MES, and the configuration management that keeps a fleet of test stations reproducible and rollback-safe. If you thrive hands-on — oscilloscopes and protocol analysers as often as a code editor — in a fast-paced environment where the architecture is yours to build, this role is for you.


What You'll Do

  • Build a broad range of test capabilities across the manufacturing value stream - PCBA bring up, electrical boxes/bottles bring-up, system level checkouts and acceptance testing to key component level in process validation.
  • Develop, execute, and manage test eco-system to de-risk hardware and ensure product meets target reliability levels and ultimate design intent.
  • Perform hands-on and data-driven root cause analysis of electromechanical subsystems utilizing structured problem solving methodologies.
  • Design, implement and maintain semi-automated testing equipment/protocols for subsystem characterization and testing.
  • Diagnose production test issues hands-on as fist point of contact for test technicians. Isolate the failure mode, work with Electrical Design and Software when escalation is needed.
  • Collaborate with the design/systems team throughout product development cycles to perform risk assessments, maintain ownership of test deployment activities in production, oversee technician training, burn down bug fixes/improvements as needed.
  • Produce and maintain testing logs/data, develop library of error codes with troubleshooting logic/diagrams for fast issue resolution.
  • Generate controlled test instructions that can be easily followed by technician team in MES or other test execution systems.
  • Optimize test design and execution of full system “end of line” factory acceptance test (FAT) of AUVs
  • Design and execution of PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary


REQUIRED QUALIFIACTIONS

  • Degree in Software, Computer, Electrical, Mechatronic or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Experience in hardware testing and automated test systems (LabVIEW, Test Stand, etc.)
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Matlab, SHELL, or others
  • Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc
  • 3+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably test design of electro-mechanical hardware in a manufacturing environment
  • Are well versed with complex electromechanical systems and are passionate about understanding what it takes to make them work reliably
  • Have experience developing full system test plans and know how to execute them on fast-paced product development timelines
  • Have experience with programming/testing a wide range of sensors, actuators, and electrical components
  • Can prototype and run your own tests, from experimental setup to hardware and software implementation
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government NV2 Security Clearance (Australian citizen).


PREFERRED QUALIFIACTIONS

  • Experience in sub-sea robotics or AUV/UUV industries
  • Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES)
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new skills or adapt to new situations. Un-phased by challenges that go beyond the traditional comfort zone or work experience. Multidisciplinary approach to problem solving
  • Comfortable with high project ownership under technical and schedule pressure, particularly where the scope and definition are limited
  • Experience testing and operating with or around hazardous systems (high voltage up to 400V)
  • Experience working on projects that involve the integration of electrical, mechanical, and software/firmware systems
  • Experience with NixOS, or anydeclarative-configuration background (Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
  • Test frameworks — pytest-based harnesses, LabVIEW, TestStand or equivalent. Exposure to more than one is a plus.

Lust auf eine Schlüsselrolle, in der du Finanzprozesse aktiv mitgestaltest und als Bindeglied zwischen Finance, Business und IT agierst? title: Mechanical Engineering Director (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As the Mechanical Engineering Director at Focused Energy, you will design, build, and lead the Mechanical Engineering department, establishing its organizational structure, operating model, engineering standards, and budget. You will oversee end-to-end mechanical capability across key delivery programs, managing peer Chief Mechanical Engineers. Your leadership will ensure that mechanical subsystems are rigorously designed, manufactured, verified, and delivered on schedule to Systems Integration.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Mechanical Engineering department's structure, headcount, budget forecasting, and capacity allocation across active delivery programs.

  • Lead and develop peer Chief Mechanical Engineers and emerging capability leads, defining delegated technical authority frameworks and clear accountability.

  • Scale and build out the five core mechanical capability areas in phased stages aligned with funded project workloads.

  • Enforce robust mechanical design review governance, ensuring all released designs contain verified load cases, tolerances, and interface evidence.

  • Establish manufacturing and supplier engineering capabilities early in the lifecycle to optimize design-for-manufacture, assembly, and test readiness.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Systems Integration, Engineering Operations, Procurement, Quality, and Facilities to ensure seamless subsystem handovers at readiness gates.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Extensive leadership experience building, structuring, and scaling engineering organizations, teams, and departmental budgets.

  • Strong background across the full mechanical engineering lifecycle, spanning initial concept, supplier manufacturing, assembly, testing, and integration handover.

  • Proven track record of establishing formal design review cadences, delegated authority models, and engineering release standards.

  • Experience managing engineering resource allocation and resolving capacity trade-offs across concurrent, complex technical programs.

  • Demonstrated capability in mentoring technical leads and creating distinct career progression pathways for both management and specialist individual contributors.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to communicate project risks, trade-offs, and commitments transparently to executive stakeholders.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Technical familiarity with high-complexity domains such as vacuum systems, cryogenics, thermal management, fluids, or precision mechanical systems.

What We Offer

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.
