  • Surprise meal stipends: work from home can’t stop the enjoyment of someone else making a meal for you!

  • Work/life harmony: 26 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Medical insurance, life insurance, and business travel insurance

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development and tuition reimbursement, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Compensation, benefits, and beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Quantum Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Project

We are looking for a Quantum Software Engineer to develop the future software stack for controlling utility-scale quantum computers. At the interface of the theory and engineering teams, this ambitious project aims to develop internal tools to streamline the operation of logical quantum circuits on Quandela’s spin-photonic quantum computers.

This position requires a strong understanding of quantum computing protocols on real hardware, strong software engineering skills and proficiency with AI tools.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a new compilation stack translating high-level quantum circuits into hardware-aware pulse schedules optimized for our photonic quantum computers.
  • Drive long-term architectural strategy, technical roadmap, and cross-organizational alignment.
  • Contribute to the development of a digital twin, receiving hardware instructions to simulate the behavior of our future QPUs.
  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in quantum software.

How You’ll Grow:

  • 3 months. By the end of the first quarter, you are expected to have a grasp over Quandela’s roadmap and specific approach to quantum computing. You understand how user operations are currently compiled to machine instructions and how that is expected to evolve
  • 6 months. By the end of the first semester, you have a firm understanding of Quandela’s technology and are already a key contributor to the compiler codebase for the near future
  • 12 months. You have a long-term vision over the quantum software’s activities, and are the owner of one or more work packages for strategic projects.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • Master’s, or PhD in Quantum related field.
  • 2/4+ years of relevant experience in quantum software, quantum hardware automation, or related topics.

Must-have:

  • A good understanding of photonic-based quantum computing.
  • Strong proficiency in python.
  • Experience working at the interface of software, experimental hardware, and theory teams in the industry or academia.
  • Collaborative mindset, able to serve as a bridge between various teams.

Important, but you can grow here:

  • Proficiency in at least one system language (C++ or Rust)
  • Exposure to the quantum computing frontends and related ecosystem (e.g. cirq, qiskit, openqasm, cuda-q).
  • Hands-on experience with quantum photonic systems.
  • Familiarity with compilation mechanisms such as LLVM or compilation to microcode.

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)

  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one

title: Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why the UK

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools, to join us in UK.

About The Role

Sales Management Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are 

  • You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
  • You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
  • You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
  • A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
  • Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.
  • Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.
  • A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets.
  • Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable.
  • A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers.

Why Join Us

  • Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid.
  • A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our AI portfolio spans model development through to production inference at scale, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to make sure that infrastructure runs reliably, scales predictably, and gets AI engineers' work safely into production.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work keeps our AI portfolio reliable and performant for hospitals and aftercare providers who depend on it daily.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Our AI portfolio needs to run reliably and perform well. Thus it has to be properly monitored.

  • Capacity needs planning, support scaling initiatives, and ensure our systems remain stable as the company grows.

  • SageMaker models need to be continuously delivered, following AWS' best practices.

  • AI engineers need assistance with productionalizing AI workloads end-to-end, from code to container build, and rollouts using optimal deployment strategies.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to build, ship, and operate AI workloads reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes and Postgres

  • Inference: Bedrock, SageMaker, ClearML

  • Observability: Datadog, LangFuse, OTEL

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Plus various auxiliary tools for security, compliance and operations: DockerHub, Google as IdP, SonarCloud, VPNs, QuickSight, CDN, Snowflake, ETLs, etc.


Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

These are the knowledge and skills you need:

  • Experience with AWS (CloudFormation, IAM, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, KMS).

  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production (kustomize, HPA and KEDA based autoscaling).

  • Experience deploying SageMaker models, setting up custom inference containers (HuggingFace and/or OSS model) and endpoints (provisioning, autoscaling, and blue/green rollouts).

  • Familiarity with observability & LLMOps best practices and solutions (Datadog, Langfuse, LLM/GenAI tracing, OTel, CloudWatch).

  • Proficiency in Python, specifically with FastAPI and async task management.

  • Knowing how to set up ML/LLM GPU inference on EKS (GPU-backed instances, Nvidia driver/plugin).

  • Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate directly with other teams.

  • Troubleshooting, RCA, and resolving problems. When things get stressful, you stay cool headed and work through issues step by step, asking for support from SMEs when needed.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • This is a cross-functional role bridging the gap between applications and the platform. Ability to both explain complex concepts clearly to non-domain experts, and extract information through well-formed questions during verbal communication, is a must.

Bonus points:

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Self-hosting/home lab.

  • Nvidia Triton/vLLM or similar.

  • MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML, DVC, Vertex AI.

  • Slack and GitHub automations (bots, workflows, apps, etc.).

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

  • Language proficiency (at least English, but the more, the better).

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Mid-level

Mid-level Software Engineer. You own features end to end: you shape them with a product person, build them, test them, release them and look after them once they are live. You work inside an existing architecture with senior review. The work is mostly Kotlin backend plus Next.js and React front end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

This advert is for the Mid-level. If you have more senior experience, see our Senior Software Engineer vacancy here.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.

  • A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • Fully remote working in the UK, with access to a fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Modeling in Harvey Research, you’ll own how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the post-training recipe across SFT and RL, including reward design and verification for challenging, semi-verifiable legal tasks. You’ll help set the research direction and carry ideas from experiments through training runs to models used by customers. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers and scientists who have gotten training runs working at scale, are immersed in RL for language models, and want their work to reach users quickly.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Own and pursue a research agenda to improve model capability on long-horizon legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

  • Design and run post-training experiments across SFT and RL, building on leading open-weight models.

  • Develop reward functions and verifiers for semi-verifiable tasks, including rubrics, learned preference models, and expert preference data, and study where they break.

  • Run and debug training at scale, addressing divergence, reward hacking, and instability.

  • Build and use rigorous evals to track improvements and decide what ships.

  • Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

What You Have

  • Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with SFT and RL, including preference optimization, and direct ownership of training runs and results.

  • Deep ML fundamentals and experience getting distributed training runs working reliably.

  • Strong engineering skills in Python, with production-quality code and end-to-end system ownership.

  • Research experience in RL for language models or reward modeling, with the ability to move quickly from experiments to shipped improvements. Publications welcome, not required.

title: Revenue Operations Engineer | AI & Automation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

As a Revenue Operations Engineeer you anchor the build end of Revenue Operations - our internal product team whose customers are the GTM functions: Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance. You build the AI, automation, and data foundations that make these teams faster, smarter, and more scalable, owning the end-to-end delivery of internal tools, integrations, and AI-powered workflows - from problem framing and architecture through launch, adoption, and measurable business impact.

Who We Want

Proven GTM Systems Builder.
You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in RevOps, GTM Engineering, SalesOps, Business Systems, or a comparable B2B SaaS role, and can show production systems you personally built.

AI-Native Builder.
You've integrated LLMs into real workflows or tools through APIs and understand how to move beyond prompting into reliable, production-ready use cases.

Product-Minded Systems Thinker.
You start with the user and business problem, map the relevant process and data dependencies, and choose the simplest scalable solution rather than defaulting to a particular tool.

Integration & Data Fluent.
You're comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, data models, and the movement of data between multiple systems.

End-to-End Owner.
You can take a project from discovery and architecture through building, testing, rollout, documentation, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.

Pragmatic Production Engineer.
You ship quickly without treating reliability as optional, including appropriate testing, error handling, security, observability, and documentation.

Business-Impact Oriented.
You connect technical work to measurable outcomes such as pipeline, productivity, data quality, speed, cost, or customer experience.

Clear Cross-Functional Communicator.
You can explain technical decisions simply, manage trade-offs, work through ambiguity, and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are fluent in written and spoken English; German is a plus.

Curious & Self-Directed.
You actively experiment with new technologies, learn through building, and share useful findings without chasing novelty for its own sake.

Who We Don’t Want

Uses tools without hands-on depth.
You've used CRM and AI tools but lack hands-on experience building automations, configuring systems, or solving operational problems end-to-end.

Struggles with cross-functional GTM processes.
You find it hard to understand how operational decisions ripple across the wider GTM motion and the business as a whole.

Weak on the technical fundamentals.
You struggle with APIs, JSON, data models, authentication, debugging, or moving data reliably between systems.

Can't connect the build to the business.
You can't explain technical choices clearly, manage trade-offs, influence stakeholders, or connect a build to its wider business impact.

Uses AI without shipping anything real.
You use ChatGPT or Claude but can't point to an LLM-powered workflow, integration, or tool you've personally built and shipped.

Builds without thinking about what comes after.
You've built isolated automations without considering maintainability, documentation, ownership, failure handling, or how the solution fits into the wider architecture.

Your Day To Day

Building: AI, Automation & Systems (~ 65%)

  • You identify and productionize high-leverage AI use cases across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, including LLM integrations, workflow design, evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring
  • You design and build lightweight internal applications and interfaces that remove recurring manual work, improve decision-making, and are simple for teams to adopt
  • You build end-to-end workflows using Make, n8n, and custom logic, including business rules, system handoffs, error handling, alerts, and ongoing monitoring
  • You create clean, maintainable data flows between HubSpot, the data warehouse, billing, support, and other GTM tools using APIs, webhooks, enrichment pipelines, and data activation
  • You work deeply within HubSpot's objects, properties, workflows, and integration layer to support complex use cases without creating fragile or unnecessarily complicated architecture

Discovery & Solution Design (~ 15%)

  • You translate scoped or ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions, define success metrics, and choose the simplest approach that can deliver meaningful impact

Deployment, Adoption & Documentation (~ 20%)

  • You test, document, deploy, and iterate on solutions with end users so they remain secure, maintainable, reliable, and useful after launch

Stakeholders

RevOps: Your peers and manager to collaborate on projects and daily initiatives
Engineering team: Coordinate with engineers for projects that may require product know how and integration across the engineering tool stack GTM teams as and when required

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
  • We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
  • We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
  • We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
  • We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.
  • Regular company-wide and team events.
  • An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.
  • A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you!

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂

title: Revenue Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

  • Remote – Europe or US (EST only)

  • Hybrid – Paris or New York

 

Role

Morpho's GTM motion has grown faster than the operations behind it. Pipeline visibility, CRM hygiene, forecasting, and tooling are split across people who all have other jobs, and nobody owns the end-to-end picture. This role owns RevOps outright and builds the systems that help the GTM team close more relevant deals, faster, working directly within the Business Operations team, directly under the Head of BizOps.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own GTM dashboards and KPI reporting so the team tracks what matters and trusts the numbers.

  • Run the GTM tech stack, automations, and AI tooling to keep business developers fast and well informed.

  • Keep the CRM minimal and clean, with stages, hygiene, and processes people actually follow.

  • Build business intelligence and forecasting to set targets that are ambitious and credible, and to spot new trends early.

  • Surface signals from markets and media so business developers can chase, upsell, and close at the right moment.

  • Partner with GTM leadership and Finance on comp design, quota setting, and territory assignment.

  • Own the knowledge base and data management so accurate information is easy to find and reuse.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

  • You are fully up to speed on the Morpho product, protocol, and roadmap, and you understand how the GTM team operates today.

  • You have a prioritized plan for what to build, fix, and delete, and you are already making reps faster.

 

First 3 months

  • You have fixed the biggest gaps and bottlenecks: a cleaner CRM, simpler processes, and the automations, dashboards, and forecasts business developers rely on daily.

  • You are central to productivity assessment, rep attribution, and deal tracking.

 

First 6 months

  • You own the full RevOps stack and bridge GTM and Finance.

  • Leadership has full visibility into the business to make better decisions, and you lead entire projects end to end.

 

Must Have Skills & Experience

  • DeFi native: you use onchain products and understand how protocols and their users behave.

  • Experience as a RevOps, growth engineer, or business analyst at a B2B startup.

  • Tech or software background: comfortable building automations and reasoning about connected systems.

  • Strong with data: cleaning, modeling, analyzing, and reporting it accurately.

  • Finance experience

  • Business mindset with a critical eye: you challenge metrics and simplify by default.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: doesn't wait to be told.

  • Clear and crisp async communication.

  • Comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous contexts.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

title: Robotics / Mechatronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Our factories run high-mix, small-batch work, and much of the automation on the market is built for long production runs. Our robotics team is building automation that fits how we work, aimed at the biggest bottlenecks on the shop floor and designed to be deployed across many sites.

As a Robotics / Mechatronics Engineer you will design, build and integrate in-house hardware, starting with autonomous material movement on the shop floor. The role spans CAD, embedded systems and software.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and integrate robotic and mechatronic systems for our factories, from concept and CAD to prototype and deployment.

  • Work across mechanical design, actuators, sensors, embedded electronics and communications hardware.

  • Write the software that runs your hardware and connects it to MasonOS.

  • Specify and integrate off-the-shelf automation, such as machine tending and cell automation, where that is the right answer.

  • Prototype and test on a live shop floor, designing for modularity so systems can be deployed at many sites.

What we're looking for

  • Broad engineering ability across hardware, software and embedded systems.

  • Strong CAD skills.

  • Programming for robotics, for example Python or C++.

  • Hands-on embedded experience with actuators and communications hardware. Self-taught is fine.

  • A record of building and deploying real hardware outside the lab.

Nice to have

  • Manufacturing automation.

  • Design for manufacture and GD&T.

  • Mobile robots, machine tending or pallet systems.

Why Isembard

  • Shape robotics at Isembard at an early stage.

  • See your work running on a live factory floor.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London.

descriptionHtml:
Sales / Account Executive - Research Participants - United Kingdom

 

 

Location: Remote (UK)
Type of contract: Freelance
Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The RoleDo you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting sales and account executives based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a sales or account executive. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant
  • Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective
  • Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part

What you’ll bring

  • Residence in the UK
  • Fluent English
  • A device with a working microphone
  • No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.

Why join this project?This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Sales Director
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Sales Director at Faculty, you will lead the sale of large-scale strategic AI engagements, building trusted C-suite relationships and establishing Faculty as the essential partner for the world's largest companies pursuing transformative AI initiatives.

You will drive high-impact growth by navigating complex sales cycles, collaborating closely with key strategic partners like Accenture, and shaping bold, differentiated commercial solutions that empower Fortune 500 and FTSE 100 organisations to harness the full power of artificial intelligence.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and managing a qualified pipeline of high-value strategic opportunities directly across target enterprises and joint Accenture partnership channels.

  • Leading end-to-end sales processes from initial executive engagement through to contract signature, orchestrating technical scoping, solution design, commercial negotiations, procurement, and legal reviews.

  • Developing enduring executive relationships with C-suite sponsors at global enterprise accounts, positioning Faculty as their premier partner for transformative AI initiatives.

  • Collaborating with Accenture leadership to identify joint pursuit opportunities, align go-to-market strategies, and coordinate enterprise deal execution.

  • Achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets while maintaining rigorous forecasting discipline and providing leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health.

  • Partnering with cross-functional technical and delivery teams to shape compelling, credible propositions that solve complex organisational challenges.

Who we're looking for

  • You bring a proven track record of enterprise sales leadership, successfully closing complex, multi-quarter strategic engagements with Fortune 500 or FTSE 100 companies.

  • You excel at C-suite engagement, building trusted relationships with senior executives such as CTOs, CSOs, and CISOs who sponsor enterprise-wide AI and safety initiatives.

  • You possess strong technical sales acumen, comfortably translating complex AI concepts into clear business value while engaging fluently with both technical teams and commercial decision-makers.

  • You bring valuable partnership sales experience, adept at collaborating with consulting firms, systems integrators, and hyper-scalers to co-sell and win major accounts.

  • You master deal orchestration and commercial structuring, with expertise in guiding multi-stakeholder work streams and negotiating sophisticated agreements like MSAs and outcome-based pricing models.

  • You demonstrate exceptional executive presence and resilience, presenting confidently to boards and C-suites while maintaining energy and momentum through complex, high-stakes sales cycles.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction call with the Hiring Manager (30 mins)

  3. On site Panel Interview (60mins)

  4. Final interview with one of our Managing Directors (30mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara's platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France
  • Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: SAR Manager
descriptionHtml:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Financial Crime Intelligence & Investigations Team as a Financial Crime SAR Manager? Reporting to the Senior Manager, you’ll act as a subject matter expert for financial crime intelligence analysis across our client base. Including conducting analysis of potential suspicious activity across a range of financial crime escalations, producing reports for both internal and external audiences, and providing support across the wider team where needed.

Candidates need to have proven experience in financial crime intelligence across different payment platforms and services. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies, detection methods and intelligence analysis techniques, and share this knowledge with other members of the team. You’ll be comfortable working in an energetic environment and dealing with change whilst taking pride in owning and mitigating financial crime risk for the business.

You’ll demonstrate the confidence to raise concerns, shape strategic thinking and make well-informed decisions. You’ll bring strong knowledge of payment services, together with extensive technical and regulatory expertise across financial crime and sanctions in the UK and other jurisdictions, including relevant reporting obligations. You’ll also have a proven ability to identify, assess, and mitigate financial crime risk across the business.

Your role includes:

  • Leading complex financial crime investigations and providing senior-level oversight, challenge and direction on material or high-risk cases

  • Overseeing the allocation and prioritisation of investigative activity, ensuring resources are effectively deployed and key regulatory and operational deadlines are met

  • Building and managing effective relationships with senior stakeholders across the business, providing clear advice, challenge and escalation on financial crime matters

  • Providing oversight of financial crime risks associated with existing and emerging products and services, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are developed and implemented

  • Driving the development of financial crime, sanctions and money laundering typology knowledge across the team and wider business

  • Overseeing complex end-to-end enquiries and ensuring appropriate, timely and risk-based outcomes

  • Directing and overseeing research and intelligence activity to support the identification, assessment and investigation of potentially suspicious activity

  • Providing oversight and approval of relevant regulatory reports and disclosures, ensuring compliance with applicable AML legislation, regulation and reporting obligations

  • Accountable for team outcomes and responsible for complex/high risk decision making

  • Applying extensive technical and regulatory expertise to identify control weaknesses, assess risk exposure and influence appropriate remediation

  • Acting as a senior subject matter expert on financial crime and maintaining awareness of emerging AML trends, typologies and industry developments to strengthen the Bank’s detection and control capabilities

  • Developing strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to influence decision-making, support strategic objectives and deliver effective financial crime risk management

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience leading and providing oversight of complex financial crime investigations

  • Strong knowledge and practical application of financial crime control frameworks, regulatory requirements and industry standards

  • Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial

  • Understanding of UK and EU AML/CTF legislation (international AML/CTF knowledge is advantageous)

  • Meticulous organisational skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with key/senior stakeholders

  • Understanding of money laundering typologies across a range of products and services

  • Solutions driven, with the appetite for constant improvement

  • In-depth knowledge of AML regulations and guidelines

  • Strong ethical standards and integrity in handling sensitive information

  • A recognised AML/Sanctions/Fraud qualification is highly desirable

  • Previous experience of Delegated Nominated Officer responsibilities would be advantageous

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara's primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland's largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President's Club, Winner's circle, Top 10%)
  • Passionate about transformational technology in the world operations
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
