title: (Senior) Account Executive - Future Opportunities
descriptionHtml:
Weekly office requirement: Mon/Tues/Thurs weekly

At GWI, we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an impact. We think big to make an impact, we’re not afraid to ask why, and we always show respect. Those values are what got us where we are today, and they’re a big part of what we look for in our people.
While we’re not actively hiring for this role right now, we’re keen to connect with Senior Account Executives for future opportunities at GWI. If you’re interested in working with us but haven’t quite spotted the perfect role yet, we’d love you to join our proactive talent community. By submitting your application and answering a few curated questions, you’ll be among the first we reach out to when the right opportunity arises that aligns with your profile.
Who knows, it could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.

Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔

As our Account Executive you’ll:
be responsible for driving new business revenue and growth across your assigned accounts or territory, either Enterprise, Majors or mid-market accounts.

A few things you’ll be responsible for: 
👉 Develop and execute an account or territory plan that builds a strong pipeline and enables you to meet and exceed your quarterly and annual sales quota.
👉 Identify, map and go high-and-wide within organizations to understand the full scope of each opportunity.
👉 Lead the entire sales cycle from initial opportunity creation through to close.
👉 Establish and build credibility with prospects from the outset by developing a deep understanding of their business challenges and presenting needs-based solutions that meet their objectives.
👉 Work cross-functionally with internal teams to drive value across live opportunities and deliver strong commercial outcomes.
👉 Take ownership of your pipeline, executing outbound prospecting activity alongside inbound opportunities.
👉 Track all sales activity, manage opportunities, and accurately forecast revenue using Salesforce.
👉 Build and develop relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-level executives.
👉 Stay informed on industry trends, the competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to inform sales strategy and maintain a competitive edge.


It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.

What do I need to bring with me? 🧳


You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:
👉 Experience in SaaS or Subscription/licensing sales, especially closing business in large and complex corporate accounts.
👉 Ability to apply strategic thinking and sales skills to align technology solutions with complex, multi-stakeholder business problems.
👉 Follow MEDD(P)ICC sales methodology to qualify opportunities and progress deals through the pipeline.
👉  Experience using Salesforce to manage business (sales-cycle, pipeline,
forecasting, etc.).
👉  Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas
clearly and succinctly
👉  You are a hunter who sees the value of outbound prospecting to grow your own
sales pipeline, in addition to inbound leads
👉  Ability to reach and develop relationships with C-level executives
👉 Have experience working in a start/scale-up environment

Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.

Our benefits

Great benefits make a big difference. Not just to employees, but to the whole vibe of a business. That’s why when you work for us, you’ll enjoy a full spectrum of generous perks, rewards and office benefits.

  • Competitve annual leave (excluding bank holidays) and December holiday office closure days on top
  • Flexitime
  • Early finishes on Fridays (4:30pm weekly, and 1pm during summer)
  • Work from Anywhere in the world - up to 15 days
  • Hybrid home/office working
  • Latest tech equipment + WFH office budget
  • A genuine commitment to mental and physical health, with a range of content, tools, and perks to help you look after your wellbeing
  • OneGWI - the team that focuses on D&I in the workplace
  • And more!

Who we are

GWI was founded with the knowledge that understanding your audience is really important for business. When you know who you’re speaking to and why, you can create content and campaigns that stand out to the people that matter.

Through our global online survey, we gather data on the behaviour and perceptions of consumers across the world. This provides businesses with deep, actionable insights on their audience, revealed from data they trust.

It’s been going well, too. Since launching in 2009, we’ve become one of the UK’s fastest growing target audience companies. We’re not about to stop growing any time soon. As a business, we’re on a mission to re-engineer data-driven marketing, and we’re on the lookout for talented people to join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

Imagine if our data came from just one kind of person. We’d get a very nuanced view of the world. And we definitely wouldn’t have got off the ground as a business.

Although things certainly aren’t perfect, we live in a society where differences are increasingly celebrated – so we’d expect nothing else from our teams.  In fact, the GWI office is as diverse as our global data, it’s really important to us that it stays that way.  This is a place to feel at home, express yourself freely and make your mark.

title: Senior Amazon Retail Media Consultant (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:

Joining our team of 100+ marketplace specialists across diverse disciplines, you will lead complex, multi-market client portfolios and drive growth across the entire customer journey. In this role, you will connect the dots between Retail, Sponsored Ads, Amazon DSP, AMC, and overarching digital marketing strategies. You will act as a trusted strategic advisor for clients, a mentor for junior colleagues, and a key driver of innovation within our team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Client Management & Strategy

Team Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing

WE OFFER

  • Occasional breakfast/lunch at the office, Smoothie Tuesdays;

  • Future Bens - Exclusive access to sustainable, healthy products at attractive deals;
  • Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform;
  • Social events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations;
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards;
  • Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Compliance team at Payward plays a critical role in enabling the company to grow responsibly while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory environment. Our teams work across jurisdictions and product lines to design and maintain scalable compliance frameworks that support Payward’s mission while ensuring regulatory obligations are met.

The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Scale Team is responsible for ensuring the FIU can scale, across new operating jurisdictions and new products, effectively and efficiently. The team leads AML transaction monitoring and blockchain monitoring to ensure thresholds are appropriately set, tested, and governed while reducing false positives and maintaining strong oversight. In addition, the team focuses on identifying efficiencies in process workflows and implementing automation across the FIU. Scale works closely with external vendor, Compliance, and internal technology teams.

  

The opportunity

  • Lead transaction monitoring optimization, including rule testing, threshold tuning, and the design and rollout of new monitoring scenarios to improve detection quality and reduce false positives

  • Identify and drive automation and workflow improvements across FIU processes to increase operational efficiency and effectiveness

  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including LLM and AI-enabled tools, to enhance alert triage, investigations, SAR filing and FIU operational capabilities

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to support vendor integrations, monitoring infrastructure improvements, and FIU tooling enhancements

  • Collaborate with Compliance leadership, including RCOs and MLROs, to maintain well-governed transaction monitoring frameworks aligned with regulatory expectations

  • Support FIU scalability by designing processes and monitoring strategies that enable expansion into new products, regions, and increased transaction volumes

  

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in AML, financial crime compliance, or FIU operations, with deep knowledge of transaction monitoring frameworks, suspicious activity detection, and regulatory expectations under BSA/AML regimes

  • 3+ years of experience designing, testing, and tuning transaction monitoring rules, including threshold optimization, scenario design, and alert reduction strategies

  • 3+ years of experience working with transaction monitoring systems and compliance tooling, including case management platforms, monitoring infrastructure, and investigative workflows

  • Experience working in a regulated financial institution, preferably one licensed to operate in the EU, UK, and/or United States

  • Experience driving process optimization or automation initiatives within compliance or financial crime programs to improve operational efficiency and scalability

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, or Operations teams to implement monitoring controls, vendor integrations, or compliance technology solutions

  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with experience using metrics, dashboards, and data analysis to evaluate monitoring effectiveness and improve detection quality

  • Experience operating in fast-growing fintech, payments, or crypto environments, with the ability to design scalable compliance controls that support new product launches and geographic expansion

  • Experience working with AI, machine learning, or LLM-enabled compliance tools, including investigative automation or alert triage technologies

  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, or similar crypto investigative platforms

  • Experience supporting vendor selection, implementation, or integration of regtech solutions

  

Nice to haves

  • ACAMS, CAMS-Audit, CFCS, or similar financial crime certifications

   

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data Engineering SAP BW / SAP Datasphere
descriptionHtml:
Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt.

Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten?

Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Unser SAP-Kerngeschäft bauen wir dabei gezielt zu einer Multi-Vendor-Strategie aus – mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio sowie den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS (u. a. Amazon Athena). Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du berätst Kunden sowie KollegInnen, analysierst gemeinsam mit deinem Team die fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen und setzt diese in Data-Engineering-Lösungen auf Basis des SAP-Portfolios (SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Data Cloud) um. Dabei tauchst du in die Geschäftsprozesse der Kunden ein und lieferst das entsprechende Datenmanagement.
  • In der Funktion des Senior Consultants übernimmst du die Verantwortung für das Projekt und das Windhoff Projektteam.
  • Da dein Schwerpunkt im Backend liegt, konzipierst und implementierst du Datenmodelle und ETL-Strecken – zunehmend auch in hybriden Szenarien, in denen SAP mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio oder den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS zusammenspielt.
  • Du bist ebenfalls am Test und an der Übergabe in den Echtbetrieb beim Kunden beteiligt.
  • Du begeisterst dich für neueste Technologien wie die SAP Business Data Cloud sowie Databricks und denkst im Sinne unserer Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern mit.
  • Durch Wissenstransfer, Projektpräsentationen und interne wie externe Technologie-Events gibst du dein Wissen an KollegInnen weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im SAP Data Engineering mit Schwerpunkt SAP BW/BW4HANA und SAP Datasphere mit.
  • Du beherrschst LSA/LSA++, ABAP, AMDP, CDS und SQL-Script sicher.
  • Ergänzende Erfahrungen mit Frontend-Tools wie SAP Analysis for Office und der SAP Analytics Cloud sind gerne gesehen und runden dein Profil ab.
  • Snowflake, Dremio sowie die Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS sind für dich kein Fremdkörper, sondern Teil einer ganzheitlichen Dateninfrastruktur rund um den SAP-Kern.
  • Du begeisterst dich für aktuelle Trends & Methoden, neueste Technologien und Standards.
  • Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung darin, agentische KI in deinen Arbeitsalltag und die Durchführung von Data-Engineering-Projekten zu integrieren. Dafür stellen wir dir ein modernes Toolset mit verschiedenen Integrationsmöglichkeiten (u. a. MCP-Server und agentische Frameworks) rund um unseren SAP-Kern bereit.
  • Durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit bringst du deine Ideen sowohl intern als auch im Umfeld unserer Kunden erfolgreich ein. Hierfür sind auch verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich.

Benefits

  • Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du kannst – je nach Projekt – zu 90 % von zuhause aus oder an einem unserer Standorte arbeiten, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Zu gelegentlichen Kundenterminen und Teamevents startest du von deinem Lebensmittelpunkt aus, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst.
  • 130 Data & Analytics Consultants zum Austausch sowie eine interne Weiterbildungsacademy
  • Langfristige Projekte mit wechselnden technologischen Herausforderungen
  • Ein festes Budget für Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • Eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Überstundenausgleich sowie bis zu 40 Tagen Urlaub
  • Sowohl erstklassige Hard- und Softwareausstattung als auch Leasingangebote für Firmenwagen, IT-Hardware und Fahrräder
  • Kurze Wege im Unternehmen, ein fairer Umgang miteinander sowie unterhaltsame Teamevents

Du verfügst über die gewünschten Erfahrungen und suchst eine neue Herausforderung? Du bist flexibel, lösungsorientiert und kommunikationsfähig?

Nutze deine Chance: Wir bieten das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

title: Senior Consultant - Satcom Constellation Design & simulation
descriptionHtml:
Are you a highly-motivated, technically-minded, critical thinker with 3-5 years of experience in consulting, looking for your next challenge? Join a leading consulting player in the booming space industry! The Technology Consulting business line is the technology and operations’ arm of the Novaspace group. It has more than 50 customers in developed and emerging space markets, in all regions of the world and across the space ecosystem, including satellite operators, governmental and international organizations (Space agencies, Defense agencies, regulatory bodies, etc.), financial institutions (private banks, commercial banks, private equity funds, etc.) and insurance brokers and insurance companies. Novaspace Technology has developed expertise and know-how around a portfolio of services and capabilities covering the complete lifecycle of a space project, from feasibility studies and project development to operations and training support. We are looking for a motivated Senior Consultant - Satcom Constellation Design & Simulation to join our team in Toulouse to support clients in technical consulting projects on future & current Satcom Constellations Systems mainly for concept analysis (early-stage definition of Satcom payloads by generating and assessing innovative design concepts) and system feasibility analysis (generation, trade-off & comparison of several preliminary communication system high level design). If this sounds like you, then read on!
Primary role and responsibilities
  • End to End Engineering of Satcom Constellation System to support customer in designing, sizing, optimization, specification, assessment, construction, testing, & operation of satellite communication systems.
    • It includes:
  • Transformation of Customer’s need into key parameters driving the Satcom Constellation Design, production and justification of several Satcom Constellation preliminary design answering customer’s requirements, underlining solutions/recommendation/adjustments when trade off (cost/time/complexity) are necessary, assessment of costs of a Communication System (CAPEX, OPEX) and performance of cost trade-offs,
  • Generation of simulations to asses/demonstrate performance/limitation/uses cases
  • Production of payload technical analysis (performance & capacity assessment, , assessment of intersystem and intra-system interference, Traffic pattern, Hand Over , Gateway positioning, Intersatellite links…)

    • Desired skills & experience
  • MSc in space engineering with a major preferably in telecommunications
  • At least 7 years of practical industry experience in satellite communications field including at least 3 years of proven practical experience in supporting Satcom Constellation Design (using different type of payload processed or not, passive or active antennas, using intersatellite links), technical performance assessment and simulation with deep understanding of the key performance parameters driving the design /trade offs in operational scenarios
  • Knowledge of spectrum regulatory aspects
  • Proven ability to address technical problems using the most efficient means, including mathematical analysis, computer simulation and experimentation. You will be expected to maintain a high level of computer literacy (python, matlab, etc..)
  • Proven ability to appreciate the commercial and operational requirements in order to define the best compromise between price, performance and operational aspects (complexity, easy implementation, development risks and implementation costs).
  • Well organized and autonomous
  • Great team spirit and rigor.
  • Ability to summarize efficiently complex information to a short presentation or produce a single intelligible content from multiple sources.
  • Proficiency in writing reports and presentations with a high level of quality.
  • Good presentation and communication skills, able to present content with ease in front of an audience, to interface smoothly with other Novaspace team member and customers, from different cultures and background.
  • Ability to travel, as you will be able to work at our clients' sites or operations anywhere in the world: Europe, Middle East, Asia, the Americas, etc
  • Fully fluent in English
  • EU citizen
    • About Novaspace Novaspace is the global leading consulting firm in the space sector. With a robust 40-year legacy of expertise in guiding private companies and government entities through strategic decisionmaking processes, Novaspace offers end-to-end consulting services, from project strategy definition to implementation, providing data-led perspectives on critical issues. Our mission is to empower clients with strategic and technical insights, enabling them to navigate and seize new opportunities within the rapidly evolving space sector. As a privately owned and fully independent organization, Novaspace presents an expanded portfolio of services, featuring combined expertise in management and technology consulting, top-tier executive summits, and market intelligence. Trusted by 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace has offices strategically located in Brussels, Montreal, Munich, Paris, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington D.C. Working at Novaspace will give you the opportunity to boost your career in the space/consulting industry where our role is to support the decision-makers by providing them the highest quality support in everything we do: consulting, market intelligence, training and summits. Only Applications containing a Motivation Letter and a CV in English will be considered.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
hellomed ist die führende digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegeunternehmen – nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach!

Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinweisungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben.

Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße – namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt.

Für unsere größeren Kunden – Pflegedienstketten, Heime und Träger mit mehreren Standorten – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Partnerschaften betreut, ausbaut und unsere Kundenbetreuung mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

  • Größere Kunden betreuen: Du betreust unsere größeren Kunden wie Pflegedienstketten, Heime und Träger – von der Einführung bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit. Du bist feste Ansprechperson für Geschäftsführungen, Regional- und Pflegedienstleitungen und führst mit ihnen regelmäßige Gespräche: Was läuft gut, wo gibt es Potenzial, was braucht der Kunde als Nächstes?

  • Nutzung steigern: Du sorgst dafür, dass an den Standorten deiner Kunden möglichst alle Patienten über hellomed versorgt werden, und schulst Pflegeteams und Leitungen im sicheren Umgang mit hellomedOS – vor Ort und digital.

  • Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Du erkennst, wo wir bei bestehenden Kunden weitere Standorte versorgen können, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb um. So machst du deine Kundenbeziehungen wirtschaftlich erfolgreicher: mehr Standorte und Patienten pro Kunde, weniger Kündigungen.

  • Kundenbetreuung mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du unsere Abläufe in der Kundenbetreuung weiter und gibst deine Erfahrung an Kollegen im Team weiter.

  • Perspektive: Mit wachsendem Team und deinem Erfolg bei unseren Kunden kannst du perspektivisch die Verantwortung für unsere gesamte Customer-Success-Funktion übernehmen.

Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Betreuung oder im Ausbau von Geschäftskunden mit, zum Beispiel als Key Account Manager, Kundenbetreuer oder im Vertrieb, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen. Alternativ hast du Leitungserfahrung in der Pflege (z. B. als Pflegedienst-, Einrichtungs- oder Regionalleitung) und Freude an Kundenkontakt und Wachstum.

  • Erfahrung mit größeren Kunden: Du hast bereits Kunden mit mehreren Standorten betreut und trittst gegenüber Geschäftsführungen sicher und überzeugend auf.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich und baust schnell Vertrauen auf – bei Pflegekräften ebenso wie bei Geschäftsführern.

  • Sprache: Du kommunizierst sicher und souverän auf Deutsch (mind. C1) – im Pflegealltag unserer Kunden ist das der Schlüssel zu Vertrauen.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest zuverlässig und organisiert, behältst auch bei mehreren Kunden mit vielen Standorten den Überblick und hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen.

  • Technische Offenheit: Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System oder Pflegesoftware ist von Vorteil.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du besuchst unsere Kunden regelmäßig vor Ort (max. 1/3 der Arbeitszeit).

  • Haltung statt Lebenslauf: Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung – entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung und dein Anspruch an gute Kundenbetreuung.

Benefits

  • Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit Arbeitsplatz in unserem brandneuen Büro am Mehringdamm im Herzen Berlin-Kreuzbergs, mit guter Verkehrsanbindung.

  • Du profitierst von einer überdurchschnittlichen Bezahlung mit attraktiver Bonuskomponente, die sich am Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen orientiert.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für eine ganze Funktion und arbeitest direkt an der Seite der hellomed-Gründer – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen.

  • Du erhältst monatlich 50 € steuerfreien Sachbezug (gesetzlicher Höchstbetrag), frei einlösbar bei über 100 Marken wie Amazon, REWE, IKEA oder Urban Sports Club. Alternativ erstatten wir dir dein Deutschlandticket.

  • Wir verstehen, dass das Leben flexibel sein muss. Daher bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten mit 2 Tagen Home-Office pro Woche in einer geregelten 5-Tage-Woche – die anderen 3 Tage arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg.

  • Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir einen Dienstwagen oder eine Bahncard zur Verfügung, um dich bei Kundenterminen und Reisen optimal zu unterstützen.

  • Du hast 27 Urlaubstage plus einen zusätzlichen Tag für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit.

  • Wir versorgen dich täglich mit Getränken, und bei regelmäßigen Teamevents sorgen wir für unvergessliche gemeinsame Momente.

  • Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen. Du hast jederzeit die Möglichkeit, dich weiterzubilden oder Schulungen zu besuchen.

title: Senior CX Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Senior CX Strategist

Company: VML UK
Location: London – Sea Containers House, SE1
Working Model: Hybrid
Reporting to: Head of Planning

Who We Are

At VML, we are a global creative company that brings together brand experience, customer experience and commerce to create connected brands and drive growth.

We combine creativity, strategy, data and technology to help some of the world's biggest brands build meaningful relationships with their customers. From shaping brand experiences to designing connected customer journeys, we believe the best work happens when different perspectives and capabilities come together.

We're now looking for a Senior CX Strategist to join our London strategy team.

The Opportunity

Most brands don't have a communications problem. They have an experience problem. A gap between what they promise and what customers actually experience at the moments that matter.

We're looking for a Senior CX Strategist who can help close that gap.

Someone who understands that great customer experience isn't just about individual touchpoints, CRM campaigns or digital journeys. It's about connecting the entire customer experience, from the first interaction with a brand through to building long-term relationships, loyalty and advocacy.

You'll bring together CX, CRM and brand-level thinking, using customer insight, creativity and data to develop strategies that make experiences better for customers and more effective for businesses.

You'll work across a range of exciting clients, including major global brands, helping them understand their customers, identify opportunities and create more connected, meaningful experiences.

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting under the skin of a business challenge, asking the right questions and turning complex customer problems into clear, inspiring strategic thinking.

You'll be comfortable working with creative teams, collaborating with data and experience specialists, and presenting your thinking to clients.

Above all, you'll be someone who sees the bigger picture but isn't afraid to get into the detail.

What You'll Be Doing

Connecting Brand, CX and CRM

  • Develop integrated customer experience strategies that connect brand ambition with real customer needs and behaviours.

  • Look across the entire customer journey, identifying opportunities to create more seamless, engaging and valuable experiences.

  • Bring together brand strategy, CRM, digital experiences and customer engagement to create joined-up strategic thinking.

  • Understand how different channels and touchpoints work together, from brand communications and social to digital, commerce, CRM and physical experiences.

  • Help clients move beyond individual campaigns and channels to think about the wider customer relationship.

Turning Insight into Strategy

  • Use customer research, behavioural insights, data and market understanding to uncover meaningful opportunities.

  • Map customer journeys, identify pain points and understand the moments that matter most.

  • Translate complex business and customer challenges into clear strategic recommendations and compelling creative briefs.

  • Develop customer propositions, experience principles and strategic frameworks that inspire creative and experience design teams.

  • Challenge existing thinking and bring fresh perspectives to how brands engage with their customers.

Making Customer Experience More Effective

  • Work closely with data and analytics teams to understand customer behaviour and identify opportunities for growth.

  • Develop strategies that improve customer acquisition, engagement, retention, loyalty and lifetime value.

  • Understand how to measure the effectiveness of customer experiences and connect customer outcomes to business performance.

  • Help define meaningful KPIs and measurement frameworks that demonstrate the impact of strategic recommendations.

  • Use performance insights to identify what's working, what isn't and where experiences can be improved.

Bringing Strategy to Life

  • Partner with Creative, Experience Design, Data, Technology and Client Services teams to turn strategic thinking into meaningful customer experiences.

  • Write clear, inspiring briefs that give creative teams a strong foundation to develop ideas.

  • Contribute strategic thinking throughout the creative development process, ensuring ideas remain grounded in customer insight and business objectives.

  • Help connect strategic ambition with practical execution across different channels and customer touchpoints.

  • Bring curiosity, fresh thinking and a willingness to challenge the expected.

Building Strong Client Relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with clients, becoming someone they turn to for thoughtful, informed strategic advice.

  • Present recommendations clearly and confidently, making complex thinking easy to understand.

  • Work alongside senior strategists and wider teams to identify opportunities to develop existing client relationships.

  • Contribute to pitches, proactive ideas and new business opportunities.

  • Support and mentor more junior team members, sharing knowledge and helping strengthen the wider strategy team.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with genuine curiosity about people, brands and the experiences that connect them.

You don't need to have worked across every aspect of CX, but you should have a strong understanding of how customer experience, CRM and brand strategy come together.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Solid experience in CX, CRM, customer engagement or integrated strategy, gained within an agency, consultancy or client-side environment.

  • A strong understanding of end-to-end customer journeys, including acquisition, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention and loyalty.

  • The ability to connect customer experience thinking with wider brand strategy and business objectives.

  • Experience developing customer-centric strategies, journey maps, propositions and creative briefs.

  • Confidence working with customer data, research and behavioural insights to inform strategic recommendations.

  • An understanding of how customer experience can drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience working across multiple channels and touchpoints, including digital, CRM, content, social and physical experiences.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to present strategic thinking to clients and internal teams.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work closely with creative, data, technology and experience specialists.

  • A genuine interest in how customer behaviours, technology and emerging trends are changing the way people interact with brands.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience working with automotive, FMCG or other major consumer brands.

  • An understanding of retail, dealership or complex customer journeys.

  • Experience contributing to pitches or identifying opportunities for client growth.

  • An interest in AI and emerging technologies and how they can improve customer experiences.

The Kind of Person You'll Be

Curious about people

You're genuinely interested in understanding what makes people tick. You ask questions, challenge assumptions and look beyond the obvious to uncover what customers really need.

Creative in your thinking

You believe strategy should inspire great work, not just explain a problem. You can turn insight into ideas and enjoy collaborating with creative teams to bring those ideas to life.

Comfortable with complexity

You can see the bigger picture while understanding the detail. You're able to connect different parts of a customer journey and turn complicated challenges into clear, actionable thinking.

Commercially minded

You understand that great customer experiences need to deliver value for both customers and businesses. You're interested in effectiveness and can connect strategic recommendations to meaningful outcomes.

Collaborative and confident

You enjoy working with different disciplines, sharing ideas and learning from others. You're confident expressing a point of view, but equally open to being challenged.

What's in It for You?

  • The opportunity to work with some of the world's most recognised brands on meaningful customer experience challenges.

  • A genuinely integrated environment where CX, brand strategy, creativity, data, commerce and technology come together.

  • The chance to shape experiences across the entire customer journey rather than being limited to a single channel.

  • A collaborative and supportive strategy team where your ideas and perspective will be valued.

  • Opportunities to develop your strategic craft, broaden your experience and progress your career.

  • Hybrid working from our London office at Sea Containers House.

  • A competitive salary and access to VML and WPP benefits.

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging

At VML, we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and backgrounds make us stronger and help us create better work.

We're committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, supported and able to thrive.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, and if you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Interested?

If you're a strategist who loves understanding people, connecting the dots between brands and customer experiences, and creating work that makes a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Come and help us shape experiences that are as creatively ambitious as they are commercially effective.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Financial Flows
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Financial Flows team, you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end data pipelines, predictive models, and cloud infrastructure powering Kpler’s commodity finance analytics. You will lead the modernization of our data foundation, spearheading the migration of production services to AWS and re-architecting legacy calculation engines into clean, performant Python services. Operating at the crossroads of quantitative research and cloud infrastructure, your work will directly ensure that market participants receive real-time, mission-critical insights across global commodities markets.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate resilient batch and real-time streaming data ingestion pipelines connecting to external financial market data providers via APIs and WebSockets.

  • Lead the architectural migration of legacy backend infrastructure to modern cloud-native environments on AWS, establishing high standards for system reliability and scalability.

  • Drive the refactoring and rewrite of the CTA positioning indicator calculation blocks from PHP to Python, ensuring strict mathematical output parity, comprehensive test coverage, and optimized latency.

  • Ingest and model complex financial datasets—including futures pricing, open interest, and trading volumes—across time-series stores and search engines like QuestDB and Elasticsearch.

  • Implement automated data validation, proactive alerting, and system monitoring to ensure market data feeds remain accurate, continuous, and fault-tolerant.

  • Deploy, maintain, and scale containerized services across Docker and Kubernetes environments using automated CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows.

  • Partner closely with quantitative researchers, commodity analysts, and product managers to translate complex trading models into high-performance production pipelines.

  • Provide technical mentorship to peer engineers, raising team-wide engineering rigor through thoughtful code reviews, system design guidance, and architectural documentation.


Experience & Background

What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • 5+ years of professional experience building, operating, and scaling production-grade data pipelines and backend infrastructure.

  • Advanced expertise in Python, with a strong background refactoring and rewriting production-critical code for performance and testability.

  • Proven hands-on experience building and maintaining real-time or streaming API ingestion pipelines (REST, WebSockets) handling time-series datasets.

  • Solid production experience deploying and managing containerized applications on AWS using Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Strong database fundamentals in SQL and experience working with distributed search or time-series databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, QuestDB, ClickHouse).

  • Deep experience establishing automated data quality frameworks, observability (monitoring/alerting), and root-cause troubleshooting for production systems.

    • Nice-to-haves

    • Domain knowledge of financial market structures, futures contracts, open interest, and commodities trading symbology.

    • Experience integrating data from major financial market vendors (e.g., Bloomberg, LSEG, Enverus, Trading Technologies).

    • Familiarity with legacy PHP codebase migration or reading PHP algorithms to translate into Python.

    • Practical familiarity with GitOps frameworks and infrastructure-as-code tooling.

title: Senior Data Engineer I (Data Platform)
descriptionHtml:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

Location: London office / Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)

Reporting to: Data Engineering Manager

The Role

Millions of people visit the Rightmove website every month. We have a huge amount of data about how people use the site, and what this means to our customers.

You’ll be joining our growing Data Engineering & Infrastructure team, a collaborative, high-performing group of engineers that uses this data to build the infrastructure that powers the UK’s favourite property site.

In this role, you will take ownership of the systems and infrastructure that ingest, process, and serve data across Rightmove. You will be responsible for the infrastructure, tooling, and engineering practices that power our data ecosystem, including data ingestion, orchestration, storage, and the developer experience for data producers and consumers.

You will bring strong hands-on expertise to our GCP-based data platform, design reusable patterns and tools, write robust Python and SQL, and deploy infrastructure with Terraform, while influencing the standards and technical decisions that the wider data engineering team works to.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be a technical leader and multiplier within the data platform team. You will own the infrastructure, frameworks, and internal tooling that power Rightmove’s data ecosystem. You will contribute to the technical direction for how data is ingested, processed, and served across the business, and consistently apply and promote engineering best practices that raise the quality of the team’s work.

Join an inclusive and collaborative engineering culture where you'll work alongside talented engineers, tackle complex technical challenges, and continue to grow your skills. You'll leverage a modern GCP stack and apply your data engineering expertise to build products and services used by millions across the UK every day.

A note from your future manager: "This role designs and builds the pipelines and infrastructure that keep our data flowing reliably, so every team can build with confidence and speed."

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define the technical approach to our most complex and ambiguous data challenges, setting direction where others would wait for clarity, making high-quality architectural decisions, and ensuring the right trade-offs are made for the long-term health of the platform
  • Own the end-to-end technical leadership of cross-functional projects, from shaping requirements with product owners and domain teams through to delivery. Take accountability for outcomes, not just the engineering contribution
  • Design and build data platform infrastructure and internal tooling, contributing to the architectural direction for how teams across Rightmove work with data
  • Own the design and evolution of reusable batch and real-time data ingestion and processing frameworks, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and serve the needs of teams across the business
  • Manage infrastructure, security and code deployment with Terraform and CI/CD pipelines

  • Champion engineering best practices across the team, including testing, documentation, and observability, share knowledge and support others through code reviews and technical discussions, helping raise the bar and embed standards in how the team works
  • Partner with engineers, data scientists, and analytics teams to enable self-service data workflows, acting as a technical enabler and setting the patterns others follow

We're Looking For Someone Who

  • Has a strong track record of delivering significant impact in data engineering or data platform engineering, with deep experience building and operating large-scale, cloud-based data platforms
  • Thrives in ambiguity, able to define the problem, identify the right technical approach, and drive complex cross-functional projects to completion without needing fully formed requirements
  • Is a strong Python and SQL engineer, with mastery of software engineering fundamentals, and is able to raise the standard across the team
  • Has deep, hands-on experience with GCP (or comparable cloud platforms) and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform, and can influence how the team approaches cloud engineering
  • Has a strong track record of designing, building, and operating production-grade data pipelines and real-time processing frameworks at scale
  • Has built and managed CI/CD pipelines for data and infrastructure, and can lead the team in adopting reliable, automated deployment practices
  • Has a track record of raising the technical bar across the team through introducing better practices, leading technical reviews, and driving engineering improvements that outlast individual projects
  • Has knowledge of GDPR and data security best practices
  • Understands data storage, data modelling principles, best practices and tools (e.g. dbt)
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, able to lead design discussions, articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and build alignment across teams
  • Is curious, self-directed, and proactive, identifying problems before they are assigned, and drives improvements to the platform without being asked

Life at Rightmove

Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here!  We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:

  • We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

The team

We are a mission-driven team of 80 engineers based in London and the surrounding areas, united by the challenge of fixing healthcare communication. We are innovating for the NHS at a scale and depth that has never been done before, solving the real-world problems that stand between millions of patients and the care they need.

We are a highly cross-functional group where engineering, product, data, and security collaborate as true peers. We foster a low-ego, high-impact environment that values expertise and new ideas, maintaining the high standards required to build and scale a national healthcare communication platform. Within this ecosystem, our teams operate with high autonomy, owning everything from initial system design to long-term service stability.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of our Analytics Engineering, Product, and ML teams, designing and scaling the pipelines and data architecture that everything else is built on, and building the foundations that turn data from a support function into a strategic asset.

Challenges you’ll solve…

  • You will design and scale a robust data architecture that handles massive event-driven communication flows across nearly every GP practice in the UK.

  • You will build and own ingestion and ELT pipelines end-to-end, from source systems through to our Snowflake data warehouse, using Python and SQL in production.

  • You will make and own architectural decisions that support analytics, experimentation and machine learning at scale.

  • You will partner closely with Analytics Engineering, Product and ML teams to turn raw healthcare communication data into reliable, high-performance datasets they can build on.

  • You will set and uphold standards for data integrity, security and reliability, in an environment where getting data right is part of keeping patients safe.

  • You will lay the data foundations for our AI and ML work, helping take models from experimentation into production.

  • You will take on greenfield problems, shaping how data works at Accurx from the ground up.

  • You will mentor teammates and contribute to a strong engineering culture through rigorous code reviews, sprint planning and open collaboration.

You should apply if…

  • You have strong, proven experience as a Data Engineer, designing and building ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines from scratch using Python and SQL in production environments.

  • You have a deep understanding of modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift, and transformation tools like dbt, with a focus on creating clean, reliable and reusable datasets.

  • You are comfortable owning decisions around data architecture, and working with cloud environments and software engineering best practices like Git and CI/CD.

  • You have experience, or a strong interest, in building and operationalising machine learning models, and understand how strong data foundations enable better AI outcomes.

  • You think beyond pipelines. You care about how data drives real-world outcomes, especially in healthcare, and can work cross-functionally to shape problems and deliver solutions.

  • You actively leverage AI tools to automate routine tasks and continuously explore ways to integrate AI into your workflows, improving quality and speed.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers.

  • £85,000 - £105,000 base salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £30,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead.

Responsibilities:

  • Start from the Customer: Understand what homeowners and partners need from a match, and turn that into the outcomes and guardrails your models optimize for, not just model metrics.
  • Own Our Matching Models: Build and run the models behind our partner matching, end to end: data, features, training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
  • Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand.
  • Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales.
  • Build the Data Foundation: Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role.
  • Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome.

  • Production-grade Python and advanced SQL, plus hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark).
  • Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud ML platform (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow).
  • Solid foundation in experiment design and causal inference, ideally in a marketplace where test and control groups affect each other.

  • A product mindset: you define success in homeowner and partner outcomes, challenge assumptions with evidence, and add complexity only where it earns its place.

title: Senior Databasebeheerder (deeltijd 16 uur)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren databasespecialist die zijn technische expertise wil inzetten voor complexe vraagstukken en de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern dataplatform? Wil je bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige databasediensten binnen een maatschappelijke organisatie, maar zoek je bewust een functie voor 16 uur per week? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Senior Database Specialist versterk je ons team met specialistische kennis van Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL. Je richt je vooral op complexe technische vraagstukken, verbeteringen en vernieuwing. De dagelijkse operatie ligt bij het team; jij helpt juist daar waar extra expertise, verdieping of richting nodig is.

Onze databasediensten vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van de technische infrastructuur van het CBS. Beschikbaarheid, performance, veiligheid en continuïteit zijn daarbij essentieel. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkelen we onze dienstverlening verder door meer te automatiseren, nieuwe databaseservices te onderzoeken en onze infrastructuur verder te moderniseren.

Met jouw ervaring help je het team bij vraagstukken die verder gaan dan het dagelijkse beheer. Je analyseert complexe problemen, adviseert over technische keuzes en helpt structurele verbeteringen te realiseren. Daarbij werk je zowel met onze bestaande MSSQL- en PostgreSQL-omgevingen als aan de ontwikkeling van toekomstige databasediensten.

Omdat je 16 uur per week werkt, ligt de nadruk op werkzaamheden waarvoor jouw senior expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt:

  • analyseren en oplossen van complexe vraagstukken rondom MSSQL en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance, troubleshooting en database-optimalisatie;

  • adviseren over databasearchitectuur, high availability, disaster recovery, lifecycle management en de verwerking van grote hoeveelheden data;

  • initiëren en uitvoeren van structurele technische verbeteringen en bijdragen aan upgrades, migraties en automatisering van databasewerkzaamheden;

  • bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe databasediensten, waaronder Database as a Service en toekomstige technologieën zoals graphdatabases;

  • meedenken over de verdere modernisering van het platform, waaronder containerisatie, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code en CI/CD;

  • verbeteren van monitoring, logging, capaciteitsbeheer, back-up- en restorevoorzieningen, encryptie, autorisaties en informatiebeveiliging en jouw kennis delen met collega’s en andere technische specialisten.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je komt te werken in Team Data & Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). De afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 IT-professionals die werkzaam zijn vanuit Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Team Data & Webdiensten bestaat uit ongeveer 15 collega’s.

Binnen het team werken we Agile in combinatie met ITIL. We gebruiken Azure DevOps om het werk inzichtelijk te maken en werken met stories en epics. Ook nemen we deel aan vaste momenten zoals dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Met 16 uur per week maak je volwaardig onderdeel uit van het team, maar verwachten we niet dat je iedere operationele taak oppakt. In overleg bepalen we waar jouw expertise het meeste verschil kan maken. Je werkt daardoor nauw samen met de collega’s die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor de databasediensten en ondersteunt hen bij complexere technische vraagstukken en ontwikkelingen.
We werken met collega’s op verschillende locaties en vanuit verschillende specialismen. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren databasespecialist die snel tot de kern van een technisch vraagstuk komt. Je hoeft niet voortdurend bij de dagelijkse operatie betrokken te zijn om te begrijpen wat er speelt en bent in staat om binnen je beschikbare tijd duidelijke prioriteiten te stellen.

Je combineert diepgaande databasekennis met een bredere blik op infrastructuur, automatisering en security. Je denkt niet alleen in tijdelijke oplossingen, maar zoekt naar structurele verbeteringen die ook op langere termijn waarde toevoegen.

Daarnaast kun je jouw technische afwegingen helder uitleggen. Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met andere technische disciplines, deelt je kennis en kunt collega’s adviseren zonder het werk van hen over te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • hbo-werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren relevante ervaring met het ontwerpen, beheren en optimaliseren van databaseomgevingen;

  • aantoonbare en diepgaande ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance tuning, troubleshooting, back-up/restore en high availability;

  • ervaring met Windows- en Linux-serveromgevingen en automatisering met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Bash en/of Python;

  • kennis van databasebeveiliging, waaronder encryptie, autorisaties, informatiebeveiliging en compliance;

  • kennis van Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD en DevOps-werkwijzen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Ansible;

  • kennis van ITIL-processen, sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding gericht op kennisdeling en continue verbetering.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Microsoft SQL Server en/of PostgreSQL zijn een pré.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

Today, we are a global brand, but our values remain the same; we are committed to improving our impact on people and the planet. To do this our people are honest, dynamic, and community spirited.
If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team.
The Role: To design the Women’s Ready-to-Wear (RTW) collections, working under the direction of the Design Director and contributing to the development of creative, commercially relevant and distinctive collections that reflect the Mulberry aesthetic. The Senior RTW Designer will take ownership of design projects from initial research and concept development through to sampling, fittings and PPS.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Research

  • Carry out research in line with the creative direction established by the Design Director and Creative Director, proactively identifying opportunities to develop and evolve the collection.
  • Demonstrate resourcefulness across a variety of research techniques, including library, online, archive and market research.
  • Identify inspiring references for silhouette, proportion, fabric, colour, print, texture, garment construction and finishing.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the luxury fashion landscape, identifying opportunities to introduce fresh perspectives whilst remaining true to the Mulberry brand.
  • Share research, knowledge and inspiration with the wider design team, supporting a collaborative and informed approach to design development.

Design

  • Design and develop the Women’s RTW collections, working under the direction of the Design Director to interpret the seasonal creative direction and translate it into a cohesive, distinctive and commercially relevant product offering.
  • Take ownership of design projects from initial concept through to final product, ensuring consistency of vision and quality throughout the development process.
  • Demonstrate strong creative judgement and the ability to develop original design ideas that balance innovation, wearability and commercial relevance.
  • Experiment with silhouette, proportion, fabrication, garment construction and detailing to create distinctive and varied collections.
  • Demonstrate confidence in developing ideas three-dimensionally through draping, toile development, garment manipulation and collaboration with pattern cutters and technical teams.
  • Apply an in-depth understanding of garment construction, fit, fabric behaviour and finishing to inform and strengthen design decisions.
  • Ensure individual designs proposals work cohesively within the wider collection, contributing to a balanced and considered product offering.
  • Present design concepts and proposals clearly and confidently, articulating the rationale behind creative decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure all designs are communicated effectively through accurate technical drawings, CADs, specifications and construction details, for the atelier and suppliers.
  • Manage workload and prioritise projects effectively, ensuring the critical path is adhered to, and all key deadlines are met.
  • Work collaboratively with the wider design, technical and production teams to ensure design intent is maintained throughout the product development process.
  • Maintain accurate records of design development, sample comments and amendments throughout the season.
  • Support the Junior RTW Designer in prioritising workload, improving technical accuracy and developing confidence and independence in their role.

Prototypes and Fittings

  • Take responsibility for ensuring prototypes and samples are developed and delivered in line with the critical path, working closely with product development
  • Lead or contribute to fit meetings and sample reviews, assessing garment fit, proportion, construction, fabric performance and overall appearance.
  • Provide clear, considered and technically accurate feedback to product development / suppliers, ensuring amendments are communicated efficiently and effectively.
  • Work collaboratively with pattern cutters, garment technicians and suppliers to resolve complex fit and construction issues. Demonstrate strong technical judgement when assessing samples, balancing creative intent with garment functionality and wearability.
  • Refine and improve designs throughout the sampling process, ensuring the final product reflects the original creative vision and meets the required quality standards.

Specifications and Production Handover

  • Work closely with the production development and technical teams to ensure product specifications are accurate, commercially viable and suitable for production handover.
  • Produce and oversee accurate technical sketches and CADs, ensuring all amendments following fittings and sample reviews are incorporated.
  • Ensure garment measurements, construction details, fabrications, trims and finishing specifications are clearly and accurately documented.

Culture:

  • Embrace and demonstrate the Mulberry values and behaviours: honesty, dynamism, and a community-oriented spirit.
  • Support Mulberry to deliver an inclusive culture, through behaving in a way that is open-minded and respectful towards others, and understanding that your views, opinions, and experiences may not always be shared by your colleagues.
  • Act as an ambassador for Mulberry and communicate positively about the brand.

Sustainability:

  • As a certified B Corp, we are committed to using business as a force for good. You’ll be encouraged to incorporate environmentally and socially responsible practices into your work, supporting our Made to Last strategy across Climate, Circularity, and Community.
  • Help foster a culture where diversity is celebrated and every individual feels valued, respected, and included. Champion equity, empathy, and understanding in all interactions - internally and externally.

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Appropriate degree in Fashion Design or a related discipline, supported by a strong portfolio.
  • Proven experience designing and developing a RTW collection from initial concept through to production at a similar level.
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern cutting principles, fit and technical specifications.
  • In-depth knowledge of fabrics, trims and garment finishes, with a strong appreciation of quality, craftsmanship and luxury product development.
  • Demonstrable ability to take creative ownership of projects, exercise independent design judgement and translate seasonal direction into commercially relevant product.
  • Experience supporting, mentoring or guiding junior members of a design team.
  • Confident communicator, able to present and articulate ideas clearly, both verbally and visually.
  • Collaborative and approachable, with the ability to build positive working relationships across the business and within the RTW team.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working within a fast-paced, evolving design environment.
  • Self-motivated, proactive and resourceful, with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Highly creative, with a strong individual approach to design and a clear understanding of the Mulberry aesthetic.

Computer Skills

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud and other appropriate CAD programmes.
  • Computer literate in Excel and Outlook.
  • Strong online research skills, including the ability to identify relevant design references, emerging trends and market opportunities.
