title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer, Cyber Defense
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We are hiring Detection & Response Engineers to decide what we detect, command the response when something is real, and automate everything in between, across enterprise, cloud, production, data centre, and operational technology environments.

You will work in a three-person regional rotation. Roughly one week in three, you hold the operational slot: taking escalations, deciding fast, and acting. The other two weeks are engineering. You find where our detection coverage is thin and work with our AI agents to close it, build automation that removes human time from the response path, and make sure we are ready for the next incident. When a serious incident lands, you command it.

If you have spent years closing the same ticket every Tuesday—and knowing exactly how to fix it for good, but never having the mandate—this is the job where that is the mandate.

What you'll be doing

Detection engineering

  • Map our detection coverage against attacker tradecraft and the real estate, and find where we are blind.
  • Turn coverage gaps, incidents, threat research, and recurring escalations into clear detection ideas, and work with our AI agents to build them.
  • Assess and tune the detection ideas and rule logic our agents propose, which run as shadow rules before they go live. Judge what each one catches, what it misses, and what its noise will cost.
  • Make the human call on promotion. You will rarely write a query from scratch, but nothing goes live without your judgement, and you are accountable for whether it is right.
  • Retire or retune live detections that are noisy, stale, or no longer relevant.
  • Identify telemetry gaps and make the business case for closing them.

Automation

  • Remove recurring toil from the response path: enrichment, triage, containment actions, case handling, and reporting.
  • Improve the agents that hold the first tier, so they resolve more on their own and escalate with better context. Every gain here cuts the human time per alert and lets us cover more attack surface.
  • Ship new capabilities in our internal security platform, such as response actions, integrations, and agent tooling, so every engineer and agent on the team gets faster, and prove each one works in production.

Incident command

  • Command security incidents: set objectives, coordinate responders across engineering, infrastructure, and service owners, and keep leadership informed.
  • Make containment calls under time pressure, knowing what you can do immediately, what requires authority, and what could disrupt production if handled incorrectly.
  • Run post-incident reviews that end in engineering work, not just a document.

Incident preparedness

  • Design and run tabletop exercises and recovery tests.
  • Keep playbooks and runbooks honest, and turn the steps that do not need a human into automation.
  • Make sure the evidence, access, knowledge, and authority we need in an incident are in place before we need them.

Your operational week

  • Take escalations from the agents and the managed provider, scope them against real asset and business context, decide, and act.
  • Execute approved containment, including isolating devices, revoking sessions, restricting access, blocking activity, and preserving evidence.
  • Ensure every escalation exits with a solve where one is warranted. Where the solve is a detection or automation, you build it with the agents. Where it is a control change, specify it clearly enough that the owning team can act without a second conversation.
  • Close every case with a security disposition, an owner, the evidence, actions taken, and any required follow-up.
  • Hold the managed provider to our standard for evidence, analysis, routing, and closure quality.

First 90 days

  • Learn the incident command, escalation, evidence, and handover model, and take a rotation slot.
  • Independently own escalations across common classes, with defensible dispositions and evidence that stands up.
  • Ship your first solve: a detection, automation, or control change that permanently retires a recurring alert class.
  • Map coverage for one area of the estate, name its top gaps, and work with the agents to close at least one.
  • Assess, tune, and promote your first agent-proposed detections to live.
  • Add your first feature to the internal security platform.
  • Shadow the incident commander on a real incident or exercise.
  • Name one telemetry gap with a business case behind it. Extra credit if it is in operational technology or building management systems, both of which we currently cannot see.

About You

  • 5+ years in detection engineering, incident response, security operations, threat hunting, security engineering, or related roles.
  • Detection judgement. You can read a rule and say what it catches, what it misses, and how noisy it will be in production. You think in coverage, not in individual alerts.
  • Fluency in modern attacker tradecraft, including credential theft, session abuse, phishing, malware execution, persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement, command and control, and exfiltration, and in how each shows up in telemetry.
  • Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux internals, including where attackers persist on each and what each one logs.
  • Incident command experience. You have led, or been central to, a significant incident: running the bridge, setting priorities, and keeping leadership informed without losing the technical thread.
  • Experience building in, and securing, public cloud environments like AWS and GCP
  • You automate what you repeat, using query languages, scripting, APIs, or workflow automation. When you hit the same problem a third time, your instinct is to build—not add another step to a runbook.
  • Hands-on investigation experience across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, network, or production workloads.
  • Sound judgement on containment under time pressure.
  • Willingness to challenge automated conclusions. You will work alongside AI agents every day, and their analysis and detection logic are inputs, not authorities. We expect you to validate them and notice when they are confidently wrong.
  • You write investigations another engineer can follow, escalations a leader can act on in thirty seconds, and case notes that still make sense to someone reading them two years later in an audit.
  • Calm and methodical when facts are incomplete or contradict each other.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and service owners who do not report to you.

Strong pluses

  • Operational technology, industrial control systems, building management systems, or critical facilities experience.
  • Cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data centres, HPC, or other availability-sensitive environments.
  • Detection-as-code, detection testing, adversary emulation, or purple teaming.
  • Building, tuning, or evaluating AI agents or LLM-based security tooling.
  • Response experience involving ransomware, identity compromise, destructive attacks, cloud intrusion, insider threats, or supply-chain incidents.
  • Experience holding a managed monitoring or response provider to a standard while keeping decisions in-house.
  • Experience working as part of a Follow-the-sun rotation.

This role may not be a fit if you:

  • Want a queue to work through all day. You hold it one week in three, and the job is making it smaller.
  • Measure success in tickets closed.
  • Close cases without a security disposition or evidence.
  • Accept a vendor alert or an agent’s conclusion without validating it.
  • Want to spend most of your time hand-writing detection queries. Here the agents draft the logic and you own whether it is right.
  • Would rather not be the person in charge when an incident is live.

What we can offer you

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive UK compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months. 🚀
  • Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨
  • Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support.
  • Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

You will be successful if you can combine hands-on engineering depth with technical leadership: solving complex platform challenges, mentoring others, and making pragmatic decisions for sensitive defence environments.

  • Experience implementing DevSecOps controls across infrastructure, pipelines and the software supply chain.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or agentic development workflows, with exposure to model APIs, LLM deployments or MCP.
  • Strong troubleshooting capability across cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, observability and software delivery.
  • Ability to influence technical direction, mentor engineers and work effectively across software, platform, security and support teams.

Desirable Experience

title: Senior Director of Platform & Data Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Keyloop is a leading automotive retail software business, operating across 100+ markets and backed by Francisco Partners. As we accelerate our transition to a modern, cloud-native SaaS platform, Platform & Data Engineering sits at the heart of our technical strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role reporting directly to the CTO, responsible for setting and executing the platform strategy that enables Keyloop's product engineering teams, powers our data and AI capabilities, and provides the integration fabric for an acquisitive, multi-product business.
Responsibilities:

1. Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a diverse, distributed team of platform and data engineers, providing guidance, mentorship, and clear career pathways to ensure high performance and professional growth.

  • Build and refine the organisational structure of the platform function, including defining team topologies that support product engineering teams as internal customers.

  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement, with a strong emphasis on developer productivity and platform reliability.

2. Platform & Technology Strategy

  • Ensure security, stability, and scalability are foundational properties of the platform - not afterthoughts - with clear ownership of reliability targets, security-by-design standards, and the capacity to serve a growing SaaS customer base across 100+ markets.

  • Co-own the multi-year platform engineering roadmap with the Platform Product Leader, translating commercial and product priorities into a coherent engineering delivery plan.

  • Lead the evolution of Keyloop’s shared services, API gateway, integration layer, and internal developer platform (IDP) to serve as the technical foundation across all product lines.

  • Establish API-first as a non-negotiable architectural principle - every platform capability must be accessible via a well-governed, versioned API surface before any other access pattern is considered, enabling both internal product teams and external ecosystem partners to build reliably on top of Keyloop infrastructure.

  • Drive cloud-native architecture decisions, leveraging AWS services and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform/Pulumi) to ensure scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.

  • Champion platform security-by-design, ensuring adherence to enterprise security standards, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2), and Keyloop's obligations as a custodian of sensitive automotive retail data.

3. Integration & Acquisitive Platform Capability

  • Architect and evolve the integration platform that enables Keyloop to onboard acquired businesses and codebases efficiently, reducing time-to-integration across M&A activity.

  • Define and maintain shared platform capabilities including identity, authentication, multi-tenancy, data residency, and OEM connectivity standards.

  • Ensure the platform acts as the enabling layer across Keyloop’s product portfolio, providing consistent APIs, event streaming, and shared infrastructure rather than duplicating capability across product teams.

  • Design and deliver low-code/no-code integration capabilities that enable rapid, standardised connectivity with third-party systems across the automotive ecosystem, including OEM partners, dealer group platforms, and acquired businesses. Build on modern integration tooling (including n8n) to reduce time-to-integration and enable non-engineering teams to configure and operate integrations where appropriate.

4. Data & AI Platform

  • Lead the design and delivery of Keyloop's data platform, including data lakes, data pipelines, and analytical infrastructure to power BI, reporting, and AI-driven product capabilities.

  • Build and operate the infrastructure layer for AI and ML workloads, including feature stores, model serving infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, and experimentation frameworks.

  • Drive strategic adoption of technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, AWS Athena, EMR, Glue, Snowplow, and Kafka, ensuring robust data governance and quality practices.

  • Partner closely with product and data science teams to ensure the data and AI platform directly enables Keyloop's AI product initiatives, including KARA and AIME.

5. Enabling the Agentic Development Lifecycle

  • Lead Keyloop's transition to an agentic software development lifecycle, defining the strategy, frameworks, and delivery model for AI-augmented engineering at scale.

  • Develop and roll out the methodologies, toolchains, and workflows that enable engineering teams to work with AI coding agents, autonomous test generation, agentic PR review, and AI-assisted architecture decisions.

  • Build and own the internal platform capabilities required to support agentic workloads, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) server infrastructure, LLM gateway services, context management systems, and agent orchestration layers.

  • Drive the skills and capability development agenda across engineering, partnering with engineering directors to upskill teams in prompt engineering, AI-native development patterns, and responsible AI tooling practices.

  • Establish guardrails, security controls, and governance frameworks that allow teams to move fast with AI tooling without introducing risk to code quality, IP, or data security.

  • Drive and report on engineering AI maturity progression using Keyloop’s established AI maturity framework, setting stage-based targets, tracking adoption across teams, closing capability gaps, and accelerating teams from early experimentation to production-grade AI-augmented delivery.

6. Delivery Excellence & Observability

  • Oversee the execution of platform engineering initiatives, ensuring timely delivery, adherence to quality standards, and effective resource utilisation.

  • Define and embed observability standards across the platform (OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, SLO/SLA frameworks), giving engineering teams clear visibility into platform health and performance.

  • Drive FinOps discipline across platform infrastructure, owning cloud cost governance and optimisation in partnership with the infrastructure leadership.

7. Strategic Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the CTO, engineering directors, architects, and product leadership to align platform capabilities with business priorities and product roadmaps.

  • Act as a strategic partner to the broader engineering organisation, ensuring platform decisions accelerate rather than constrain product delivery teams.

  • Represent platform and data engineering at the executive and board level, communicating strategy, progress, and investment cases clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Required Skills & Experience:

Technical & Architectural

  • Deep experience in cloud-native platform engineering on AWS, including IaC (Terraform or Pulumi), containerisation (Kubernetes/ECS), event streaming (Kafka), and API gateway patterns.

  • Proven track record designing and operating shared platform services - integration layers, identity, multi-tenancy, and developer-facing APIs - in a complex, multi-product enterprise SaaS environment.

  • Hands-on background in data platform engineering: data lake architecture, ELT pipelines, and familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS data services (Athena, Glue, EMR).

  • Experience building AI/ML infrastructure: feature stores, model serving, MLOps pipelines, and LLM-enabling platform capabilities such as MCP server infrastructure or LLM gateway services.

  • Strong understanding of platform observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, SLO/error budget frameworks, and production reliability engineering.

  • Security-first mindset with hands-on experience in enterprise security practices, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2), and zero-trust architecture patterns.

Leadership & Delivery

  • Extensive engineering leadership experience, with a proven record of building, scaling, and developing high-performing distributed engineering teams of 60+ people.

  • Experience operating within an acquisitive software business, with the ability to lead M&A technical integration and platform standardisation across acquired codebases and teams.

  • Familiarity with modern delivery frameworks (SAFe, Shape Up, or equivalent) and the ability to adapt methodology to the needs of a platform organisation serving multiple internal customers.

  • Strong FinOps capability, including cloud cost governance, unit economics thinking, and the ability to frame infrastructure investment in commercial terms.

Agentic Engineering & AI Tooling

  • Practical experience adopting and scaling AI-native development tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) across engineering organisations.

  • Understanding of agentic software delivery patterns: autonomous agents, human-in-the-loop workflows, agentic code review, test generation, and AI-assisted architecture.

  • Ability to define governance frameworks that enable AI-augmented development at pace while managing code quality, IP protection, and data security risks.

  • Passion for driving engineering culture change, with the ability to take a sceptical or early-majority engineering team on a credible AI adoption journey.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex platform and data engineering decisions into clear narratives for executive, commercial, and board audiences.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering with product, commercial, and finance leadership in a PE-backed, high-growth software environment.

title: Senior Electrical Product Engineer - Maritime Engineering
department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Undersea Dominance - Engineering & Operations : Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. The role sits within Platform Engineering and is based primarily at the production site, dispositioning nonconformances and Material Review Board (MRB) actions for electrical systems and sub-assemblies, resolving design questions in real time, and closing the loop between production and design so that issues get root caused and fixed at the source. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues.

Key Responsibilities

Production Floor Engineering Support

  • Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines
  • Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity
  • Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries
  • Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions
  • Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions
  • Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments)

Electrical Design Contribution

  • Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor
  • Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions
  • Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle

Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support

  • Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites
  • Support the stand-up and ramp of production at new or expanding manufacturing sites, ensuring electrical design engineering knowledge transfers effectively
  • Raise and implement engineering changes to correct production issues that originate in the electrical design, through the Anduril configuration management and change process
  • Feed production observations, failure modes and DFM/DFA opportunities back into Platform Electrical design work through structured feedback, prioritised using data

Design to Production Interface

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering on work instruction (WI) development, tooling validation, and First Article Inspection (FAI) activities for electrical assemblies, communicating the design intent and acceptance criteria
  • Own the resolution of EBOM discrepancies found in production for electrical assemblies, and give engineering input to Configuration Management and Manufacturing Engineering on PLM workflows, BOM reconciliation and work instruction tooling
  • Identify patterns across electrical nonconformances, test failures and build issues, and lead engineering root cause analysis and design corrective action implementation
  • Collaborate on the improvement of key tool and functional interfaces (PLM workflows, digital work instructions, BOM reconciliation) that impact design-to-production efficiency
  • Support the development of scalable frameworks for multi-site production: configuration management alignment, site-specific work instruction adaptation, and cross-site lesson-learned sharing
  • Build repeatable playbooks for standing up production of new product variants, reducing ramp time and first-unit defects at each additional site

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Metrics

  • Maintain strong working relationships with Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Management to ensure aligned priorities and rapid issue resolution
  • Collate and drive corrective actions on design-originated production issues, providing data-backed prioritisation to core Design Engineering teams
  • Participate in Production readiness reviews, design reviews (P&DFMEA, DFM/A/T) and engineering change assessments

Key Competencies & Attributes

  • Engineering Judgement: Technical depth in electrical and power systems combined with production pragmatism - able to make sound engineering decisions under time pressure without over-engineering solutions
  • Design Authority Integrity: You protect product safety and integrity under schedule pressure, understand the limits of your delegated authority and escalate when you should
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Credibility with both design engineers and production operators; able to speak both languages and bridge communication gaps
  • Autonomy & Initiative: Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities in a fast-moving production environment; able to self-direct and prioritise without constant direction
  • Systems Thinking: Thinks beyond individual issue resolution to identify patterns, root causes, and scalable solutions that prevent recurrence across sites and variants
  • Communication: Clear, concise technical communication - written dispositions, engineering reports, and presentations to leadership

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Proven experience in a senior role within defence, tech or any fast-paced environment, driving successful electrical engineering projects from concept to market launch
  • Expertise in electrical engineering principles, techniques, and technologies, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions
  • Proficiency in using industry-standard electrical design and simulation software
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor junior engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation
  • Strong time management and organisational abilities, with a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time and within budget
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and adapt to diverse and evolving challenges
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with fast paced environment best practices, including agility, adaptability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 Australian Government Security Clearance
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience working on or directly supporting a production floor
  • Understanding of Material Review Board (MRB) processes, nonconformance management, and engineering disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return to vendor)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing electrical and power systems for unmanned vehicles
  • Experience in the subsea or maritime domain
  • Experience working on defence programs and familiarity with current Defence standards
  • Previous experience as a Product, Sustaining, Liaison or Production Support Engineer with delegated design or disposition authority
  • Experience with first article inspection (e.g. AS9102) and production test development
  • Familiarity with IPC/WHMA-A-620 and/or IPC-A-610

title: (Senior) Enterprise Engagement Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Stackgini

How do you govern 20,000 applications when nobody in the building still knows which of them do the same thing? How do you get faster to market and leaner at the same time, when business units ship AI prototypes in days and the regulatory load grows every quarter?

Stackgini is the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. Our system understands our customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up: from technical configuration to application documentation, from a single tech demand to the dependencies across the entire portfolio. With the depth of knowledge of a senior tech expert and the speed of a machine. Some of the largest organizations in the world work with us, including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers and REWE.

We're a small, talent-dense team, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career.

About the role

As an Enterprise Engagement Manager, you own what Stackgini actually becomes inside our customers. You take over once the deal closes and guide the organization from the first target-picture discussion to the point where tech demand management runs differently than it did before.

This is advisory work with a product behind it. You sit with CIOs, IT business partners, and enterprise architects, understand how their demand process works today and where it breaks, and design a target picture they can defend internally. You measure what it delivered and turn that into the basis for the next year.

Unlike consulting, you don't walk out after the final presentation. You stay with the accounts you own and see, over years, what became of your work.

Areas of ownership

  • Strategic advisory. You are the trusted advisor to tech leaders in DAX-40, Fortune-500, and ambitious mid-market organizations. You show them what best-practice AI-first demand management looks like and bring an outside view they can't get internally. Out of that you develop the target picture with them, from the end-to-end process concept to how Stackgini fits into the existing IT toolchain.

  • Value realization. You define the KPIs you will be measured against together with the customer, baseline them, and prove the effect. You guide them through portfolio optimization and build the business cases behind it. Realized value is not a story for the QBR here, it is the number the role hangs on.

  • Stakeholder engagement. You make the champions inside the customer's organization successful. You give them the arguments, the evidence, and the backing they need to carry Stackgini into business units, IT governance, architecture, procurement, and information security.

  • Adoption and enablement. You make power users and multipliers capable through trainings, best practices, and workshops, and you feed what you learn back into our methodology.

  • Account growth and expansion. Identify and drive expansion opportunities by developing growth plans across new use cases, teams, and units, and spot risk before it surfaces in a renewal.

  • Build our customer value engine. You work hands-on on daily operations, expand the Stackgini Academy into a best-in-class enablement hub, and develop thought leadership assets: playbooks, point-of-view content, best practice guides.

  • Partner cross-functionally. Bring structured customer insights into Product and Engineering, shape our roadmap with use-case-driven evidence, and support Sales on key strategic deals.

Who you are

  • 2+ years in enterprise tech or consulting. Strategy or management consulting, IT transformation, or an enterprise tech function such as IT governance, architecture, or tech demand management. What matters is that you owned an outcome at a customer, not a workstream.

  • You structure ambiguity. You break down complex problems, shape them into clear options, and build processes that work without you.

  • You hold your own up to C-level. Precise in writing, structured in speech, composed in front of executives. In German and English.

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. You can describe concretely how you use LLMs, agents, or custom workflows in your daily work. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be credible in a room with one.

  • Ownership over scope. You move things forward without waiting to be assigned, and client-facing work energizes you rather than drains you.

What's a plus

  • A real understanding of how enterprise tech organizations work, ideally with exposure to enterprise architecture, IT governance, software asset management, or IT procurement

  • Experience designing onboarding paths, trainings, and certifications that drive adoption at scale

Your first 90 days

  • You own accounts and know their demand process well enough to challenge it.

  • You have built a target picture and the corresponding value KPIs with at least one customer.

  • You run workshops and trainings on your own, with business and tech in the same room.

  • You have improved one thing about our methodology, because you saw where it didn't hold up at a customer.

Process

Intro call, hiring manager interview, case study, meeting the team.

Compensation Package

The annual salary for this permanent, full-time position is EUR 80,000–110,000 per year and employee stock options.

Benefits

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | AI & Security
descriptionHtml:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Product & Platform) • Paris Office

  • Location: Paris (75002), 2 days remote per week

  • Company: Escape : Leading AI Cybersecurity

  • Compensation: €75–90k base + 0.05% BSPCE depending on seniority and scope

  • Total Engineering Team at Escape: 21 Engineers, 4 Technical Leads, 4 Squads

About Escape

Escape is offensive security for the teams that are 100x outnumbered. We build AI agents that find and exploit vulnerabilities in modern applications, APIs, and microservices: the way a real attacker would, but at the speed of a CI pipeline.

We're a Y Combinator W23 company. We just closed an $18M Series A in March 2026 led by Balderton Capital (with Uncorrelated Ventures, IRIS, and YC following on). Our customers and partners include Zoom, Schibsted, Wiz, Pandadoc, and a growing list of teams who've stopped pretending annual pen tests are enough. We're 40 people split between Paris and NYC, scaling to 80 in the next 12 months.

The product surface is real: ASM, business-logic-aware DAST, and AI Pentesting GA-ing this year. The competitive thesis is that LLMs collapsed the cost of offensive engineering by 1000x, and the companies that ship that capability into production first will own the next decade of the category. We're betting we're those companies.

About the Role

In AI, context is the moat. At Escape, the data model is the context: and a team of three owns it end to end.

Every Escape product (ASM, DAST, AI Pentesting) is built on top of one data model rich enough to represent an entire attack surface and everything our agents learn about it. That model is our moat, and this team owns it. You'll own the schema at the heart of the company and the last mile that delivers our offensive R&D to customers through the GraphQL API and the product UI. If it ships to a customer, it goes through your team.

This is not a CRUD SaaS role in security clothing. It's the highest-leverage seat in product engineering: small team, central surface, and a direct line from your commits to what a CISO sees. "Senior" here means you set technical direction, not just execute it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the data model that is the moat: Design and evolve the schema representing tens of thousands of assets, millions of findings, multi-identity context, and everything our AI accumulates across engagements. This compounds: get it right and the whole platform gets stronger.

  • Turn R&D into Product for customers: Turn the output of our offensive AI research into something teams actually use: through the Svelte frontend, the GraphQL API, integrations, and real-time data refresh. You're the bridge between technology and value.

  • Push PostgreSQL to its edge: Query optimization, index design, pagination, caching, low-latency search over millions of records. The platform is intensely data-driven and the standard playbook runs out fast. This is most of the job.

  • Build AI-native workflows: Guided triage, assisted remediation, signal extraction from noisy scan data. AI is woven through the product, not bolted on: you build the surfaces where it meets the user.

  • Drive architecture: Data modeling, system design, GraphQL schema. You decide how we build, not just what: with a real, un-gimmicky path to Tech Lead.

Our Tech Stack & Focus

Frontend: Svelte + TypeScript, GraphQL client Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Yoga + Pothos), Prisma, PostgreSQL, Kafka Infra: AWS, GitLab CI, Grafana Adjacent deep tech: Python (AI/ML), Go (network tooling)

Perks & Benefits

  • ❤️‍🩹 Top-tier health insurance with Alan

  • 🍕 Meal vouchers with Swile

  • 💪 EGYM Wellpass sport subscription

  • 📚 Continuous learning: budgets for books and online courses

  • 💻 Premium equipment to support your work

  • 🎁 Dedicated time for open-source projects

  • 🌍 Present at top international conferences (RSAC, BlackHat, DEFCON, BSides, APIDays)

About You

  • 5+ years building production web apps, genuinely strong on both frontend and backend

  • Deep TypeScript knowledge: you use the type system to its full potential, you don't just tolerate it

  • Proven experience designing (not just consuming) GraphQL schemas A real passion for product, craft, and design: you care how it feels, not only whether it works

  • Strong ownership: you fix the problem the moment you spot it Excellent communicator: able to explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineering stakeholders

Nice to have:

descriptionHtml:

More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. 

Since 2013, Doctolib has been striving for a healthier world by providing new-generation technology. With more than 2,800 employees across France, Italy, Germany and the Netherlands, Doctolib improves the daily lives of healthcare professionals and serves more than 80 million Europeans, offering a fast, frictionless, and secure journey for all their care needs.

What you'll do

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

As a Fullstack Engineer, your mission will be to work on web features for our secure medical communication solutions that enable healthcare professionals to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues both within and beyond their organizational walls. You will be working in a feature team developing a product that powers Europe's largest medical network with over 1M healthcare professionals.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

title: Senior Hardware Certification Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Hardware Certification Engineer with focus on DO-254, you will be an important part of our Certification and Systems Engineering organization, supporting the development and certification of advanced unmanned aircraft systems.

Your main focus will be the development assurance and certification of airborne electronic hardware. You will work closely with Hardware, Systems Engineering, Safety, Verification & Validation and Certification teams to ensure that hardware development and verification activities fulfil the applicable certification objectives.

You will translate certification and safety requirements into practical engineering activities and help ensure that the required compliance evidence is complete, consistent, traceable and ready for review by certification authorities.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Plan, coordinate and support DO-254 / ED-80 hardware certification activities throughout the hardware development lifecycle.

  • Develop, review and maintain certification artefacts such as the Plan for Hardware Aspects of Certification (PHAC), Hardware Verification Plan (HVP), Hardware Configuration Management Plan (HCMP), Hardware Accomplishment Summary (HAS) and supporting compliance evidence.

  • Define and maintain DO-254 compliance matrices and ensure that applicable objectives are addressed by appropriate engineering evidence.

  • Support determination and justification of the applicable Hardware Design Assurance Level (DAL) together with Systems and Safety Engineering.

  • Ensure bidirectional requirements traceability between system requirements, hardware requirements, design data and verification evidence.

  • Review hardware requirements, conceptual and detailed designs, verification activities and lifecycle data against DO-254 objectives.

  • Define and review hardware verification methods, test cases, procedures, analyses and results, including the required level of independence.

  • Support compliance of FPGA, programmable logic, complex electronic hardware and electronic assemblies, as applicable to the individual programme.

  • Assess COTS, reused or previously developed hardware and define appropriate certification and compliance activities.

  • Support configuration management, problem reporting, change control and lifecycle data management required for certification.

  • Perform compliance reviews, gap analyses and change-impact assessments and track findings through closure.

  • Work closely with Hardware Development, Systems Engineering, Safety, Test & Verification and Configuration Management to integrate certification activities into the engineering lifecycle.

  • Support certification reviews, audits and authority engagements and provide clear technical justification for the selected means of compliance.

  • Continuously improve the organisation's DO-254 processes, templates, tooling and certification methods.


What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Professional experience in airborne electronic hardware development, hardware verification, aerospace certification or development assurance.

  • Strong practical knowledge of RTCA DO-254 / EUROCAE ED-80 and its application to airborne electronic hardware.

  • Experience with hardware certification planning, requirements management, verification and compliance evidence.

  • Good understanding of FPGA / CPLD or complex electronic hardware development, electronic hardware and PCB development, hardware requirements and design reviews, requirements-based verification, configuration management, change control, requirements traceability, verification independence, and COTS or reused hardware assessment.

  • Experience creating or reviewing DO-254 lifecycle documents such as PHAC, HVP, HCMP and HAS is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with AC 20-152A or comparable authority guidance for airborne electronic hardware is an advantage.

  • Knowledge of related aerospace development and safety standards such as ARP4754A, ARP4761 / ARP4761A and DO-178C is advantageous.

  • Experience working with aviation certification authorities or within a DOA or military airworthiness environment is advantageous.

  • Structured and analytical working style with a strong focus on traceability, evidence and technical correctness.

  • Ability to communicate complex certification requirements effectively to hardware engineers and other engineering disciplines.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. German language skills are beneficial.

title: Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders) you will lead the electrical design of the battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and junction box of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Through electrical modelling and analysis, you will close the design before it moves to test and provide the engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is electrically safe, robust, and certifiable.

Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the electrical/electrothermal design of HV equipment for an 800 V class propulsion battery system, covering topology, segregation, protection, isolation, precharge, and safe disconnection within each unit.

  • Align the electrical design of each unit with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system, working closely with the HV Electrical Systems team and the Electrical Systems Architect.

  • Design cell interconnections and busbars as well as develop the cell connection system together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team.

  • Specify and select protection and safety devices, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge components, current sensors, manual service disconnects, and the HV interlock loop, working with Airborne Electronics colleagues where solid-state power controllers (SSPCs) are used.

  • Define the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces of each unit together with the HV Electrical Systems team.

  • Lead or support component specification, selection, and supplier engagement depending on the component, together with the responsible teams.

  • Develop or assist with electrical models of the full battery pack to close the design before testing, and support propulsion battery system modeling of performance and failure cases together with the HV Electrical Systems team.

  • Perform electrical/electrothermal analyses, including short-circuit and fault current, protection coordination, insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, partial discharge at altitude, voltage drop, and Joule losses as input to the Thermal Systems team.

  • Own the grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design within each unit.

  • Define the physical layout and routing of electrical components together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team.

  • Perform safety analyses such as FMEA for each unit or support the Safety team in system-level safety assessments.

  • Draft test requirements (TRQs) for electrical verification, independently or together with the respective teams as required.

  • Create and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, requirements, and interface definitions under configuration control, and contribute to design reviews and certification evidence.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in HV electrical design, preferably in aerospace or automotive battery systems, or other safety-critical industries.

  • Proven experience in the electrical design of HV battery packs, power distribution units, or junction boxes.

  • Strong understanding of HV DC distribution and protection, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge circuits, insulation monitoring, HV interlock, and fault coordination.

  • Experience designing busbars and cell interconnections, including current-carrying capacity, thermal derating, and short-circuit withstand.

  • Experience with insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, and partial discharge, ideally for equipment operating at altitude.

  • Proficiency with electrical modeling and analysis tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Electrical, PLECS, or equivalent.

  • Proficiency with ECAD tools such as Zuken E3.series, Siemens Capital, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, or equivalent.

  • Experience with grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design.

  • Experience writing requirements and test requirements, and correlating analysis results with test data.

  • Experience with safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, and FHA is desirable.

  • Experience with electronics or PCB design, including flex PCBs, is beneficial.

  • Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, DO-254, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and IEC 60664-1 is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. German is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. title: Senior Influencer Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Airbnb Communications team drives earned visibility and cultural relevance for the brand, delivering campaigns that support direct traffic, brand love and positive conversation. Our influencer function sits at the intersection of culture, content and community — leading social-first campaigns that inspire travel on Airbnb and strengthen its long-term reputation.

The Difference You Will Make

We're looking for a Senior Influencer Manager to lead Airbnb's influencer programme in theUK, localising regional priorities and delivering campaigns that connect the brand to culturally relevant conversations.

The role covers our full influencer remit: earned and organic creator partnerships, and influencer work running through paid media. You'll own campaigns end to end — creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, measurement and reporting — and help position influencers as both a commercial lever and a long-term driver of brand health, while collaborating with agency partners.

Sitting in the UK Communications team, you'll build influencer into campaign narratives from inception, and partner with Brand Marketing and Paid Media so creator content is designed for amplification from the outset, with usage rights, whitelisting and dark posting permissions secured up front.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn brand objectives into content that is authentic, thumb-stopping and earns attention rather than interrupting it.

A Typical Day

  • Own and scale Airbnb's influencer programme in the UK against local, regional and global priorities — timelines, creative execution and performance
  • Deliver across earned, organic and paid influencer work, partnering with the regional Influencer Lead and the UK Brand Marketing and Paid Media teams on creator selection, briefing for amplification, permissions and asset delivery
  • Build influencer into the core campaign narrative and press strategy from inception, with the UK Communications team
  • Identify, vet and build relationships with creators across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — emerging talent through to established partners — with inclusive, culturally relevant casting
  • Write clear, strategic briefs covering objectives, key messages and content guidelines, and lead onboarding and content reviews against brand standards
  • Partner with legal and agency teams on contracts: deliverables, usage rights, paid media, exclusivity and payment
  • Stay plugged into culture, consumer and media trends — particularly Gen Z — bringing forward creator ideas and campaign hooks, and moving fast on reactive opportunities
  • Manage logistics for influencer stays and experiences, including vetting, Host coordination and credit approvals
  • Track performance across commercial and brand health metrics using CreatorIQ,Sprinklr and Airtable, optimising with the agency and reporting to the regional team
  • Align plans with local Marketing, Partnerships, Affiliate and Growth teams and the global influencer team to avoid duplicated effort
  • Lead day-to-day communication and program operations with our respective UK Influencer agency partners 
  • Identify opportunities with key opinion formers — policy, cultural and news influencers, and third-party validators — for reputation campaigns

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years in communications, influencer marketing, talent partnerships or social-first content strategy
  • Deep knowledge of the UK creator landscape and strong instincts on what resonates and why, across a diverse audience
  • A communications mindset: a track record of building creator partnerships into integrated campaigns, connected to the earned, social and reputation storytelling around them
  • End-to-end campaign experience across organic and paid environments — sourcing, briefing for amplification, dark posting, usage rights, contracting and performance analysis
  • Confident negotiating with creators and managing external agencies and stakeholders across legal, marketing and comms
  • Strong writing, particularly briefs and content feedback
  • Familiarity with influencer tools (CreatorIQ, Sprinklr or similar tooling platforms) and reporting that quantifies brand health and sentiment, not just reach and engagement
  • Able to run multiple campaigns and creators at once with high attention to detail
  • Belief in influencer as a driver of long-term brand equity, not just short-term performance

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range£72,000—£90,000 GBP

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

· Bereichsaufbau: Aktive Mitgestaltung der Prozesse, Strategien und Standards für PlanetHome Investments.

· Track Record: Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Investmentgeschäft oder in der Vermittlung von Wohn- und Geschäftshäusern.

· Marktnetzwerk: Belastbarer Zugang zu Eigentümern, Investoren, Projektentwicklern oder Family Offices.

descriptionHtml:
About BeReal

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 70+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Role

We are looking for a talented iOS Engineer to join our Monetization team, where you will focus on building and optimizing revenue-generating features while maintaining the authentic experience that makes BeReal special.

You will be responsible for:

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable iOS monetization features (ads formats, sponsored content, premium features) in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (designers, product managers, data analysts, backend engineers, adOps team) to build innovative monetization solutions that respect user experience.

  • Building the bridge between advertisers/partners and our users, ensuring monetization feels native and non-intrusive.

  • Optimizing performance and stability of monetization features to ensure seamless integration with the core BeReal experience.

  • Analyzing user behavior, A/B tests results, and business metrics to iterate on monetization strategies.

  • Ensuring a high-quality, authentic user experience through thoughtful technical solutions.

  • Contributing to and upholding best practices in code quality, design, and development processes.

  • Continuously innovating and improving the iOS tech stack (Swift, SwiftUI).

You'll work alongside AI tools that amplify your creativity and streamline your day-to-day.

Profile

  • Strong iOS programming skills (5+ years experience).

  • Solid knowledge in Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit.

  • Familiarity with Clean Architecture principles and separation of concerns.

  • Experience building monetization features, ads products, or consumer-facing products is a strong plus.

  • Ability to understand and debug large, complex codebases.

  • Product mindset with a strong passion for clean interfaces, smooth animations, and interactions.

  • Interest for analytics and data-first mindset to measure impact and iterate.

  • Strong understanding of user experience and ability to balance business goals with product quality.

  • You're highly driven, autonomous, and results oriented.

  • Be fluent in English (French is a plus).

Our Stack

Use the following predefined list:

  • iOS: Swift, Combine, SwiftUI, SPM, Swift Concurrency, MVVM

  • Ops: Github.

  • Android: Kotlin, Compose, Coroutines, Room, gRPC.

  • Infrastructure: GCP, GKE, Firebase.

  • Data: Amplitude, Tableau.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

title: Senior IT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About the role

At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human.

We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working.

This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates.

You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes.

Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations.

What you'll do

Own and improve our IT operations

  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution.
  • Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems.
  • Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience.
  • Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects.

Build smarter systems through AI and automation

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT.
  • Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes.
  • Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work.
  • Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance.

Think like a product owner

  • Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact.
  • Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs.
  • Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience.
  • Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning.

Collaborate across Typeform

  • Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.
  • Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members.
  • Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation.

What you'll bring

  • Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company.
  • ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations.
  • Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian.
  • Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools.
  • Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity.
  • Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management.
  • Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution.
  • A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations.
  • Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems.
  • Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms.
  • Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting.
  • Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance.
  • Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects.

descriptionHtml:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Finance.

DEINE MISSION

Als (Senior) Java Fullstack Developer (m/w/d) gestaltest du leistungsfähige Anwendungen, vom Backend mit Java, Java EE und Spring bis zum Frontend mit React und JSF (PrimeFaces). Dabei bringst du deine Expertise in Softwarearchitektur, Datenbank-Design und -Optimierung sowie in die Qualitätssicherung der Software ein.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Backend-Komponenten auf Basis von Java/Java EE und Spring, unter anderem unter Einsatz von Hibernate

  • Umsetzung moderner Benutzeroberflächen mit React und JSF (PrimeFaces) sowie JavaScript, HTML/CSS und XML

  • Konzeption und Implementierung von SOAP- und REST-Webservices zur Anbindung fachlicher Systeme

  • Design, Konzeption und Optimierung von Oracle-Datenbanken, einschließlich Performancetuning sowie Entwicklung mit SQL und PL/SQL

  • Verwaltung des Quellcodes mit GIT sowie Automatisierung von Build- und Deployment-Prozessen mit Jenkins und Maven

  • Betrieb und Konfiguration von Anwendungen auf JBoss Webserver, Oracle Application Server und Apache Tomcat

  • Einsatz und Anbindung von Elastic Search zur Such- und Analysefunktionalität

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in Java, Java EE, JavaScript, HTML/CSS und XML

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL und PL/SQL

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SOAP- und REST-Webservices

  • Praxis mit Spring, Hibernate, React und JSF (PrimeFaces)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Eclipse IDE oder IntelliJ sowie mit SQL Developer oder PL/SQL Developer

  • Erfahrung mit GIT, Jenkins und Maven

  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit JBoss Webserver, Oracle Application Server und Apache Tomcat

  • Erfahrung mit Elastic Search

  • Know-how in Oracle Datenbank-Design und Datenbank-Konzeption sowie in Datenbank-Optimierung und Performancetuning

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau sowie Englisch auf Konversationsniveau

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Terminen bei einem Remote-Anteil von etwa 80 %

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

  • Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.

  • Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich.

  • Individuelles Hardware-Budget? – Stell dir deinen Arbeitsplatz so zusammen, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst.

  • Mental Health? – Dein mentales Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Mit OpenUp unterstützen wir dich und bieten dir jederzeit kostenlosen Zugang zu professioneller psychologischer Unterstützung.

  • Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget? – Egal ob die nächste Zertifizierung oder ein lang ersehnter Sprachkurs – du entscheidest, worin und wann du dich weiterbildest.

  • Mitarbeiter:innen-PC-Programm? – Lease dir dein nächstes Device zur rein privaten Nutzung einfach über virtual7.

  • JobRad oder Firmenwagen? – Wir helfen dir dabei, so mobil zu sein, wie du es brauchst.


Erzähl mir, wer du bist und wann du anfangen kannst. Gerne auch über
