title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

  • Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.
  • Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.
  • Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

Business Cases and Strategy

  • Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.
  • Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.
  • Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

Product Discovery and Delivery

  • Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.
  • Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.
  • Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

Alignment and Stakeholder Management

  • Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.
  • Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.
  • Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.
  • Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

Must-haves

  • Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.
  • Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.
  • High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.
  • Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.
  • Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.
  • Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.
  • A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE  🎆

  • Retail, CPG, or retail media background
  • Multi-market experience
  • Can speak Italian or German

LOCATION 🌐 

While we have offices in Milan, Berlin, Barcelona, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full remote available), empowering you to work where you're most effective.

HOURS ⏰
Your manager and several partner teams are in North America, so you’ll need to be flexible about working some later hours, beyond a standard 9-5 CET.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE 💜 

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
  • Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.

Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
descriptionHtml:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day.One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

  • Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions.

  • Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins.

  • Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle.

  • Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria.

  • Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing.

  • Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements.

  • Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field.

  • At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems.

  • Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes.

  • Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration.

title: Senior QA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.

As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping)

  • Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests

  • Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failures the same day and fix flaky tests at the root cause, including ones caused by unreliable third-party sandboxes

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what’s worth automating and what stays manual

  • Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and integrations with external systems (Postman, Playwright API testing or similar), including authentication flows like OAuth and webhooks

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong exploratory testing skills, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You’ve defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS, ideally with a public API or integration marketplace

  • Contract testing (e.g. Pact) or mocking third-party services

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

  • Experience leading a shift-left change

  • Testing integrations with accounting or finance software

  • Basic security testing (e.g. OWASP ZAP)

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

  • Final Skills Interview, on-site (60 mins)

title: Senior Receiving Inspector
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role will work onsite at our office located in Oxford, England (UK).
Job ID: 1948

The Role: 

We are looking for a Senior Receiving Inspector to join our Quality team. As a Senior Receiving Inspector, you’ll be part of a cross-functional team whose mission is to lead IonQ on its journey to build the world’s best quantum computers to solve the world’s most complex problems. 

You will make sure that incoming, in-process and finished components meet their mechanical, electrical and PCBA specifications. You will also own the inspection side of the Material Review Board process, from handling and containing nonconforming material, through the inspection actions the board assigns, to verifying, closing and tracking nonconformance records once the Quality Engineer has given the disposition. As the senior technical resource for inspection, you will allocate the daily inspection work and guide less experienced inspectors. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with the integrity to hold quality standards under production pressure.

Responsibilities:

Day to day, you will inspect incoming parts, in-process production and finished goods against approved specifications, drawings and purchase order requirements, deciding the inspection method and sequence with little instruction. You will interpret drawing callouts and datum structures to GD&T and ASME Y14.5, turn them into inspection plans and acceptance criteria, apply statistical sampling plans and use the right metrology instruments, including programming and running CMM, OMM or vision systems. You will support the calibration schedule, remove out of tolerance equipment from service and keep the inspection area to the local 5S procedure.

When something is wrong, you will control it. You will identify, tag, segregate and quarantine nonconforming material with correct lot and serial traceability to ISO 9001 and AS9100, sweep stock and work in progress to contain every affected lot, write the nonconformance record and present the inspection evidence at the Material Review Board. You will carry out the actions the board assigns, verify scrap disposal so nothing returns to the supply chain, and feed inspection data to the Quality Engineer for root cause analysis and supplier corrective action. You will also support internal, customer and regulatory audits, and keep to the quality management system, export control and customer contract requirements for controlled material and data.

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Leading daily inspection of incoming, in-process and finished goods, including allocating the workload and verifying other inspectors' results and records before release
  • Writing nonconformance records, presenting inspection evidence at the Material Review Board and completing assigned actions such as screening, sorting and rework verification
  • Verifying and closing nonconformance records against the Quality Engineer's disposition, and keeping the MRB log and ageing report up to date
  • Drafting and releasing inspection procedures and work instructions, and reporting metrics such as first pass yield, defect Pareto, NCR ageing and inspection turnaround
  • Working with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and suppliers on source inspection, first article inspection and quality problems

Requirements:

You will bring six or more years of related experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, including proven PCBA inspection to IPC-A-610 and experience of aerospace inspection processes and standards. You will have hands-on experience of controlling nonconforming product and of the Material Review Board process, and of using a Quality Management System or ERP nonconformance module to raise, track and close records and actions.


You read and interpret complex technical drawings with a thorough understanding of datum structures to ASME Y14.5, and you are expert with layout tools such as surface plates, height gauges, indicators, callipers, micrometers, gauge blocks and thread gauges. You have allocated work to, trained and guided less experienced inspectors, and you are confident with standard office software for data analysis and documentation. The role involves lifting up to 18 kg and standing for long periods, with strict adherence to safety and PPE requirements.


You’d be a great fit with:

  • Clear communication at every level, from management to engineers and physicists, when resolving complex quality issues
  • Working knowledge of root cause analysis methods such as 5 Why, Ishikawa or 8D
  • Experience of first article inspection to AS9102 and of source inspection at supplier sites
  • An ASQ Certified Quality Inspector or Certified Quality Technician qualification, or equivalent
  • A quality first, self-starting approach, with precision under pressure and a willingness to support other quality functions

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.
 
We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  

US Non-Technical Jobs. Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d), Vollzeit und Teilzeit
descriptionHtml:
Über Joberg

Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d) – mit Option auf Head of SEO & GEO – OTE 130.000 € – Vollzeit – Remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

Die meisten SEO-Stellen suchen jemanden, der Tickets abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der uns sagt, welche Tickets es überhaupt geben sollte.

Über uns

Wir bauen gerade eine zweite Business Unit auf: GEO-SEO für ausgewählte Nischen, die die großen Agenturen nicht beachten. Gemeint ist Sichtbarkeit dort, wo Menschen heute fragen, also bei Google und in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini. Die Nachfrage haben wir in den ersten Verkaufsgesprächen bereits bestätigt.

Dahinter steht Joberg, eine „kleine“, aber feine Marketing-Agentur. Unser erstes Standbein sind Paket-Mailings, mit denen unsere Kund:innen auf dem Schreibtisch von Entscheider:innen landen. Mit der neuen Unit expandieren wir in den SEO/GEO- und vielleicht in Zukunft in den SEA/GEA-Markt. Was dafür noch fehlt, bist du.

Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und keine Büropolitik. Wir arbeiten konzentriert, haben dabei Spaß und nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst. Wir finden, dass ein Job, der Spaß macht, und ein richtig gutes Gehalt sich nicht ausschließen.

Ehrlich gesagt

Es gibt noch keinen Prozess, kein Team und kein Handbuch. Das ist kein Mangel, das ist der Job. Du bist Person Nummer eins in diesem Bereich und trägst 100 % der Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. Den Plan schreibst du. Und wenn du findest, dass wir falsch liegen, sag es. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Perspektive

Du startest als Senior SEO & GEO Manager und setzt selbst um. Wenn der Bereich wächst, hast du die Option, dich zum Head of SEO & GEO zu entwickeln und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen. Wie und wann, gestalten wir gemeinsam.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du setzt SEO, GEO und Bewertungsmanagement für unsere Kund:innen um, von der Analyse bis zum Ergebnis.

  • Du findest heraus, was ein Unternehmen in KI-Antworten nach vorne bringt, und machst daraus eine wiederholbare Methode (Framework/SOP).

  • Du baust das Fulfillment und die automatisierten Workflows mit KI so auf, dass sie mit jedem neuen Kunden besser werden und nicht langsamer.

  • Du sagst uns, welche Nischen sich deiner Meinung nach lohnen und welche nicht.

Was du kannst

  • Google kennst du in- und auswendig: Google Business Profile, Search Console, lokale Rankings und AI Overviews.

  • Du weißt, wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini Quellen auswählen und Unternehmen empfehlen.

  • Du erstellst Websites und Landingpages automatisiert und optimierst sie für SEO und GEO, inklusive strukturierter Daten.

  • Du beherrschst Bewertungsmanagement: mehr echte Bewertungen gewinnen und professionell darauf antworten.

  • Du baust Workflows mit KI und Automationstools, etwa über APIs, n8n oder Make.

  • Du misst Ergebnisse und erklärst sie so, dass Kund:innen sie verstehen.

Woran wir merken, dass du es bist

  • Du lebst KI. Du nutzt sie jeden Tag, beruflich wie privat, und probierst neue Modelle aus, bevor jemand danach fragt.

  • Du bist neugierig und ruhst dich nie auf dem Status quo aus. Was gestern funktioniert hat, stellst du heute infrage.

  • Wir müssen dir nichts erklären. Du erklärst uns Dinge, die wir noch nicht wussten.

  • Du arbeitest ergebnisorientiert und brauchst niemanden, der dir Aufgaben gibt.

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung, mit einem deutlichen Anteil Local SEO. Je mehr, desto besser.

  • Du beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bist einfach eine coole, sympathische Person :)

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Eine echte Founding Role mit der Option, Head of SEO & GEO zu werden

  • Ein Gesamteinkommen (OTE) weit über dem Markt, denn wir sind margenstark und teilen den Erfolg

  • Workations: Arbeite auch mal ein paar Wochen von dort, wo andere Urlaub machen.

  • Arbeiten, wo du willst: remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

  • Flache Hierarchien: keine Freigabeschleifen, eine Entscheidung dauert bei uns ein Telefonat.

  • Budget für die KI-Tools, die du brauchst

  • Start ab Januar 2027 oder wann es für dich passt

Gehalt: Fixum 56.200 € brutto im Jahr. On-Target-Earnings (OTE): 130.000 € im Jahr. Wie sich die OTE zusammensetzen, erklären wir dir im ersten Gespräch.

So bewirbst du dich

Nutze den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite mit dem Betreff „Bewerbung Senior SEO & GEO Manager – Vollzeit“:

  1. Deinen Lebenslauf

  2. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, maximal eine Seite: Warum reizt dich genau diese Rolle, und was würdest du in den ersten 90 Tagen anders machen als die meisten? Und wie nutzt du KI heute schon im Alltag?

Pluspunkte, wenn du magst: Ein Vorstellungsvideo von 1 bis 3 Minuten (die Handykamera reicht, schick einfach den Link). Jeder Extra-Aufwand fließt positiv in die Bewertung ein, ist aber kein Muss.

Du hörst innerhalb von 5 Werktagen von uns, auch wenn es ein Nein ist.

Du kennst jemanden, der perfekt passt? Schick uns den Kontakt. Führt deine Empfehlung zur Einstellung, bedanken wir uns mit 3.000 €, sobald die Person die Probezeit bestanden hat.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute Libraries
descriptionHtml:
About the job

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll develop, maintain and release the C++ libraries and runtime APIs that engineers use to build and execute workloads on Graphcore’s AI hardware.
Your work will focus on developer-facing libraries, runtime components or a combination of both. You’ll design clear abstractions for low-level hardware capabilities, improve reliability and performance, and support developers integrating these libraries into the wider software stack.

You will take ownership of library changes from design and implementation through review, integration, release and ongoing maintenance. Deliver dependable library releases through packaging, dependency validation, release notes and the maintenance fixes developers need.

You’ll write API documentation, usage examples and migration guidance to help developers adopt changes confidently. Work with library users across the software stack to understand requirements, resolve integration issues and guide API improvements.

The team and culture

The AI Compute Libraries team develops high-performance compute libraries and the software infrastructure that helps engineers make effective use of Graphcore’s AI hardware.

You’ll work alongside specialists in accelerator software, runtime systems and performance engineering. Together, you’ll turn hardware capabilities and developer requirements into practical, well-tested APIs, with clear documentation and dependable releases.

What we’re looking for

Essential skills:

  • Strong modern C++ skills and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable code.
  • The ability to turn complex, low-level concepts into clear APIs and abstractions.
  • Strong debugging and automated testing skills, including diagnosing issues in existing codebases.
  • Confidence owning substantial engineering tasks independently and working effectively across teams.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience with hardware accelerators, heterogeneous computing or architecture-specific software.
  • Experience with embedded DSLs, graph representations, descriptor generation or compiler infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with CMake, C++ library packaging, API/ABI compatibility, versioning or dependency management.
  • Experience integrating C++ libraries with Python or ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
  • Experience improving release automation, compatibility testing or developer tooling.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.


Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Autonomy team who really enjoys creating quality, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through design improvements, and prioritizing sound interfaces and architecture. We are not specifically looking for roboticists, but welcome any person with extensive production software experience who wants to work in a real-world robotics deployment. At our company, we specialise in developing tailored software solutions that enable our robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency.

This is a senior, hands-on software engineering role at the heart of cutting‑edge R&D, mission frameworks, autonomous behaviors, obstacle avoidance, path planning and the application of modern AI techniques. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.


Your Contributions
  • Contribute to the technical strategy and design for the autonomy software architecture, ensuring robots act transparently and reliably in complex environments
  • Lead and develop core robotics algorithms to expand our autonomous operational envelope in challenging conditions
  • Triage customer issues, recognize trends, and rapidly make our system more resilient to failures observed in the field.
  • Write, deploy, and maintain highly efficient C++ and Python software for the autonomy stack
  • Serve as a mentor and collaborator, participating in architecture group activities and guiding junior engineers on algorithm design and best practices
  • Evaluate cutting-edge algorithms and solutions to continuously push the boundaries of autonomous performance and system adaptability

    • Your Profile
  • University degree in engineering or science with a focus on computer science, electrical engineering or robotics
  • Proven track record of shipping software to the field and maintaining those solutions over time
  • Proven experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices
  • Strong contributor to technical strategy and mentoring of junior engineers
  • Strong understanding of autonomous systems, including: motion planning, state estimation, behaviour‑based control, path planning, mission planning & execution
  • Strong knowledge of Linux systems, middleware frameworks and interfacing complex modules up and down the software stack
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset, working towards a goal and achieving outcomes
  • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Bonus Points
  • Hands-on experience with Reinforcement Learning (RL) and deployment of cutting-edge AI/ML models
  • Development of scalable and modular robot architectures with task execution frameworks such as Behavior Trees
  • Experience with ROS/ROS2
  • Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim

title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Platform, C++)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

#LI-MM1

We’re looking for a Software Engineer with strong C++ expertise to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.

Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

Built on top of the open-source YTsaurus ecosystem, we run and extend our own Nebius distribution and develop significant in-house functionality (core and platform-level). We can design, implement, and roll out features end-to-end on our clusters without waiting for upstream approvals and contribute upstream when it makes sense.

At scale today, this includes~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.

What’s inside the platform

You’ll work on a system that includes (and ties together):

  • Distributed Storage (Cypress): transactional semantics, tiered storage, erasure coding, replication, and strong reliability expectations.
  • Compute & ETL: a cluster-wide job scheduler (tens of thousands of cores), MapReduce, YQL for SQL-like data processing, and SPYT (Spark over YTsaurus) for modern data engineering.
  • Interactive analytics (CHYT): ClickHouse® instances spun up directly on compute nodes for fast SQL over data in-place.
  • Dynamic Tables: low-latency NoSQL KV with distributed ACID transactions for OLTP-style workloads and feature stores.
  • Orchestracto: workflow orchestration deeply integrated with the platform (Airflow-like, but platform-native).

What you’ll do

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong systems skills with product sense: understanding who uses the platform, why certain capabilities matter, and making pragmatic trade-offs to maximize impact. On our team, engineering work is expected to be connected to real users and outcomes — you’ll regularly align with internal stakeholders, clarify requirements, and help drive prioritization.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and implement new functionality in YTsaurus core (C++) with production reliability in mind.
  • Build and evolve platform-level capabilities: platform architecture and operating model—multi-cluster growth, shared primitives, and a consistent experience that scales with new teams and use cases.
  • Improve end-to-end platform experience for internal (and external-facing) users: APIs, guardrails, debugging workflows, and automation.
  • Own production quality: incident response / on-call rotation, root cause analysis, and turning learnings into durable fixes.

Example projects

  • Roll out sharded YTsaurus masters (incl. Kubernetes operator support) and build automatic balancing of metadata across master cells (consensus groups) to remove control-plane bottlenecks and unlock 10–100x cluster growth.
  • Make CHYT interactive SQL faster and more predictable at high load via performance work like data-skipping / min-max-style indexes and improved execution introspection.
  • Turn Orchestracto into a platform product by defining the building blocks, developer experience, and governance for how teams create and share workflows.
  • Scale and harden Parquet-on-S3 for native YTsaurus workloads by tackling replication/movement, consistent lifecycle semantics, and master-server metadata optimizations for performance and reliability.
  • Design and ship complete, trustworthy audit trails for data changes (who/what/when) across heterogeneous storage and compute paths.

Tech stack

  • Core: modern C++ (C++20, async + multithreaded primitives)
  • Services & tooling: Go and Python (microservices, utilities, integration tests)

What we expect

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong C++ skills (you’ll write core code).
  • Working knowledge of Python and/or Go (you don’t have to be expert, but should be comfortable navigating them).
  • Experience developing and/or operating high-load, distributed services.
  • Production mindset: ability to use SSH, read logs/metrics/traces, and debug distributed systems behavior.
  • Solid CS fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency basics.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).
  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, schedulers, resource isolation, quotas, and reliability engineering.
  • Strong performance engineering skills (profiling, lock contention, latency/throughput tradeoffs).

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer — ML Inference & Numerics
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You’ll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You’ll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We’re looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You’ll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

What you’ll do

  • Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.
  • Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.
  • Optimize numerics. Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.
  • Make numerical quality measurable. Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.
  • Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.
  • Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

What we need from you

  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model’s implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.
  • You build excellent software. You’ve owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You’re strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.
  • You are fluent with agentic tooling. You’d rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.
  • You take ownership and bring others along. You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.

If you tick a few of these boxes, we’d love to hear from you.

We’d be thrilled if you had

  • Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.
  • Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.
  • Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.
  • Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

Why join us

Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You’ll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.

If you want to build the tools, solve the hard failures, and help set the engineering direction of a new inference platform, we’d like to hear from you.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer

Join our new Software Platform team and make the devices, networks and compute behind SE3's autonomy run reliably, so our engineers can focus on what they do best.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Software Platform team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be a founding member of our new Software Platform team and own everything infrastructure apart from cybersecurity: software distribution to our platforms, device provisioning, networks, our compute cluster and CI. You'll work on-site in Munich alongside our cybersecurity engineer and the CV, robotics and firmware teams, with occasional visits to our second site.

What You'll Work On

  • Over-the-Air Updates: Unify our separate update and software distribution setups for Jetson, NXP and other edge nodes into one reliable system for every platform.

  • Device Provisioning: Provision, configure and maintain Linux-based edge devices, workstations and ground systems, including ARM64 platforms.

  • Deployment Automation: Build reproducible container images, deployments, device configuration, release workflows and recovery procedures, with Bash and Python tooling.

  • Networks & Remote Access: Design and troubleshoot connectivity across networked and remote devices, including routing, SSH, VPNs, firewalls and constrained field links.

  • Compute Cluster & CI: Make our GPU compute and evaluation cluster and self-hosted CI runners reliable, so engineers can depend on them without manual recovery.

  • Monitoring & Documentation: Improve monitoring, service availability, security hygiene and operational documentation, working closely with our cybersecurity engineer.

  • Engineering Standards: Set the infrastructure standards our teams follow, and support firmware, robotics, CV and test teams in the lab and the field.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership across many areas at once and enjoy covering several roles in a small team, from planning a system to fixing it by hand.

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.

  • You bring around five years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, DevOps or Linux systems engineering, ideally in a small IT or platform team, and you can point to real systems you built and ran.

  • You have distributed and updated software across large fleets of devices, whether laptops, servers or embedded systems.

  • You have strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, write reliable Bash and Python automation, and understand your systems well enough to catch the edge cases tools miss.

  • You can debug IP networks end to end, including routing, DNS, SSH, VPNs and firewalls, and you're experienced with Docker and container deployment.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Embedded Linux on NVIDIA Jetson or NXP, Yocto/BSP, flashing or hardware bring-up.

  • GPU compute clusters, Slurm or Kubernetes, and self-hosted GitHub Actions runners.

  • Infrastructure automation or observability with Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus or Grafana.

  • ROS 2/DDS, MAVLink or field robotics.

  • Involvement in technical student groups or societies during university.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3's growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let's get to know each other.

  2. Technical Interview (60 min): We discuss software distribution, networking and how you approach problems across a broad infrastructure stack.

  3. On-site Interviews: Meet engineers from our CV, robotics and platform teams and work through real infrastructure scenarios together.

  4. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

Equal Opportunity

SE3 is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

WHO YOU ARE

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. title: Software Engineer - Database
descriptionHtml:
About MotherDuck

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do

The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.

  • Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.

  • Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.

  • Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.

  • Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.

  • Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most.

  • Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems.

  • Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team.

  • Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next.

What you bring

  • You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like.

  • You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.)

  • A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques.

  • Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at.

  • You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems.

  • You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies.

  • You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs.

  • You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment.

  • You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs.

What we provide

  • The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases.

  • Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.

  • Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.

  • A good pension plan

  • Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong.

  • Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. We have to warn you though, most of us like the office so much we come anyway. It’s on the river Ij, with a great lunch every day.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer

The Role

We’re hiring a Software Engineer to maintain and grow the platform that clinicians rely on every day. You’ll work across the whole stack and in both of our main repositories: the SvelteKit front end and the Python services that power document generation with large language models. You’ll take features from idea to production, keep the platform fast, reliable and cost-effective, and work closely with our Product Engineer and engineering leadership to turn the roadmap into shippable work. You’ll also help set the engineering standard for the team through thoughtful code review and sound technical judgement.

This role suits a broad, highly capable engineer who enjoys owning problems end to end rather than staying in one layer. You’ll be comfortable moving from a Svelte component to a FastAPI service to a database migration in a single afternoon, and you’ll enjoy the detective work of tracing a slow request or getting to the root cause of a production incident. You’ll lead in some areas and learn from teammates in others, and you’ll care as much about quality, safety and maintainability as you do about shipping.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Deliver features end to end, from Postgres, to API services, through UI optimisations, and user experiences.

  • Build new clinical document types, from writing and evaluating the prompt to building the editor view and releasing it safely behind a feature flag

  • Improve the speed and cost of document generation by tracing requests, finding bottlenecks, and tuning models, prompts and retry policies without compromising quality

  • Build integrations with practice management systems such as Best Practice and EMIS, and with healthcare standards like FHIR and HL7

  • Investigate production incidents using Sentry, CloudWatch, and Langfuse, and then identify and fix the root cause rather than just the symptoms

  • Independently break down feature work into clear, shippable steps

  • Review your teammates’ code and help keep our engineering standard high

What you’ll bring

  • Strong, production-level TypeScript and modern front-end framework experience, ideally Svelte and SvelteKit

  • Strong Python skills, including data structures, async programming, and building APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic

  • Hands-on experience integrating large language models into products, including prompt engineering, structured output, streaming, and managing latency and cost

  • Solid Postgres and SQL skills, including schema design, indexing and query performance

  • Experience shipping and operating software on AWS, a history with Docker, and good observability and testing practices

  • The breadth and confidence to work across the full stack, and the judgement to know when to lead and when to learn

Nice to have

  • Experience with healthcare integrations such as FHIR, HL7, EMIS or Best Practice

  • Familiarity with Supabase, including row level security and generated types, or with Temporal for durable workflows

  • Experience protecting personal data in text using tools like Presidio, llm-guard or spaCy

  • Experience with rich text editors such as ProseMirror or TinyMCE, or with browser audio capture and real-time streaming

  • A working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and front-end performance optimisation

Every hour a clinician spends on paperwork is an hour taken away from patients. The code you write here goes straight into the hands of doctors, nurses and allied health professionals, giving them time back and helping them deliver better, safer care. If you want your engineering to have a real, visible impact on people’s health, this is the place to do it.

We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Company

Help us build the world's most reliable, on-demand logistics engine for last-mile delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers the company’s three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and riders.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced engineers to join the EU Traffic team, based at Deliveroo, part of DoorDash, and help build the next generation of DoorDash’s Traffic platform. We are building a single, shared platform designed to serve DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, so your work will shape reliability and security for all three marketplaces. Our team owns the infrastructure that carries every request into and through that platform: the edge, where we manage Cloudflare (CDN, DNS, rate limiting, bot mitigation) and the ingress systems for external traffic, and service-to-service (S2S) communication, where we run the service mesh and the authentication that secures calls between thousands of services across multiple regions.

You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security. It includes designing, building, and maintaining systems that must operate reliably and efficiently across some of the most critical and latency-sensitive workloads at DoorDash, from the first byte at the edge to the last hop between services.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the EU-Traffic Team within the Infrastructure organization. This role is hybrid working from London.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design and build large-scale distributed systems that are high RPS and latency sensitive
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and fix issues that affect production and maintain our SLAs
  • Work collaboratively with other platform and product engineers to deliver on feature requests and solve their problems
  • Find ways to improve the team’s productivity and operational capabilities through the use of automation, AI tools, and other avenues
  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation and help lead production investigations and incidents, with support from teammates
  • Mentor and learn from teammates through design reviews, pairing, and incident reviews

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer in infrastructure, networking, or platform engineering/SRE
  • Experience operating edge technologies at scale, such as CDN, WAF, proxy layers, and DNS
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals like TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTP/2, gRPC, Load Balancing
  • Background working on and debugging high-QPS or latency-sensitive systems
  • You’re curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in ambiguity
  • You work AI-first: you delegate to and orchestrate coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across design, implementation, testing, incident response, and releases

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about this work, we’d still love to hear from you.

Delivery & Execution

  • Own delivery frameworks: timelines, milestones, reporting, proactively securing commitments and flagging risks or delays early.

  • Optimize delivery processes by identifying friction points and standardizing workflows to enhance quality and predictability.

  • Run the account's logistics for Mistral team going on site (access, security, meetings)

Operational Innovation & Automation

  • Build and enhance Mistral’s platform and internal tools to empower program delivery with scalable, tailored solutions

  • Automate workflows to eliminate manual friction in planning, reporting, and follow-ups, accelerating execution and reducing operational overhead


Who you are

  • Technical foundation. You have an engineering or equivalent technical background and 3–5 years of experience as a Technical Program Manager (or similar) delivering complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs at a tech company, scale-up, or enterprise.

  • AI-fluent. You genuinely use AI tools to automate your own work: drafting, analysis, reporting, PMO tasks. You're comfortable building and iterating on automations.

  • High agency. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap, you close it, and you raise the standard as you go.

  • Customer-centric. You can hold a room with senior enterprise stakeholders and translate between business strategy and technical delivery.

  • Adaptable. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and a fast-moving environment; bias to action over process for its own sake.


Nice to have

  • Experience in enterprise software, AI, or deep-tech delivery environments.

  • Exposure to change management / adoption at scale within large organizations.

You'll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering while partnering directly with customers in manufacturing, retail, security, robotics, and beyond.   • 12 months: Becoming the technical partner AEs and CSMs want on their biggest accounts, with POCs that convert and referenceable customer deployments.

  • Strong Python and practical experience with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and computer vision.

  • Experience training, optimizing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Comfortable with Docker, Git, REST APIs, Linux, cloud platforms, and edge workflows.

  • Experience deploying across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.

  • Proven ability to deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and POCs.

  • Strong communication skills with both technical and executive audiences.

  • Independent ownership, urgency, resilience, and results in a high-performance startup environment.

At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

  • Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.
